entries.example: They had to abandon the car when the flood water rose.
entries.exampleZh: 洪水上涨时，他们只好弃车。

entries.example: The storm finally began to abate after three long days.
entries.exampleZh: 三天漫长的日子过后，暴风雨终于开始减弱。

entries.example: She asked what the abbreviation at the end of the line meant.
entries.exampleZh: 她问那一行末尾的缩略语是什么意思。

entries.example: Most people find such cruel treatment of animals completely abhorrent.
entries.exampleZh: 大多数人认为这样残忍地对待动物是完全可恶的。

entries.example: I cannot abide the noise from the building site next door.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法忍受隔壁建筑工地的噪音。

entries.example: Her ability to stay calm under pressure impressed the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 她在压力下保持镇定的能力让整个团队印象深刻。

entries.example: The doctor said the test results were slightly abnormal this time.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说这次的化验结果有点反常。

entries.example: They welcomed us into their humble abode by the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 他们把我们迎进湖边他们那简陋的住所。

entries.example: Many people want the government to abolish this outdated law.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人希望政府废除这条过时的法律。

entries.example: The museum displays beautiful art made by aboriginal people long ago.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出很久以前原住民创作的美丽艺术品。

entries.example: They had to abort the mission when the weather turned bad.
entries.exampleZh: 天气变坏时，他们不得不取消这次任务。

entries.example: The debate about abortion still divides many voters in that country.
entries.exampleZh: 关于流产的争论在那个国家仍然使许多选民意见分歧。

entries.example: Fresh vegetables abound in the markets during the summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 夏季的几个月里，市场上新鲜蔬菜很多。

entries.example: She cleaned the small abrasion on her knee with care.
entries.exampleZh: 她小心地清洗了膝盖上那块小小的擦伤。

entries.example: The publisher decided to abridge the novel for younger readers.
entries.exampleZh: 出版社决定为年龄较小的读者删节这部小说。

entries.example: His abrupt answer made everyone at the table feel uncomfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 他唐突的回答让桌边每个人都感到不自在。

entries.example: Three students were absent from class because of the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 因为有暴风雨，三名学生没来上课。

entries.example: High absenteeism at the factory forced the manager to act.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂里居高不下的旷工率迫使经理采取行动。

entries.example: She has absolute trust in her old friend's judgment.
entries.exampleZh: 她对她那位老朋友的判断绝对信任。

entries.meaning: 吸收；吸引；吸收；吸引…的注意，使全神贯注；把…并入，同化
entries.example: Dry soil cannot absorb water as quickly as wet soil.
entries.exampleZh: 干燥的土壤吸收水分不如湿土快。

entries.meaning: 抽象的；(书籍、演说等的)摘要；抽象的；；摘要，提炼；抽象化
entries.example: Her abstract painting confused most visitors at the small gallery.
entries.exampleZh: 她的抽象画让小画廊的大多数参观者感到困惑。

entries.example: The philosopher warned that too much abstraction can hide real problems.
entries.exampleZh: 这位哲学家告诫说，过多的抽象会掩盖真实问题。

entries.meaning: 可笑的，荒谬的；荒谬的，荒唐的
entries.example: It seems absurd to blame the weather for our poor planning.
entries.exampleZh: 把规划不周归咎于天气似乎很荒谬。

entries.meaning: 丰富；大量，丰富，充足，充裕
entries.example: There was an abundance of fresh fruit at the summer market.
entries.exampleZh: 夏季市场上新鲜水果供应充足。

entries.meaning: 滥用；恶习；辱骂；滥用，妄用；虐待，伤害；辱骂，毁谤；滥用，妄用；虐待，伤害；辱骂，毁谤[ə'bjuːz]
entries.example: The report describes the abuse of power by several local officials.
entries.exampleZh: 报告描述了数名当地官员滥用权力的行为。

entries.meaning: 学术的；学校的；学院的；学术的；不切实际的；学者；大学教师
entries.example: She has a strong academic background in biology and chemistry.
entries.exampleZh: 她在生物学和化学方面有很强的学术背景。

entries.example: The new engine can accelerate from zero to sixty in seconds.
entries.exampleZh: 这台新发动机能在几秒内从零加速到六十。

entries.example: Your proposal is acceptable, but we need more details before Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 你的提议可以接受，但我们需要在周一前得到更多细节。

entries.example: Students need access to the library after six in the evening.
entries.exampleZh: 学生在晚上六点以后需要能够进入图书馆。

entries.example: The museum is accessible to visitors in wheelchairs all year.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆全年都方便轮椅使用者参观。

entries.example: A simple scarf is a useful accessory for cool autumn evenings.
entries.exampleZh: 一条简单的围巾是凉爽秋夜里实用的配饰。

entries.meaning: 向…欢呼，为…喝彩；称赞；欢迎
entries.example: The young director received international acclaim for her first film.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻导演因她的第一部电影获得了国际赞誉。

entries.example: It took the team two weeks to acclimatise to the high altitude.
entries.exampleZh: 队伍花了两周时间才适应高海拔环境。

entries.example: The hotel can accommodate up to three hundred guests each night.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店每晚最多可接待三百位客人。

entries.meaning: 住宿；住处，膳宿；适应，调节
entries.example: We found cheap accommodation near the station for the whole week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们找到了车站附近便宜的住处，可以住一整周。

entries.meaning: 陪伴，伴奏；陪伴；伴随，与…同时发生；伴奏
entries.example: Her brother will accompany her to the interview on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 她哥哥将在周五陪她去参加面试。

entries.example: We can accomplish more if we work together on this project.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我们在这个项目上合作，就能完成更多工作。

entries.example: The two countries signed a peace accord after long talks.
entries.exampleZh: 两国经过长时间会谈后签署了和平协议。

entries.meaning: 账目；帐户；计算；说明；说明，解释；占；
entries.example: Please check your bank account before making the large payment.
entries.exampleZh: 在进行大额付款之前，请检查你的银行账户。

entries.example: Managers must be accountable for every decision they make at work.
entries.exampleZh: 管理者必须对他们在工作中做出的每一项决定负责。

entries.example: She chose accountancy because she enjoys working with numbers and financial records.
entries.exampleZh: 她选择会计工作，因为她喜欢和数字及财务记录打交道。

entries.example: The accountant checked every figure before sending the report to the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 会计在把报告发给经理之前核对了每一个数字。

entries.meaning: 信任，相信，委任，授权；把…归于
entries.example: The university will accredit the new program after a careful review.
entries.exampleZh: 大学将在仔细审查后批准这个新项目。

entries.example: The hospital received full accreditation after meeting all the safety standards.
entries.exampleZh: 这家医院在达到所有安全标准后获得了全面认证。

entries.example: Dust can accumulate quickly if you do not clean the shelves.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你不清理架子，灰尘会很快积聚起来。

entries.example: The accuracy of these measurements matters for the final test results.
entries.exampleZh: 这些测量的准确性对最终测试结果很重要。

entries.example: Her description of the accident was accurate and easy to understand.
entries.exampleZh: 她对事故的描述准确且容易理解。

entries.example: They accuse the company of hiding important facts from the public.
entries.exampleZh: 他们指责公司向公众隐瞒重要事实。

entries.example: Teachers accustom students to speaking English during every class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师们让学生习惯于每节课都说英语。

entries.example: With steady effort, you can achieve your goals this year.
entries.exampleZh: 只要坚持不懈，你今年就能实现目标。

entries.meaning: 成就，成绩；达到，完成，实现
entries.example: Winning that prize was a great achievement for the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 赢得那个奖项是整个团队的一大成就。

entries.example: The acid in the lemon can damage the surface of this table.
entries.exampleZh: 柠檬里的酸会损坏这张桌子的表面。

entries.meaning: 承认；表示收到信件，表示感谢；承认，确认；致意；感谢
entries.example: Please acknowledge receipt of this letter by signing and returning the form.
entries.exampleZh: 请签好并寄回表格，以确认收到这封信。

entries.example: The band played an acoustic version of their most famous song.
entries.exampleZh: 乐队演奏了他们最著名歌曲的原声版本。

entries.meaning: 使认识；使熟悉；认识；熟悉
entries.example: A short tour will acquaint you with the history of this town.
entries.exampleZh: 一次短途游览会让你了解这座小镇的历史。

entries.example: She met an old acquaintance at the market this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上她在市场遇到了一位老熟人。

entries.example: Children acquire language skills by listening to people around them.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们通过倾听周围的人来获得语言技能。

entries.meaning: 获得，获得物；取得；获得物
entries.example: The company announced its acquisition of a smaller rival last week.
entries.exampleZh: 公司上周宣布收购了一个较小的竞争对手。

entries.example: The acrobat balanced carefully on a thin rope above the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 杂技演员在人群上方的一根细绳上小心保持平衡。

entries.meaning: 杂技的；杂技般的；杂技演员的
entries.example: The dancers performed an acrobatic move that amazed the young audience.
entries.exampleZh: 舞者们表演了一个令年轻观众惊叹的杂技动作。

entries.meaning: 使活动，触发；激活；使活动，使活化
entries.example: Press this button to activate the alarm before you leave the building.
entries.exampleZh: 离开大楼前按这个按钮启动警报。

entries.example: The actual cost was much higher than the estimate we received.
entries.exampleZh: 实际费用比我们收到的估算高得多。

entries.example: Her business acumen helped the small company survive a difficult year.
entries.exampleZh: 她的商业敏锐帮助这家小公司度过了艰难的一年。

entries.example: Many patients say acupuncture reduced their back pain after several treatments.
entries.exampleZh: 许多患者说针灸在几次治疗后减轻了他们的背痛。

entries.meaning: 厉害的，敏锐的，(疾病等)急性的；灵敏的；剧烈的，猛烈的
entries.example: The doctor noticed an acute pain in his lower back area.
entries.exampleZh: 医生注意到他下背部有一处剧烈疼痛。

entries.meaning: 使适应，改编；使适合；改编；适应
entries.example: Children often adapt quickly to a new school and make friends.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们通常很快适应新学校并交到朋友。

entries.example: The film is a loose adaptation of a famous nineteenth-century novel.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部著名十九世纪小说的松散改编。

entries.meaning: 使沉迷，使嗜好；吸毒成瘾的人，有瘾的人，对…入迷的人
entries.example: He is a former drug addict who now helps others recover.
entries.exampleZh: 他是一名正在帮助他人康复的戒毒者。

entries.example: His addiction to video games began to affect his studies and sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 他对电子游戏的沉迷开始影响他的学业和睡眠。

entries.example: In addition to English, she studies French and Japanese at school.
entries.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还在学校学习法语和日语。

entries.example: We need additional staff to handle the rising number of customers.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要更多员工来应对不断增加的顾客数量。

entries.meaning: 住址；致词；向致词；在信封上写姓名；致函，写姓名地址；向…讲话，演说；处理，
entries.example: Please write your address clearly on the form before sending it back.
entries.exampleZh: 寄回表格前，请把您的地址清楚地写在表格上。

entries.meaning: 充分的；可胜任的；充足的；合适的，合格的
entries.example: The training was adequate for the job, but more practice would help.
entries.exampleZh: 这项培训足以胜任这份工作，但更多练习会有帮助。

entries.meaning: 粘着；忠于；坚持；黏附；遵守；坚持
entries.example: Please adhere to the safety rules while working in the laboratory.
entries.exampleZh: 在实验室工作时请遵守安全规则。

entries.meaning: 邻接的，邻近的；邻近的，毗连的
entries.example: Our hotel is adjacent to the train station and a large park.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的酒店毗邻火车站和一个大公园。

entries.example: A small garden will adjoin the new library and reading room.
entries.exampleZh: 一个小花园将与新图书馆和阅览室毗连。

entries.meaning: 附加物，附件；附加语，修饰语
entries.example: The teacher treated the field trip as an adjunct to classroom lessons.
entries.exampleZh: 老师把实地考察视为课堂课程的补充。

entries.meaning: 校准，调整；校准；调节；使…适应
entries.example: You can adjust the chair height to make it more comfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以调整椅子的高度，使它更舒适。

entries.meaning: 管理，支配；给予；掌管；给予
entries.example: Nurses administer medicine to patients at regular times each day.
entries.exampleZh: 护士每天按时给病人给药。

entries.meaning: 管理，经营；行政；管理；行政
entries.example: The hospital administration announced new visiting hours for all patients.
entries.exampleZh: 医院管理层宣布了所有病人的新探视时间。

entries.example: The administrative staff handled all the paperwork before the meeting began.
entries.exampleZh: 行政人员在会议开始前处理了所有文书工作。

entries.meaning: 管理者，管理人员；行政人员
entries.example: The new administrator quickly organized the office and answered every call.
entries.exampleZh: 新来的管理人员迅速整理了办公室并接听了每一个电话。

entries.meaning: 准入，接纳，承认；允许进入，加入权，进入权；招供，招认；入场券
entries.example: Her admission to the university surprised everyone in the small town.
entries.exampleZh: 她被大学录取的消息让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 承认；准许…进入；准许…加入
entries.example: I must admit that the test was harder than I expected.
entries.exampleZh: 我必须承认这次考试比我预想的更难。

entries.example: The old house was built from adobe and local wood.
entries.exampleZh: 那座老房子是用土坯和当地木材建成的。

entries.example: During adolescence, many young people begin to question the rules around them.
entries.exampleZh: 在青春期，许多年轻人开始质疑周围的规则。

entries.meaning: 青春期的；青少年的；青少年
entries.example: Every adolescent needs support and clear guidance from caring adults.
entries.exampleZh: 每个青少年都需要有爱心的成年人给予支持和明确指导。

entries.meaning: 收养；采用；采用，采取，采纳；收养，领养；正式通过，批准
entries.example: The couple decided to adopt a child from a nearby village.
entries.exampleZh: 这对夫妇决定从附近村庄收养一个孩子。

entries.example: I adore the quiet mornings I spend reading by the window.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常喜爱在窗边读书的安静早晨。

entries.meaning: 预先的；；前进，前移；增长，提高；预付
entries.example: Please book your tickets in advance to avoid long lines.
entries.exampleZh: 请提前订票以避免排长队。

entries.example: This advanced course teaches students how to solve complex problems.
entries.exampleZh: 这门高级课程教学生如何解决复杂问题。

entries.example: One advantage of living here is the short walk to school.
entries.exampleZh: 住在这里的一个优点是步行到学校很近。

entries.example: It is advantageous to book your room early during the holiday season.
entries.exampleZh: 在假期期间尽早预订房间是有利的。

entries.example: The advent of cheap cameras changed how people recorded their lives.
entries.exampleZh: 廉价相机的出现改变了人们记录生活的方式。

entries.meaning: 冒险，冒险活动；异乎寻常的经历，奇遇
entries.example: Their weekend adventure in the mountains became a favorite family story.
entries.exampleZh: 他们周末在山里的冒险成了家人最爱讲的故事。

entries.meaning: 喜欢冒险的，敢作敢为的；充满危险和刺激的，惊险的
entries.example: She is an adventurous traveler who loves trying new foods and routes.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一个喜欢冒险的旅行者，喜欢尝试新食物和新路线。

entries.meaning: 不利的；劣的；不利的，有害的
entries.example: The medicine may have adverse effects on people with heart problems.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药可能对心脏病患者有不良影响。

entries.meaning: 做广告；为…做广告；宣传；公告，公布
entries.example: They plan to advertise the new product on several popular websites.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在几个热门网站上为新产品做广告。

entries.meaning: 广告，公告；广告活动，宣传
entries.example: I saw an advertisement for a job that matches my skills.
entries.exampleZh: 我看到一则与我技能相符的招聘广告。

entries.example: My teacher gave me useful advice about preparing for the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给了我一些关于备考的有用建议。

entries.example: It is advisable to book your tickets early this summer.
entries.exampleZh: 今年夏天最好尽早订票。

entries.meaning: 辩护人；倡导者；提倡，支持；拥护，支持；提倡['ædvəkət]；拥护者，支持者；提倡者
entries.example: Doctors advocate regular exercise for people over fifty.
entries.exampleZh: 医生提倡五十岁以上的人定期锻炼。

entries.example: Good aeration helps the roots stay healthy in wet soil.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的通风有助于根系在潮湿的土壤中保持健康。

entries.meaning: 空气的；空中的 (无线电)天线
entries.example: The aerial view of the valley was truly breathtaking.
entries.exampleZh: 从空中俯瞰山谷的景色真是令人叹为观止。

entries.example: She teaches aerobics at the local gym every Tuesday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 她每周二晚上在当地健身房教有氧运动。

entries.example: He studied aeronautics and later joined a small design firm.
entries.exampleZh: 他学习航空学，后来加入了一家小型设计公司。

entries.example: The old aeroplane landed safely despite the strong wind.
entries.exampleZh: 那架旧飞机尽管风很大仍安全着陆。

entries.meaning: 宇宙空间；航空航天技术
entries.example: The aerospace industry offers many jobs for skilled engineers.
entries.exampleZh: 航空航天工业为熟练工程师提供了许多工作岗位。

entries.meaning: 美学的；艺术的；美学的；审美的
entries.example: The building's aesthetic appeal comes from its simple lines.
entries.exampleZh: 这座建筑的美学吸引力来自其简洁的线条。

entries.example: Lack of sleep can affect your mood and concentration.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会影响你的情绪和注意力。

entries.example: She showed great affection for her old family dog.
entries.exampleZh: 她对家里的老狗表现出深厚的感情。

entries.meaning: 使加入，接受为分支机构
entries.example: The university will affiliate with a new research center.
entries.exampleZh: 这所大学将与一个新的研究中心建立联系。

entries.example: The witness will affirm that she saw the car leave.
entries.exampleZh: 证人将断言她看见那辆车离开。

entries.example: Please affix the stamp firmly to the top corner.
entries.exampleZh: 请把邮票牢牢贴在右上角。

entries.meaning: 使痛苦，使苦恼；使苦恼；折磨
entries.example: Chronic pain can afflict people for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 慢性疼痛能折磨人很多年。

entries.example: The afflicting illness kept him at home for weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 这种令人痛苦的疾病使他待在家里数周。

entries.example: They live in an affluent neighborhood near the city center.
entries.exampleZh: 他们住在市中心附近一个富裕的社区。

entries.meaning: 冒险；得起；供给；负担得起
entries.example: We cannot afford a new car this year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今年买不起新车。

entries.meaning: 在野外，在田中；在战场上；离乡背井地；到远方，在远处
entries.example: The researchers traveled far afield to collect rare plant samples.
entries.exampleZh: 研究人员远赴野外采集稀有植物样本。

entries.meaning: 代理商(社)；机构；代理，代办
entries.example: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel rooms.
entries.exampleZh: 旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店房间。

entries.example: The next item on our agenda is the budget report.
entries.exampleZh: 我们议程上的下一项是预算报告。

entries.meaning: 使恶化；使加剧；使气恼；恶化，加重，加剧
entries.example: Loud music late at night can aggravate your neighbours.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜的喧闹音乐会使你的邻居更加烦躁。

entries.example: Her constant complaints caused him a great deal of aggravation.
entries.exampleZh: 她不断的抱怨给他带来了极大的烦恼。

entries.example: The aggregate of these numbers comes to exactly one hundred.
entries.exampleZh: 这些数字合计正好是一百。

entries.meaning: 侵略的，有闯劲的；侵犯的，侵略的，挑衅的；有进取心的，有冲劲的
entries.example: The company adopted an aggressive strategy to enter the new market.
entries.exampleZh: 公司采取了进取的策略来进入这个新市场。

entries.example: His aggressiveness during the meeting surprised even his closest colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 他在会议上的咄咄逼人连最亲近的同事都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The dancer was surprisingly agile for someone of her age.
entries.exampleZh: 这位舞者对她这个年纪的人来说身手出奇地敏捷。

entries.example: She showed clear signs of agitation before the job interview.
entries.exampleZh: 面试前她表现出明显的不安迹象。

entries.example: He was in agony after twisting his ankle during the match.
entries.exampleZh: 他在比赛中扭伤脚踝后痛苦不堪。

entries.meaning: 令人愉快的；乐于同意的
entries.example: The weather today is quite agreeable for a long walk outside.
entries.exampleZh: 今天的天气很适合到户外长时间散步。

entries.example: After hours of talks, the two sides finally reached an agreement.
entries.exampleZh: 经过数小时的会谈，双方终于达成了一项协议。

entries.example: Modern agriculture depends heavily on machines and chemical fertilizers.
entries.exampleZh: 现代农业严重依赖机械和化肥。

entries.example: This simple herbal remedy can ease a minor ailment like a cold.
entries.exampleZh: 这种简单的草药疗法能缓解像感冒这样的小病。

entries.example: The mountain air was cold and wonderfully fresh after the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后的山间空气寒冷而格外清新。

entries.example: The committee gave the new proposal a full airing last week.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会上周对这个新提案进行了充分的讨论。

entries.example: Keep the biscuits in an airtight box so they stay crisp.
entries.exampleZh: 把饼干放在密封盒里，这样它们就能保持酥脆。

entries.example: She walked down the aisle towards her waiting husband.
entries.exampleZh: 她沿着通道走向等候她的丈夫。

entries.meaning: 警报，惊慌；使忧虑；惊恐，恐慌；报警器；闹钟；警报；使惊恐；使担心
entries.example: The fire alarm woke everyone in the building at midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 午夜时分火警警报吵醒了楼里的每个人。

entries.example: He agreed to help, albeit rather reluctantly and without much enthusiasm.
entries.exampleZh: 他同意帮忙，尽管相当勉强，也不太热心。

entries.example: My grandmother keeps every old family photo in a thick album.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶把每一张旧的家庭照片都收在一本厚相册里。

entries.example: The old alchemist tried to turn ordinary metal into gold.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年老的炼金术士试图把普通金属变成黄金。

entries.example: The doctor advised him to avoid alcohol while taking these pills.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议他在服用这些药片期间不要饮酒。

entries.example: The guards stayed alert throughout the whole night.
entries.exampleZh: 卫兵们整夜都保持警惕。

entries.example: She struggled with algebra during her first year at college.
entries.exampleZh: 大学第一年她在代数上很吃力。

entries.meaning: 外侨；外国人的；不相容的
entries.example: He felt like an alien in that strange new city.
entries.exampleZh: 在那座陌生的新城市里，他觉得自己像个外侨。

entries.meaning: 离间，使疏远；使疏远，使不友好；转让，让渡
entries.example: His rude jokes began to alienate several of his coworkers.
entries.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的玩笑开始让几位同事疏远他。

entries.example: A sense of alienation kept him from joining any social group.
entries.exampleZh: 一种疏离感使他无法融入任何社交团体。

entries.example: We watched the butterfly alight gently on a yellow flower.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看着那只蝴蝶轻轻落在一朵黄花上。

entries.example: A quick alignment of the wheels improved the car's handling.
entries.exampleZh: 车轮的一次快速校准改善了汽车的操控性。

entries.example: We all agreed to meet again next Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们都同意下周六上午再见面。

entries.example: Neighbours allege that the noise comes from that empty house.
entries.exampleZh: 邻居们声称噪音来自那栋空房子。

entries.example: Soldiers swear allegiance to their country on the first day.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在第一天宣誓效忠自己的国家。

entries.meaning: 过敏的，变态反应的，变应性的
entries.example: My sister is allergic to peanuts and seafood.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹对花生和海鲜过敏。

entries.meaning: 减轻(痛苦等)；减轻，缓解，缓和
entries.example: A warm bath can alleviate the pain in your back.
entries.exampleZh: 热水浴可以减轻你背部的疼痛。

entries.example: The children played football in the narrow alley behind our house.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们房子后面的狭窄小巷里踢足球。

entries.example: The two companies formed an alliance to share research costs.
entries.exampleZh: 两家公司结成联盟以分担研究费用。

entries.example: The teacher will allocate ten minutes for questions at the end.
entries.exampleZh: 老师将在最后留出十分钟提问。

entries.example: The allocation of funds among the schools caused a heated debate.
entries.exampleZh: 资金在各学校之间的分配引发了激烈争论。

entries.meaning: 分配；拨给；部分；小块菜地
entries.example: The organizer will allot each speaker exactly five minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 组织者将给每位发言者正好分配五分钟。

entries.example: His parents give him a small monthly allowance for books.
entries.exampleZh: 他父母每月给他一小笔买书的零用钱。

entries.example: The factory mixes copper with another metal to produce a strong alloy.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂将铜与另一种金属混合，以生产出一种坚固的合金。

entries.example: The allure of the big city attracts many young people every year.
entries.exampleZh: 大城市的诱惑每年都吸引着许多年轻人。

entries.meaning: 【地】冲积的，淤积的；冲积土，淤积土
entries.example: Farmers grow rice on the rich alluvial soil beside the river.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们在河边肥沃的冲积土上种植水稻。

entries.example: Britain was a close ally of the United States during the war.
entries.exampleZh: 战争期间，英国是美国的亲密盟友。

entries.example: The cake is flavored with almond and topped with fresh cream.
entries.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕用杏仁调味，上面还铺了新鲜奶油。

entries.example: She lives alone in a small flat near the station.
entries.exampleZh: 她独自住在车站附近的一间小公寓里。

entries.example: The dog walked alongside its owner down the busy street.
entries.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着繁忙的街道走在主人身边。

entries.example: Please arrange these files in alphabetical order before the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 请在会议前把这些文件按字母顺序排列好。

entries.example: We had to alter our plans because of the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 由于大雨，我们不得不改变计划。

entries.meaning: 交替的，轮流的；轮流交替，交替；轮流，交替；轮流的；间隔的；交替的
entries.example: Doctors alternate between morning and evening shifts each week.
entries.exampleZh: 医生们每周在早班和晚班之间轮流。

entries.meaning: 两者选一；可供选择的；可供替代的；可供替代的；非传统的，
entries.example: The council is looking for an alternative route around the closed bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 市议会正在寻找一条绕开封闭桥梁的替代路线。

entries.example: The plane climbed to a high altitude before it turned east.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机爬升到很高的高度后才转向东方。

entries.example: Her altruistic behavior surprised everyone at the small charity event.
entries.exampleZh: 她在小型慈善活动上的无私举动让每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The frame is made of light aluminium and weighs very little.
entries.exampleZh: 这个框架由轻质铝制成，重量很小。

entries.example: Over the years he managed to amass a large collection of stamps.
entries.exampleZh: 多年来他积攒了大量的邮票收藏。

entries.meaning: 业余爱好者(的)；业余的；外行；业余爱好者
entries.example: He plays tennis as an amateur but trains almost every day.
entries.exampleZh: 他作为业余选手打网球，但几乎每天都训练。

entries.example: The magician's final trick will amaze even the older children.
entries.exampleZh: 魔术师最后的把戏甚至会让大一点的孩子感到惊奇。

entries.meaning: 大使；授权代表；大使，使节
entries.example: The French ambassador invited us to a dinner at his home.
entries.exampleZh: 法国大使邀请我们到他家参加晚宴。

entries.meaning: 模棱两可；多义词句；模棱两可；不明确
entries.example: The ambiguity of his answer left everyone in the room confused.
entries.exampleZh: 他回答的含糊其辞让房间里的每个人都感到困惑。

entries.meaning: 有歧义的；暧昧的；含糊其辞的；不明确的，模棱两可的
entries.example: His ambiguous reply made it hard to know what he wanted.
entries.exampleZh: 他含糊的回答让人很难知道他想要什么。

entries.meaning: 雄心，抱负；雄心，抱负；野心
entries.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help people in poor villages.
entries.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助贫困村庄的人们。

entries.meaning: 有抱负的；有抱负的，有雄心的，有野心的
entries.example: The ambitious young engineer plans to build a clean energy company.
entries.exampleZh: 这位有雄心的年轻工程师计划创办一家清洁能源公司。

entries.meaning: 救护车；救护车；野战医院
entries.example: An ambulance arrived within minutes and took the injured boy to hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 一辆救护车几分钟内赶到，把受伤的男孩送到了医院。

entries.example: The committee agreed to amend the old rules before the next season.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会同意在下个赛季前修改旧规则。

entries.example: He offered to make amends for the damage caused by his careless remark.
entries.exampleZh: 他主动提出为他轻率言论造成的伤害作出赔偿并道歉。

entries.example: The small shop stayed open amid the heavy rain and strong wind.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小店在暴雨和强风中仍然营业。

entries.example: She kept smiling amidst the noisy crowd and the flashing cameras.
entries.exampleZh: 在嘈杂的人群和闪烁的相机中，她一直微笑着。

entries.example: The soldiers carried enough ammunition for two days of fighting in the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们携带了足够在山中战斗两天的弹药。

entries.meaning: 无固定形状的；无组织的
entries.example: A dark, amorphous cloud slowly covered the whole valley before the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 一团黑暗而无定形的云在暴风雨前慢慢覆盖了整个山谷。

entries.meaning: 等于；总数；数量；合计；总额
entries.example: A small amount of salt can improve the flavour of this simple soup.
entries.exampleZh: 少量的盐可以改善这道简单汤的味道。

entries.meaning: 两栖动物；水陆两用飞机和车辆
entries.example: The frog is a common amphibian that lives near ponds and slow rivers.
entries.exampleZh: 青蛙是一种常见的两栖动物，生活在池塘和缓慢的河流附近。

entries.example: The army used an amphibious vehicle to cross the wide river quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 军队使用一辆水陆两用车迅速渡过了宽阔的河流。

entries.example: There is ample space in the garden for a table and six chairs.
entries.exampleZh: 花园里有充足的空间放一张桌子和六把椅子。

entries.meaning: 详述；引申；增强；详述；放大
entries.example: The teacher used a simple story to amplify her point about teamwork.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的故事来进一步说明她关于团队合作的观点。

entries.example: The funny clown tried to amuse the children during the long birthday party.
entries.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑在漫长的生日聚会上努力逗孩子们笑。

entries.example: The teacher said the heart is analogous to a pump in a simple machine.
entries.exampleZh: 老师说心脏类似于简单机器中的泵。

entries.example: She drew a clear analogy between the human brain and a computer.
entries.exampleZh: 她把人脑和计算机做了一个清晰的类比。

entries.example: The team will analyse the results before making any final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 团队将在做出任何最终决定之前分析结果。

entries.example: A careful analysis of the data revealed a surprising change in customer habits.
entries.exampleZh: 对数据的仔细分析揭示了顾客习惯的惊人变化。

entries.example: Her analytical mind helps her solve difficult problems in the laboratory.
entries.exampleZh: 她的分析性思维帮助她在实验室里解决难题。

entries.example: The anatomy of the human hand has fascinated artists for centuries.
entries.exampleZh: 人类手的解剖结构几个世纪以来一直令艺术家们着迷。

entries.example: My grandfather often spoke of an ancestor who sailed across the ocean.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父常提起一位横渡大洋的祖先。

entries.example: They returned to their ancestral village to celebrate the spring festival.
entries.exampleZh: 他们回到祖辈居住的村庄庆祝春节。

entries.meaning: 锚；危难时可依靠的人或物；用锚泊船；抛锚；使固定，系牢；使基于；主持；锚；给人安全感的人；精神支柱；顶梁柱
entries.example: The ship dropped anchor just outside the small harbor at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明时分，那艘船在小港口外抛下了锚。

entries.example: We walked through the ancient ruins and admired the carved stone walls.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走过古老的废墟，欣赏着那些雕刻的石墙。

entries.example: His evidence was purely anecdotal, so the scientists refused to accept it.
entries.exampleZh: 他的证据纯属轶闻，因此科学家们拒绝接受。

entries.meaning: 轶事，趣闻；短故事；趣闻，轶事
entries.example: She told a funny anecdote about her first day at work.
entries.exampleZh: 她讲了一件关于自己第一天上班的趣事。

entries.meaning: 移向；使成角度移动；从报道；角；角度；观点，立场
entries.example: Try to look at the problem from a different angle.
entries.exampleZh: 试着从另一个角度看待这个问题。

entries.meaning: 活的，有生命的；赋予生命；使生机勃勃
entries.example: Bright colors can animate a dull room and lift your mood.
entries.exampleZh: 明亮的色彩能让沉闷的房间焕发生机，也能改善你的心情。

entries.example: A single storm could annihilate the crops these farmers depend on.
entries.exampleZh: 一场风暴就可能摧毁这些农民赖以生存的庄稼。

entries.example: My parents celebrated their thirtieth anniversary with a quiet dinner at home.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母在家吃了一顿安静的晚餐，庆祝他们的三十周年纪念日。

entries.example: The company will announce the new product next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将于下周一上午宣布这款新产品。

entries.meaning: 使烦恼，使生气；使烦恼；打搅
entries.example: Loud music late at night really tends to annoy my neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜的大声音乐确实常常惹我的邻居们生气。

entries.meaning: 每年的，一年生的；年刊；一年生植物；每年的，年度的；年刊，年鉴；一年生植物
entries.example: Our annual trip to the mountains always begins in early October.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每年去山里的旅行总是从十月初开始。

entries.example: After he retired, the pension paid him a modest annuity each month.
entries.exampleZh: 退休后，养老金每月付给他一笔不多的年金。

entries.example: The donation came from an anonymous reader who wished to remain silent.
entries.exampleZh: 这笔捐款来自一位不愿露面的匿名读者。

entries.example: Years of small misunderstandings finally grew into open antagonism between them.
entries.exampleZh: 多年的小误会最终发展成他们之间公开的敌意。

entries.example: Historians studied the antecedent events that slowly led to the long war.
entries.exampleZh: 历史学家研究了那些慢慢导致这场长期战争的先前事件。

entries.example: The crowd stood up and sang the national anthem together.
entries.exampleZh: 人群站起来，一起唱起了国歌。

entries.example: This anthology collects twenty short poems by young local writers.
entries.exampleZh: 这本诗集收录了二十首当地年轻作家的短诗。

entries.example: The anthropologist spent two years studying a small village in the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 这位人类学家花了两年时间研究山里的一个小村庄。

entries.example: She decided to study anthropology after reading about ancient human societies.
entries.exampleZh: 读完关于古代人类社会的资料后，她决定学习人类学。

entries.meaning: 抗生素；抗菌的；抗菌的；抗生素，抗菌素
entries.example: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the infection in my throat.
entries.exampleZh: 医生给我喉咙的感染开了一种抗生素。

entries.meaning: 占先，预先处理；预料；预期，预料，期望；先于…行动
entries.example: We anticipate a large crowd at the concert this Saturday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们预计本周六晚上音乐会将有很多人。

entries.example: The children waited in eager anticipation for the first snow of winter.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们满怀期待地等待冬天的第一场雪。

entries.example: Scientists are still searching for an effective antidote to this rare poison.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家仍在寻找这种罕见毒物的有效解毒药。

entries.example: The company finally replaced its antiquated computer system last month.
entries.exampleZh: 公司上个月终于更换了陈旧的计算机系统。

entries.meaning: 古代的；古玩；古物；古时的，古老的；古物，古董
entries.example: My grandmother keeps a valuable antique in a glass cabinet.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖母把一件珍贵的古董放在玻璃柜里。

entries.meaning: 古，古老；古代；古人；古迹，古物
entries.example: The museum displays several objects from classical antiquity in this room.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆在这个房间里展出几件古典时期的古物。

entries.example: She cleaned the small wound with an antiseptic solution before bandaging it.
entries.exampleZh: 她用抗菌溶液清洗了小伤口，然后把它包扎好。

entries.example: The teacher asked us to find an antonym for the word happy.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们找出单词“快乐”的反义词。

entries.example: Her anxiety about the exam kept her awake for most of the night.
entries.exampleZh: 她对考试的焦虑让她一夜大部分时间都醒着。

entries.example: I am anxious to hear the results of the final test.
entries.exampleZh: 我急切地想听到期末考试的结果。

entries.meaning: 不论用何种方法；无论如何
entries.example: It was raining hard, but we went for a walk anyhow.
entries.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，但我们还是去散步了。

entries.example: Technology continues to develop apace, changing the way we work and live.
entries.exampleZh: 技术继续快速发展，改变着我们工作和生活的方式。

entries.meaning: 相间隔；分离；除去；分离的
entries.example: The two sisters live far apart but call each other every week.
entries.exampleZh: 两姐妹住得很远，但每周都互相打电话。

entries.example: A large ape watched us quietly from behind the thick glass.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大猿在厚玻璃后面安静地看着我们。

entries.example: He gave me an apologetic smile after arriving late for dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 他晚饭迟到后给了我一个表示歉意的微笑。

entries.meaning: 仪器；设备；器械，器具，仪器；机构，组织
entries.example: The laboratory has a complex apparatus for measuring air quality.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室里有一台测量空气质量的复杂仪器。

entries.meaning: 明显的，表面上的；显然的；表面上的
entries.example: It became apparent that nobody had remembered to bring the key.
entries.exampleZh: 很明显，没有人记得带钥匙。

entries.example: The train will apparently arrive about twenty minutes late this evening.
entries.exampleZh: 火车今晚显然会晚点大约二十分钟。

entries.meaning: 呼吁，上诉；吸引(力)；呼吁；起诉，上诉；吸引；上诉，申诉；呼吁；感染力，吸引力
entries.example: The charity launched an appeal to raise money for local families.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构发起了一项呼吁，为当地家庭筹款。

entries.meaning: 出现，显露，公开露面；出场，问世；仿佛，似乎
entries.example: A strange light seemed to appear above the quiet lake last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚，一道奇怪的光似乎出现在安静的湖面上方。

entries.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised all of us.
entries.exampleZh: 她突然出现在聚会上，让我们所有人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The detailed data is included in the appendix at the back.
entries.exampleZh: 详细数据包含在后面的附录中。

entries.example: The long walk gave the children a healthy appetite for dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间的散步让孩子们晚餐时胃口很好。

entries.meaning: 鼓掌欢迎；赞成；鼓掌，喝彩；称赞
entries.example: The audience began to applaud the young singer after her song.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻歌手唱完后，观众开始鼓掌。

entries.meaning: 用具，设备，装置；用具，器具
entries.example: This kitchen appliance makes it easier to prepare healthy meals quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 这种厨房电器让快速准备健康餐食变得更容易。

entries.example: Each applicant must submit the form before the end of May.
entries.exampleZh: 每位申请人都必须在五月底前提交表格。

entries.meaning: 请求，申请；应用，运用；施用，敷用
entries.example: Her application for the research job arrived after the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 她申请研究工作的材料在截止日期之后才到。

entries.meaning: 要求，申请；申请；应用，使用；涉及
entries.example: You should apply for the scholarship before the end of this month.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该在本月底之前申请这项奖学金。

entries.example: The board will appoint a new director at the next meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会将在下次会议上任命一位新主任。

entries.example: I have a dental appointment at three this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点有一个牙医预约。

entries.example: The manager will apportion the available funds among the three teams.
entries.exampleZh: 经理将把可用资金分配给三个团队。

entries.meaning: 估价，评价；鉴定；评估，评价
entries.example: The annual appraisal helps employees understand their strengths and weaknesses.
entries.exampleZh: 年度评估帮助员工了解自己的优势和不足。

entries.example: There was an appreciable drop in temperature after the storm passed.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，气温出现了明显的下降。

entries.meaning: 欣赏，感激；涨价；赏识，鉴赏；感激；涨价，增值
entries.example: I really appreciate your help with moving these heavy boxes.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常感激你帮我搬这些重箱子。

entries.example: She felt some apprehension before her first job interview.
entries.exampleZh: 第一次求职面试前，她感到有些忧虑。

entries.example: The young apprentice learned quickly by watching the experienced carpenter.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻学徒通过观察经验丰富的木匠很快就学会了。

entries.meaning: 接近，着手处理；接近；方法；途径；靠近，接近；来临；靠近，接近；方法，途径
entries.example: We need a new approach to solving this difficult problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个难题。

entries.meaning: 合适的；适当的[ə'prəuprieɪt]；占有，挪用；拨出
entries.example: Please wear appropriate clothes for the job interview tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 明天的求职面试请穿合适的衣服。

entries.meaning: 允许，赞同；批准；赞成，同意；正式批准
entries.example: The manager gave her final approval for the new project.
entries.exampleZh: 经理最终批准了这个新项目。

entries.example: My parents do not approve of my plan to travel alone.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母不赞成我一个人去旅行的计划。

entries.meaning: 近似的，约略的；接近，近似；近似的[ə'prɒksɪm3ɪt]；近似
entries.example: The approximate cost of the trip is two hundred dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的费用大约是两百美元。

entries.example: The journey takes approximately three hours by train.
entries.exampleZh: 坐火车这段旅程大约需要三个小时。

entries.meaning: 聪明的；合适的；易于的；易于…的；适宜的；敏捷的
entries.example: She is apt to forget her keys when she is in a hurry.
entries.exampleZh: 她匆忙时容易忘带钥匙。

entries.meaning: 才能；能力；天资，天赋，天生的才能
entries.example: He showed a natural aptitude for music at an early age.
entries.exampleZh: 他在很小的时候就表现出音乐方面的天赋。

entries.meaning: 水族馆；养鱼池；养鱼池；玻璃缸；水族馆
entries.example: We visited the aquarium and saw many colourful fish.
entries.exampleZh: 我们参观了水族馆，看到了许多色彩斑斓的鱼。

entries.example: Many aquatic plants grow well in this shallow pond.
entries.exampleZh: 许多水生植物在这个浅池塘里长得很好。

entries.example: The farmers grow wheat on the rich arable land.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们在肥沃的耕地上种小麦。

entries.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision without asking anyone.
entries.exampleZh: 老师没有征求任何人的意见就做了一个武断的决定。

entries.example: Monkeys are arboreal animals that live in tall trees.
entries.exampleZh: 猴子是栖息在树上的动物，生活在高大的树木中。

entries.example: The rainbow formed a perfect arc above the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 彩虹在山丘上方形成了一道完美的弧。

entries.example: We spent the afternoon playing games in the arcade.
entries.exampleZh: 我们下午在游戏厅里玩游戏。

entries.example: The old bridge has a stone arch in the middle.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥中间有一个石头拱。

entries.meaning: (语言、词汇等)古代的，已不通用的
entries.example: This archaic word rarely appears in modern English texts.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古旧的词在现代英语文本中很少出现。

entries.meaning: 建筑师；设计师；建筑师，设计师；创造者
entries.example: The architect designed a beautiful library for our town.
entries.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为我们镇设计了一座漂亮的图书馆。

entries.meaning: 建筑学；建筑设计，建筑风格；【计】 体系结构
entries.example: She studied architecture at a famous university in Europe.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一所欧洲的著名大学学习建筑学。

entries.example: They keep old newspapers in the archive room downstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 他们把旧报纸存放在楼下的档案室里。

entries.example: The archives contain letters written by the famous writer.
entries.exampleZh: 档案室里保存着那位著名作家写的信件。

entries.example: Few plants can survive the long, harsh arctic winter.
entries.exampleZh: 很少有植物能在漫长而严酷的北极冬季中存活。

entries.example: She is an ardent supporter of local environmental projects.
entries.exampleZh: 她是当地环保项目的热心支持者。

entries.example: Climbing the mountain proved an arduous task for the team.
entries.exampleZh: 攀登这座山对团队来说是一项艰巨的任务。

entries.example: The new arena can hold twenty thousand fans.
entries.exampleZh: 新竞技场能容纳两万名观众。

entries.example: They often argue about money at the dinner table.
entries.exampleZh: 他们常在餐桌上为钱争吵。

entries.meaning: 争吵，争论；观点，论据；说理，论证
entries.example: Their argument lasted for hours without any clear solution.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的争论持续了几个小时，却没有明确的解决办法。

entries.example: The aridity of the desert makes farming almost impossible.
entries.exampleZh: 沙漠的干旱使农耕几乎不可能。

entries.example: Problems often arise when people ignore simple safety rules.
entries.exampleZh: 当人们忽视简单的安全规则时，问题常常会出现。

entries.example: She solved the arithmetic problem faster than anyone expected.
entries.exampleZh: 她解那道算术题的速度比任何人预想的都快。

entries.example: The knight wore heavy armour into the battle.
entries.exampleZh: 那位骑士穿着沉重的盔甲上战场。

entries.example: The sudden arousal of public anger surprised the officials.
entries.exampleZh: 公众愤怒的突然激起让官员们感到意外。

entries.example: Loud noises can arouse fear in young children.
entries.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音会唤起幼儿的恐惧。

entries.example: Please arrange the chairs in a circle before the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 请在会前把椅子排成一个圆圈。

entries.example: The seating arrangement was changed at the last minute.
entries.exampleZh: 座位安排在最后一刻被更改了。

entries.example: The shop offers a wide array of fresh vegetables.
entries.exampleZh: 这家商店提供各种各样的新鲜蔬菜。

entries.example: His arrogance made it hard for colleagues to work with him.
entries.exampleZh: 他的傲慢让同事们很难与他共事。

entries.example: He sounded arrogant when he described his own achievements.
entries.exampleZh: 他描述自己的成就时听起来很傲慢。

entries.example: The museum displayed an ancient artefact found near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一件在河边发现的古代手工艺品。

entries.meaning: 动脉，干线；动脉；干线，要道
entries.example: The doctor warned him that a blocked artery is dangerous.
entries.exampleZh: 医生警告他，动脉堵塞很危险。

entries.example: Her arthritis makes it painful to open jars.
entries.exampleZh: 她的关节炎让她打开罐子时很疼。

entries.example: She wrote an article about the benefits of morning exercise.
entries.exampleZh: 她写了一篇关于晨练益处的文章。

entries.meaning: 发音清晰的；说话表达力强
entries.example: Good teachers articulate complex ideas in simple and memorable ways.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的老师能用简单易记的方式清晰表达复杂的观点。

entries.meaning: 人工的；娇揉造作的；人工的，人造的；假的，矫揉造作的；模拟的
entries.example: The park's artificial lake attracts many birds during winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 公园的人工湖在冬季吸引许多鸟类。

entries.example: The old fort still displays cannon and other artillery from the war.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧堡垒仍展示着战争时期的大炮和其他火炮。

entries.example: The team chose a quiet cafe, as opposed to the noisy place next door.
entries.exampleZh: 团队选择了安静的咖啡馆，而不是隔壁那家吵闹的。

entries.meaning: 登(山等)；上升；攀登；上升，升高
entries.example: The climbers slowly ascend the steep path before sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 登山者在日出前缓慢地登上陡峭的小路。

entries.example: The steep ascent to the temple left everyone breathless.
entries.exampleZh: 通往寺庙的陡峭上坡让每个人都气喘吁吁。

entries.meaning: 查明，探查；弄清，查明；确定
entries.example: Police are trying to ascertain the exact cause of the fire.
entries.exampleZh: 警方正试图查明这场火灾的确切原因。

entries.meaning: 归因于，把归于；把…归因于
entries.example: Some historians ascribe the victory to better planning and luck.
entries.exampleZh: 一些历史学家把这场胜利归因于更好的筹划和运气。

entries.example: The fireplace was cold, and only gray ash remained.
entries.exampleZh: 壁炉已经冷了，只剩下灰色的灰烬。

entries.example: He felt deeply ashamed after forgetting his mother's birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 他忘记母亲的生日后深感羞愧。

entries.meaning: 方面；朝向，方向；外貌，外观样子
entries.example: We discussed every aspect of the plan before making a decision.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在做决定之前讨论了计划的每个方面。

entries.meaning: 渴望；抱负；强烈的愿望；志向
entries.example: Her greatest aspiration is to become a doctor in rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 她最大的志向是在农村地区当一名医生。

entries.meaning: 渴望；向往，渴望，追求；有志于，有抱负
entries.example: Many young people aspire to work for international companies.
entries.exampleZh: 许多年轻人渴望在国际公司工作。

entries.example: The assassination shocked the nation and changed its history forever.
entries.exampleZh: 这起暗杀震惊了全国，并永远改变了它的历史。

entries.meaning: 袭击；攻击，袭击；侵犯人身罪；冲击；
entries.example: The soldiers launched a sudden assault on the enemy camp.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们对敌营发动了突然袭击。

entries.example: The students will assemble in the hall for the morning meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们将在礼堂集合参加晨会。

entries.meaning: 宣称；维护；断言，声称；坚持
entries.example: The report does not assert that the manager acted illegally.
entries.exampleZh: 报告并没有断言经理有违法行为。

entries.example: Teachers assess student progress through regular tests and class work.
entries.exampleZh: 老师通过定期测试和课堂作业评估学生的进步。

entries.meaning: 判定，评定；核定的付款额；看法，评价
entries.example: The final assessment will include a written report and an interview.
entries.exampleZh: 最终评估将包括一份书面报告和一次面试。

entries.example: Her greatest asset is patience when dealing with difficult customers.
entries.exampleZh: 她最大的优点是在应付难缠的顾客时有耐心。

entries.meaning: 分配；确定时间或地点；指派；指派，分配；指定
entries.example: The manager will assign each new task to a different team member.
entries.exampleZh: 经理会把每一项新任务分配给不同的团队成员。

entries.example: Our teacher gave us a difficult assignment about climate change.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一个关于气候变化的难题作业。

entries.example: Children often assimilate new languages faster than adults do.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们掌握新语言往往比成年人更快。

entries.meaning: 吸收；吸收和同化的过程
entries.example: The assimilation of new ideas takes time in any organization.
entries.exampleZh: 在任何组织中，新观念的吸收都需要时间。

entries.example: Two nurses will assist the doctor during the operation tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 明天手术时会有两名护士协助医生。

entries.example: She asked for assistance with her heavy luggage at the station.
entries.exampleZh: 她在车站请求帮忙搬她沉重的行李。

entries.example: He works as an assistant manager in a small hotel.
entries.exampleZh: 他在一家小旅馆担任助理经理。

entries.meaning: 半工半读助学金，研究生助教奖学金
entries.example: She received a teaching assistantship that covers her tuition and housing.
entries.exampleZh: 她获得了一份助教奖学金，涵盖她的学费和住宿费。

entries.meaning: 伙伴，同事，同伴；使联合；使有联系；交往；副的；联合的，合伙的；伙伴；同事
entries.example: My associate will handle the client meeting while I travel.
entries.exampleZh: 我出差期间，我的同事会负责客户会议。

entries.example: The local football association organizes matches for young players every summer.
entries.exampleZh: 当地足球协会每年夏天都为年轻球员组织比赛。

entries.example: The box contained assorted chocolates and small bags of nuts.
entries.exampleZh: 盒子里装着各式各样的巧克力和小袋坚果。

entries.meaning: 假定；承担；使用；假定，设想；承担，就
entries.example: I assume the train will arrive on time today.
entries.exampleZh: 我猜今天的火车会准点到达。

entries.meaning: 假定之事；承担，担任；假定，假设；担任，承担
entries.example: Your assumption about the cost may be wrong, so check carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 你对费用的假设可能是错的，所以要仔细核对。

entries.meaning: 自信；承诺；保险；信心；保证；保险
entries.example: He gave me his assurance that the report would be ready.
entries.exampleZh: 他向我保证报告会准备好。

entries.meaning: 断言，使确信；保(人寿)险；使确信，使确保；保证，向…保证
entries.example: I assure you that the package will arrive before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我向你保证包裹会在周五之前送到。

entries.example: Her asthma gets worse during cold weather and dusty days.
entries.exampleZh: 在寒冷天气和扬尘的日子里，她的哮喘会加重。

entries.example: The magician's final trick will astonish even the oldest children.
entries.exampleZh: 魔术师的最后一个戏法甚至会让最大的孩子也惊叹不已。

entries.example: Such generous gifts always astound the local charity workers.
entries.exampleZh: 如此慷慨的礼物总是让当地慈善机构的工作人员大为震惊。

entries.example: One wrong turn led the hikers astray in the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 一个错误的转弯让徒步者在森林里迷了路。

entries.example: Many people read their horoscopes online, but astrology is not a real science.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人上网查看星座运势，但占星学并不是真正的科学。

entries.example: The astronaut floated slowly through the space station and waved at the camera.
entries.exampleZh: 宇航员在空间站里慢慢飘过，并向镜头挥手。

entries.example: She studies astronomy at university and often observes the stars at night.
entries.exampleZh: 她在大学学习天文学，并且经常在夜里观测星星。

entries.example: The family asked for asylum after fleeing their country during the war.
entries.exampleZh: 战争期间逃离自己的国家后，这家人申请了避难。

entries.example: The slight asymmetry of the painting gives it a strange, natural beauty.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画轻微的不对称赋予了它一种奇特而自然的美。

entries.example: The young athlete trained hard every morning before school started.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员每天早上上学前都刻苦训练。

entries.example: He opened the old atlas to find the small island.
entries.exampleZh: 他打开那本旧地图册，想找到那座小岛。

entries.example: The atmosphere in the room became tense after the manager spoke.
entries.exampleZh: 经理讲话之后，房间里的气氛变得紧张起来。

entries.meaning: 大气的，空气的；大气层的；大气所引起的
entries.example: Scientists measured atmospheric pressure before the storm reached the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨抵达海岸之前，科学家测量了大气压。

entries.example: The museum explains how atomic energy changed the modern world.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆讲解了原子能如何改变了现代世界。

entries.meaning: 系上；附上；依恋；认为；系，贴；认为有重要性；使附属，附加
entries.example: Please attach the signed form to your email before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把签好的表格附在你的邮件里。

entries.meaning: 攻击；非难；疾病发作；进攻；抨击；突然发作
entries.example: The sudden attack of flu kept her in bed for three days.
entries.exampleZh: 流感的突然发作让她卧床三天。

entries.meaning: 取得，得到；达到；获得；完成
entries.example: With steady practice, you can attain a high level of fluency.
entries.exampleZh: 通过持续的练习，你可以达到很高的流利程度。

entries.meaning: 可获得的，可达到的，可实现的
entries.example: Her goal of running a marathon seems attainable with proper training.
entries.exampleZh: 只要训练得当，她跑完马拉松的目标似乎是可以实现的。

entries.meaning: 尝试，企图；尝试，试图；努力
entries.example: He made one last attempt to fix the broken machine.
entries.exampleZh: 他做了最后一次尝试，想修好那台坏掉的机器。

entries.meaning: 专心；照顾；出席，参加；随同，陪同；专心，注意
entries.example: All students must attend the safety meeting on Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 所有学生都必须参加周一上午的安全会议。

entries.meaning: 到场；出席人数；到场，出席；出勤；伺候，照料
entries.example: Attendance at the evening lecture was lower than the teacher expected.
entries.exampleZh: 晚间讲座的出席人数比老师预期的要少。

entries.example: The flight attendant smiled and handed me a warm blanket.
entries.exampleZh: 空乘人员微笑着递给我一条温暖的毯子。

entries.example: Please pay close attention to the instructions on the first page.
entries.exampleZh: 请注意第一页上的说明。

entries.meaning: 注意的，专心的；关心的，体贴的；留意的
entries.example: The attentive nurse checked on every patient twice during the night.
entries.exampleZh: 那位细心的护士夜里查看了每位病人两次。

entries.example: Her positive attitude helped the whole team finish the difficult project on time.
entries.exampleZh: 她积极的态度帮助整个团队按时完成了这个困难的项目。

entries.example: The attorney explained the contract clearly before we signed the final papers.
entries.exampleZh: 律师在我们签署最终文件之前清楚地解释了合同。

entries.example: Bright colors often attract the attention of young children in stores.
entries.exampleZh: 明亮的颜色常常在商店里吸引幼儿的注意。

entries.meaning: 爱慕，吸引；吸引力；具有吸引力的事
entries.example: The main attraction of this small town is its quiet beach.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小镇的主要吸引力是它安静的海滩。

entries.meaning: 有吸引力的，讨人喜欢的；吸引的，有吸引力的；引起注意的
entries.example: She wore an attractive dress to the party last Saturday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 上周六晚上她穿了一条漂亮的连衣裙去参加聚会。

entries.meaning: 归因于；属性；象征；标志；把…归于['ætrIbjʊːt]；属性；品质
entries.example: We should not attribute the delay to bad weather alone.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不应该把延误仅仅归因于恶劣天气。

entries.example: They plan to hold an auction for the old furniture next month.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月为旧家具举行一场拍卖。

entries.meaning: 大胆的；有冒险精神的；鲁莽的；厚颜无耻的
entries.example: Her audacious plan surprised even the most experienced members of the group.
entries.exampleZh: 她大胆的计划甚至让小组里最有经验的成员都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The speaker's voice was barely audible at the back of the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 演讲者的声音在礼堂后面几乎听不见。

entries.example: The audience clapped loudly when the singer returned to the stage.
entries.exampleZh: 当歌手回到舞台时，观众热烈鼓掌。

entries.example: The audio quality on this old recording is still surprisingly clear.
entries.exampleZh: 这段旧录音的音质仍然出奇地清晰。

entries.meaning: 审计；查账；审计，查账；旁听；审计，查账
entries.example: The company ordered an independent audit after the financial reports were published.
entries.exampleZh: 财务报告公布后，公司下令进行独立审计。

entries.meaning: 试听；试演；面试；试演；试听，试音
entries.example: She prepared a short song for her first audition at the theatre.
entries.exampleZh: 她为在剧院的第一次试演准备了一首短歌。

entries.example: The school auditorium was filled with parents before the concert began.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会开始前，学校礼堂里坐满了家长。

entries.meaning: 增大，增加；增加，提高，扩大
entries.example: They decided to augment the team with two experienced engineers this spring.
entries.exampleZh: 他们决定今年春天用两名有经验的工程师来增强团队。

entries.meaning: 国外来的(姑娘)帮助料理家务换取住宿的
entries.example: They invited an aupair girl to live with them and help at home.
entries.exampleZh: 他们邀请一名换宿女孩和他们同住并帮忙做家务。

entries.meaning: 真实的，可靠的；真品的，真迹的；真正的，真实的，逼真的
entries.example: The museum displayed an authentic letter written by the famous scientist.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一封那位著名科学家写的真实信件。

entries.example: The bank will authenticate your signature before releasing the funds.
entries.exampleZh: 银行会在放款前验证你的签名。

entries.example: The manager must authorise every payment above a certain amount.
entries.exampleZh: 经理必须批准每一笔超过一定金额的付款。

entries.meaning: 有权威的；命令的；可靠的
entries.example: The guide gave an authoritative account of the city's long history.
entries.exampleZh: 导游对这个城市的悠久历史作了权威的讲述。

entries.meaning: 威信；当局；权威；权力；权力，管辖权；
entries.example: The local authority approved the new safety rules last week.
entries.exampleZh: 地方当局上周批准了新的安全规定。

entries.example: The manager will authorize the payment after checking every receipt.
entries.exampleZh: 经理会在核对每张收据后授权支付这笔款项。

entries.example: She published her autobiography after retiring from the national team.
entries.exampleZh: 她从国家队退役后出版了自己的自传。

entries.example: The autocratic leader ignored advice from his most experienced advisers.
entries.exampleZh: 这位独裁领导人无视最有经验的顾问们的建议。

entries.example: Her autoimmune condition requires careful monitoring by a specialist.
entries.exampleZh: 她的自身免疫性疾病需要专科医生仔细监测。

entries.meaning: 自动的，无意识的；小型自动武器
entries.example: The doors have an automatic lock that closes at midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 这些门有一个午夜关闭的自动锁。

entries.example: The lights turn on automatically when the room becomes dark.
entries.exampleZh: 房间变暗时，灯会自动亮起。

entries.example: Factory automation has replaced many repetitive tasks in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来，工厂自动化取代了许多重复性工作。

entries.example: The automobile industry is investing heavily in electric models this decade.
entries.exampleZh: 汽车行业这十年正在大力投资电动车型。

entries.meaning: 自治，自治权；自治，自治权；人身自由，自主权
entries.example: The region was granted greater autonomy after years of peaceful talks.
entries.exampleZh: 经过多年和平谈判，该地区获得了更大的自治权。

entries.example: The hospital uses an auxiliary generator during sudden power cuts.
entries.exampleZh: 医院在突然停电时使用辅助发电机。

entries.meaning: 有益于，有用；用处，利益；有帮助，有益，
entries.example: His advice was of little avail during the crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 在危机期间，他的建议几乎没什么用。

entries.meaning: 可利用性，可得性；利用的可能性；可利用的人或物
entries.example: The availability of clean water remains a serious problem in many areas.
entries.exampleZh: 清洁水的可获得性在许多地区仍是一个严重问题。

entries.meaning: 可获得的，可用的；可获得的，可得到的；可用的；有空的
entries.example: Tickets are available at the front desk until Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 门票可在周五下午之前在前台领取。

entries.example: A sudden avalanche blocked the mountain road for several hours.
entries.exampleZh: 一场突如其来的雪崩把山路堵了好几个小时。

entries.example: He vowed to avenge his brother after the shocking attack.
entries.exampleZh: 在那次令人震惊的袭击之后，他发誓要为弟弟报仇。

entries.example: They walked down a quiet avenue lined with old trees.
entries.exampleZh: 他们沿着一条两旁种着老树的安静大街走着。

entries.meaning: 平均的；平常的，普通的；平均达到；平均为；平均
entries.example: The average score in our class rose by five points.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班的平均分提高了五分。

entries.example: Quick action helped avert a serious accident on the busy road.
entries.exampleZh: 迅速的行动帮助避免了繁忙道路上的一场严重事故。

entries.meaning: 航空(学)；航空，飞行；航空制造业
entries.example: Modern aviation depends on strict safety rules and skilled engineers.
entries.exampleZh: 现代航空依赖于严格的安全规则和熟练的工程师。

entries.example: We left early to avoid the heavy evening traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 我们早早离开，以避开傍晚的拥堵车流。

entries.example: She received an award for her outstanding community work.
entries.exampleZh: 她因出色的社区工作而获得了一个奖项。

entries.meaning: 知道的，意识的；知道的；意识到的
entries.example: Are you fully aware of the new safety rules in this building?
entries.exampleZh: 你完全了解这栋楼里新的安全规定吗？

entries.meaning: 可怕的；糟糕的；极度的；糟糕的
entries.example: The weather was awful during our entire holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们整个假期期间天气都很糟糕。

entries.meaning: 难使用的，笨拙的；尴尬的
entries.example: He felt awkward at the party and left early.
entries.exampleZh: 他在聚会上感到很不自在，于是提前离开了。

entries.example: The earth rotates around its axis once a day.
entries.exampleZh: 地球每天绕地轴自转一周。

entries.example: The mechanic replaced the broken axle on our old truck.
entries.exampleZh: 修理工换掉了我们旧卡车上坏掉的车轴。

entries.example: My uncle has remained a bachelor despite many invitations to marry.
entries.exampleZh: 我的叔叔尽管多次有人提亲，至今仍是单身。

entries.example: Her honesty formed the backbone of the whole project.
entries.exampleZh: 她的诚实是整个项目的支柱。

entries.meaning: 背景；经历；后台；不重要或不引人注目的地方
entries.example: The painting shows a quiet village in the background.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了背景中一个宁静的村庄。

entries.example: The doctor prescribed medicine for a bacterial infection in her throat.
entries.exampleZh: 医生为她喉部的细菌感染开了药。

entries.example: Every visitor must wear a badge inside the building.
entries.exampleZh: 每位访客在大楼内都必须佩戴徽章。

entries.example: We usually play badminton together every Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们通常每周六早上一起打羽毛球。

entries.example: The complicated instructions completely baffle most new users.
entries.exampleZh: 这些复杂的说明把大多数新用户完全难住了。

entries.example: She finds it hard to balance work and family life.
entries.exampleZh: 她觉得很难兼顾工作和家庭生活。

entries.example: We drank coffee on the balcony and watched the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在阳台上喝咖啡，看着日落。

entries.example: The panda sat quietly and chewed fresh bamboo.
entries.exampleZh: 熊猫安静地坐着，嚼着新鲜的竹子。

entries.meaning: 乐队；群，伙；带，箍；条纹；波段，频带；用带绑扎
entries.example: The band played three new songs at the concert.
entries.exampleZh: 这支乐队在音乐会上演奏了三首新歌。

entries.example: The struggling company went bankrupt after years of poor sales.
entries.exampleZh: 这家经营困难的公司连年销售不佳，最终破产了。

entries.example: The bankruptcy forced the family to sell their house.
entries.exampleZh: 破产迫使这家人卖掉了他们的房子。

entries.example: The students hung a bright banner across the school gate.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们在学校大门上方挂起了一条鲜艳的横幅。

entries.meaning: 酒吧；栅栏；棒，条状物；闩；阻拦
entries.example: We met at a quiet bar near the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在火车站附近一家安静的酒吧见了面。

entries.meaning: 野蛮的，粗鲁的；残暴的，残忍的；原始部落的
entries.example: The ruler's barbaric treatment of prisoners shocked the entire world.
entries.exampleZh: 统治者对囚犯的野蛮对待震惊了整个世界。

entries.example: We planned a backyard barbecue for Saturday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划在周六下午举行一场后院烧烤野餐。

entries.example: His bare feet left marks on the dusty floor.
entries.exampleZh: 他赤裸的双脚在满是灰尘的地板上留下了印记。

entries.meaning: 仅仅，几乎不；赤裸裸地，无遮蔽地
entries.example: She could barely hear the speaker at the back.
entries.exampleZh: 她几乎听不见后面那位演讲者的声音。

entries.meaning: 讨价还价；协议；交易；便宜货
entries.example: She found a real bargain at the local market.
entries.exampleZh: 她在当地市场淘到了一件真正的便宜货。

entries.example: A heavy barge moved slowly along the narrow canal.
entries.exampleZh: 一艘沉重的驳船沿着狭窄的运河缓缓移动。

entries.example: The dog began to bark loudly at the mail carrier.
entries.exampleZh: 那只狗开始对着邮递员大声吠叫。

entries.example: The old baron owned a large castle by the river.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年老的男爵在河边拥有一座大城堡。

entries.example: The soldiers survived a long barrage of enemy fire.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们挺过了一场长时间的敌方火力网。

entries.example: The workers rolled a heavy barrel into the storage room.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们把一个沉重的桶滚进了储藏室。

entries.meaning: 贫瘠的，荒芜的；不结果实的，不育的；无益的，无效果的
entries.example: Nothing could grow on the barren land after the fire.
entries.exampleZh: 大火之后，这片贫瘠的土地上什么也长不出来。

entries.meaning: 栅栏；关卡，检票口；障碍，隔阂；屏障
entries.example: A metal barrier blocked the entrance to the construction site.
entries.exampleZh: 一道金属屏障挡住了建筑工地的入口。

entries.example: We meet on a weekly basis to discuss our progress.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每周聚一次讨论进展情况。

entries.meaning: 一批，一组，一群；一批生产量
entries.example: The bakery sold a fresh batch of bread this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这家面包店今天早上卖出了一批新鲜面包。

entries.example: My phone battery died during the long train ride.
entries.exampleZh: 我的手机电池在漫长的火车旅途中没电了。

entries.example: Several fishing boats returned to the calm bay at sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 日落时几艘渔船回到了平静的海湾。

entries.example: You must be careful when you cross this busy road.
entries.exampleZh: 你过这条繁忙的马路时必须小心。

entries.example: A single glass bead fell from her broken necklace.
entries.exampleZh: 一颗玻璃珠从她断了的项链上掉了下来。

entries.meaning: 面露喜色；发射电波，播送；束；梁；笑容，喜色
entries.example: A warm beam spread across her face as she welcomed the guests.
entries.exampleZh: 她迎接客人时，脸上露出温暖的笑容。

entries.example: The beehive in our garden is full of busy insects.
entries.exampleZh: 我们花园里的蜂箱里满是忙碌的昆虫。

entries.example: Please let me know beforehand if you cannot attend the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你不能参加会议，请事先告诉我。

entries.example: His begrimed hands showed he had worked all day in the field.
entries.exampleZh: 他污秽的双手表明他在田里干了一整天活。

entries.meaning: 对…感到不满；嫉妒；勉强做，不乐意地做
entries.example: I do not begrudge her the success she has earned.
entries.exampleZh: 我不嫉妒她所赢得的成功。

entries.example: She spoke on behalf of the students at the school meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她在学校会议上代表学生发言。

entries.meaning: 表现；运转；起作用；表现得体；使检点
entries.example: The children were told to behave well during the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们被告知在长途旅行中要好好表现。

entries.example: Her belief in hard work helped her through difficult times.
entries.exampleZh: 她对努力工作的信念帮助她度过了困难时期。

entries.example: He tightened his belt before climbing the steep hill.
entries.exampleZh: 他在爬陡峭的山坡前系紧了腰带。

entries.example: A small river flows beneath the old stone bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 一条小河流过那座古老的石桥下方。

entries.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both body and mind.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对身心都有益。

entries.example: The new library will benefit everyone who loves reading.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆将使每个热爱阅读的人受益。

entries.example: The benevolent old man often helped his poorer neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 那位仁慈的老人经常帮助比他贫穷的邻居。

entries.meaning: 被弄弯的，弯曲的；爱好，天赋
entries.example: The old key was bent but still opened the door.
entries.exampleZh: 那把旧钥匙弯了，但仍然能打开门。

entries.example: Nothing can bereave him of his happy memories.
entries.exampleZh: 没有什么能使他失去快乐的回忆。

entries.example: The hotel is cheap and besides it is close to the station.
entries.exampleZh: 这家旅馆很便宜，而且离车站很近。

entries.example: He placed a small bet on the final horse race.
entries.exampleZh: 他在最后一场赛马中下了小注。

entries.meaning: 出卖，泄露；辜负；流露情感
entries.example: I will never betray the trust you have placed in me.
entries.exampleZh: 我永远不会背叛你对我的信任。

entries.example: The waiter brought a cold beverage to our table.
entries.exampleZh: 服务员给我们桌上送来了一杯冷饮。

entries.example: Please beware of slippery steps when walking in the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 下雨天走路时请小心湿滑的台阶。

entries.example: The complicated instructions completely bewilder most of the new employees.
entries.exampleZh: 这些复杂的说明完全使大多数新员工感到困惑。

entries.meaning: 在…较远的一边；超出，除…之外
entries.example: The small village lies beyond those hills, about ten miles away.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小村庄在那片山丘的另一边，大约十英里远。

entries.example: The report seemed biased against the smaller companies in the region.
entries.exampleZh: 这篇报道似乎对该地区较小的公司有偏见。

entries.example: Please add a complete bibliography to the end of your essay.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你的论文末尾附上一份完整的参考书目。

entries.example: Our company made a strong bid for the new airport contract.
entries.exampleZh: 我们公司为这个新机场合同提出了有力的投标。

entries.example: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement on trade last week.
entries.exampleZh: 两国上周签署了一项双边贸易协定。

entries.example: Our school offers a bilingual program for students who speak two languages.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校为会说两种语言的学生提供双语课程。

entries.example: Please throw those old newspapers into the bin near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把那些旧报纸扔进门旁的垃圾桶里。

entries.example: These strong ropes will bind the boxes together during the move.
entries.exampleZh: 这些结实的绳子会在搬家时把箱子捆在一起。

entries.example: He watched the birds through a pair of old binoculars.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一副旧双筒望远镜观察那些鸟。

entries.example: The rainforest is famous for its rich biodiversity and rare plants.
entries.exampleZh: 这片雨林以其丰富的生物多样性和稀有植物而闻名。

entries.example: She wrote a detailed biography of the famous scientist last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年她写了一部关于那位著名科学家的详细传记。

entries.meaning: 生物的；生物学的，有关生物学的
entries.example: The scientists studied the biological effects of the new chemical.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们研究了这种新化学品的生物影响。

entries.example: Many modern phones use biometrics to keep your data safe.
entries.exampleZh: 许多现代手机使用生物测定技术来保护你的数据安全。

entries.example: We had a lovely dinner at a small bistro near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在河边一家小餐馆吃了一顿愉快的晚餐。

entries.example: I am feeling a bit tired after the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后我觉得有点儿累。

entries.example: The film tells a bizarre story about talking animals and ghosts.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于会说话的动物和鬼魂的怪诞故事。

entries.example: Be careful with that sharp blade when you cut the bread.
entries.exampleZh: 切面包的时候要小心那把锋利的刀片。

entries.example: Do not blame the driver for the delay caused by snow.
entries.exampleZh: 不要因为下雪造成的延误而责怪司机。

entries.example: He stared at the blank page for an hour without writing anything.
entries.exampleZh: 他盯着空白的纸看了一个小时，什么也没写。

entries.example: She wrapped the sleeping child in a warm wool blanket.
entries.exampleZh: 她把熟睡的孩子裹在一条温暖的羊毛毯里。

entries.example: The blast broke every window in the old factory.
entries.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了那座旧工厂的所有窗户。

entries.meaning: 熊熊燃烧；发光；迸发；火焰
entries.example: Firefighters worked all night to control the blaze.
entries.exampleZh: 消防员整夜奋战以控制那场大火。

entries.meaning: 寒冷的，阴沉的；阴郁的，暗淡的；没有希望的，不乐观的；荒凉的；索然无味的
entries.example: The future looked bleak for the small fishing village.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小渔村的未来看起来一片黯淡。

entries.meaning: 混合，混杂；混合物；混合，交融
entries.example: This tea is a blend of three different leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 这种茶是三种不同叶子的混合。

entries.meaning: 一排房屋，街区；阻塞；大块木料；阻塞，拦阻；封锁
entries.example: He walked around the block twice before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭前他绕着街区走了两圈。

entries.meaning: 白肤金发碧眼的；白肤金发碧眼的女人
entries.example: The blonde woman ordered coffee at the corner cafe.
entries.exampleZh: 那位金发女子在街角的咖啡馆点了咖啡。

entries.example: The roses in our garden bloom every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 我们花园里的玫瑰每年春天都开花。

entries.example: The architect showed us a blueprint of the new library.
entries.exampleZh: 建筑师给我们看了新图书馆的蓝图。

entries.meaning: 钝的；率直的；把…弄钝；使减弱
entries.example: A blunt knife is dangerous in the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 钝刀在厨房里很危险。

entries.example: The board will meet on Friday to discuss budgets.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会将于周五开会讨论预算。

entries.example: His boast about winning annoyed everyone at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 他关于获胜的自夸让聚会上的每个人都很烦。

entries.meaning: 粗体的；大胆的，鲁莽的，勇敢的；醒目的
entries.example: She made a bold decision to change her career.
entries.exampleZh: 她做出了一个大胆的决定，要改变自己的职业。

entries.example: New evidence helped bolster his argument during the debate.
entries.exampleZh: 新证据有助于在辩论中支持他的论点。

entries.example: Every employee received a small bonus at year's end.
entries.exampleZh: 每位员工在年底都收到了一小笔奖金。

entries.example: The museum gives visitors a free booklet about its history.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆向参观者赠送一本介绍其历史的小册子。

entries.example: He placed the heavy dictionary on a wooden bookrest.
entries.exampleZh: 他把那本沉重的词典放在一个木制阅书架上。

entries.example: The city's booming economy attracts workers from everywhere.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市迅速发展的经济吸引着来自各地的工人。

entries.meaning: 使增长，使兴旺；鼓励，促进；为…作宣传，宣扬；增加，提高；帮助，激励
entries.example: The new policy may boost sales during the holiday season.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策可能会在假日季促进销售。

entries.example: He cleaned the mud off his left boot.
entries.exampleZh: 他擦掉了左脚靴子上的泥。

entries.meaning: 小房间；公用电话亭；售货棚
entries.example: She waited inside the phone booth until the rain finally stopped.
entries.exampleZh: 她在电话亭里等到雨终于停了。

entries.meaning: 与…接壤；接近，毗邻；边缘；边界
entries.example: The small town lies right on the border between the two countries.
entries.exampleZh: 这座小镇正好位于两国之间的边界上。

entries.meaning: 使厌烦；钻孔；令人讨厌的人
entries.example: His long speech began to bore most of the audience.
entries.exampleZh: 他冗长的讲话开始让大多数听众感到厌烦。

entries.meaning: 打扰，烦扰；烦恼，操心；麻烦，烦扰
entries.example: Please do not bother your sister while she is studying.
entries.exampleZh: 你姐姐学习时请别打扰她。

entries.example: A huge boulder blocked the narrow path through the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 一块大石头挡住了穿过森林的狭窄小路。

entries.meaning: 弹起，反弹；上下晃动；弹跳；反弹力；活力，精力
entries.example: The ball will bounce twice before it rolls under the car.
entries.exampleZh: 球会弹跳两次，然后滚到车底下。

entries.example: The bouncing baby boy smiled at everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 那个健壮的男婴对房间里的每个人微笑。

entries.meaning: 负有义务的；一定的，必然的
entries.example: With such talent, she is bound to succeed in this field.
entries.exampleZh: 有如此天赋，她一定会在这个领域取得成功。

entries.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two villages.
entries.exampleZh: 这条河构成两个村庄之间的天然分界线。

entries.example: The performer gave a deep bow after the final song.
entries.exampleZh: 表演者在最后一首歌结束后深深鞠了一躬。

entries.example: A small bird landed on the highest branch of the tree.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小鸟落在树最高的树枝上。

entries.meaning: 商标；品牌；铭刻，打烙印于；丑化
entries.example: This brand of coffee is popular among young office workers.
entries.exampleZh: 这个品牌的咖啡在年轻上班族中很受欢迎。

entries.example: The old door handle was made of polished brass.
entries.exampleZh: 那个旧门把手是用抛光黄铜制成的。

entries.meaning: 黄铜制的，黄铜色的；厚颜无耻的
entries.example: He told a brazen lie to avoid taking responsibility.
entries.exampleZh: 他撒了一个厚颜无耻的谎来逃避责任。

entries.meaning: 垮台，倒塌，破裂；衰竭，衰弱；损坏，故障；分类
entries.example: The breakdown of the old machine caused a long delay.
entries.exampleZh: 那台旧机器的故障造成了长时间的延误。

entries.example: Scientists announced a major breakthrough in the treatment of this disease.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家宣布在这种疾病的治疗上取得了重大突破。

entries.example: The stone breakwater protects the harbor from strong winter storms.
entries.exampleZh: 石砌的防浪堤保护港口免受冬季强风暴的侵袭。

entries.meaning: 饲养，养殖，繁殖；养育，培育；酿成，招致；种，品种
entries.example: Farmers here breed sheep for wool and high-quality meat.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的农民养羊以获取羊毛和优质羊肉。

entries.example: A cool breeze came through the open window this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，一阵凉风从开着的窗户吹进来。

entries.example: My father likes to brew fresh tea after dinner every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢每天晚饭后泡一壶新茶。

entries.meaning: 短时间的，短暂的；简短的，
entries.example: We had a brief meeting before lunch in the office.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在办公室午餐前开了个简短的会议。

entries.example: He carried a leather briefcase to the important meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他带着一个皮公文包去参加重要会议。

entries.example: She briefly explained the rules before the game started.
entries.exampleZh: 她在比赛开始前简要地解释了规则。

entries.meaning: 光辉灿烂的；卓越的，有才华的
entries.example: That brilliant student solved the difficult problem in minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 那个才华横溢的学生几分钟就解决了这个难题。

entries.meaning: 易碎的，易损坏的；靠不住的；冷淡的，不友好的；尖利的
entries.example: Old plastic becomes brittle and breaks easily in cold weather.
entries.exampleZh: 旧塑料会变脆，在寒冷的天气里容易断裂。

entries.example: The travel agency gave us a colorful brochure about local sights.
entries.exampleZh: 旅行社给了我们一本关于当地景点的彩色小册子。

entries.example: My doctor said acute bronchitis requires rest and plenty of fluids.
entries.exampleZh: 我的医生说急性支气管炎需要休息和大量饮水。

entries.example: The hen will brood her eggs until they hatch.
entries.exampleZh: 母鸡会孵蛋直到它们孵化。

entries.example: She used a broom to sweep the kitchen floor clean.
entries.exampleZh: 她用扫帚把厨房地板扫干净了。

entries.meaning: 吃嫩叶或草；浏览；嫩叶，嫩芽；吃草；浏览
entries.example: I like to browse the bookstore for new novels on weekends.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢在周末浏览书店寻找新小说。

entries.example: The small town bore the brunt of the powerful storm last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚这个小城镇承受了强风暴的冲击。

entries.meaning: 野兽般的，残忍的；无情的，冷酷的
entries.example: The brutal winter killed many animals in the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 严酷的冬天杀死了森林里的许多动物。

entries.meaning: 冒泡，起泡；发出冒泡的声音；泡，泡沫；气泡；幻想的计划
entries.example: A soap bubble floated gently through the warm summer air.
entries.exampleZh: 一个肥皂泡在温暖的夏日空气中轻轻飘浮。

entries.example: Please fill that bucket with clean water from the well.
entries.exampleZh: 请把那个水桶装满干净的井水。

entries.meaning: 扣紧；变形；弯曲；皮带扣环
entries.example: He tried to buckle his seat belt before driving.
entries.exampleZh: 他开车前试图扣紧安全带。

entries.example: A tiny green bud appeared on the tree this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上树上出现了一个小小的绿芽。

entries.example: We must keep the project within our monthly budget.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须让项目保持在每月预算之内。

entries.example: A wild buffalo drank from the river at sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 一头野牛在日落时在河边饮水。

entries.example: The light bulb burned out, so we bought a new one.
entries.exampleZh: 灯泡烧坏了，所以我们买了一个新的。

entries.example: His pockets began to bulge with all the candy he collected.
entries.exampleZh: 他的口袋因为收集的糖果开始鼓起来。

entries.example: The bulk of the work is already finished.
entries.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成了。

entries.example: A stray bullet broke the window during the night.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里一颗流弹打破了窗户。

entries.meaning: 新闻简报；公告；学报；期刊
entries.example: The school posts a weekly bulletin outside the main office.
entries.exampleZh: 学校在主办公室外张贴每周公告。

entries.meaning: 恃强凌弱者；恐吓；胁迫，欺负
entries.example: That older boy often tries to bully younger students.
entries.exampleZh: 那个较大的男孩经常试图欺负年纪较小的学生。

entries.meaning: 碰，撞；颠簸着前进；碰撞；隆起物
entries.example: Be careful not to bump your head on the low door.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别把头撞到低矮的门上。

entries.meaning: 集中，挤在一起；使成一束；群，伙；束，串，捆
entries.example: She gave me a bunch of fresh flowers this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上她给了我一束鲜花。

entries.example: They rented a small bungalow near the beach for summer.
entries.exampleZh: 他们夏天在海滩附近租了一间小平房。

entries.example: The travel bureau can help you book a cheap flight.
entries.exampleZh: 旅行社可以帮你预订便宜的航班。

entries.example: Too much bureaucracy slows down even simple decisions at city hall.
entries.exampleZh: 过多的官僚程序使市政厅连简单的决定都变慢了。

entries.example: Online sales began to burgeon after the company improved its website.
entries.exampleZh: 公司改进网站后，网上销售开始迅速发展。

entries.example: A burglar entered the house through an unlocked back window.
entries.exampleZh: 一名窃贼从没锁的后窗进入了房子。

entries.example: Rabbits dig a deep burrow under the old oak tree.
entries.exampleZh: 兔子在老橡树下挖了一个深洞。

entries.meaning: 爆炸；突然发作；破裂；爆炸
entries.example: A sudden burst of thunder woke the sleeping children.
entries.exampleZh: 突然一声雷响惊醒了睡着的孩子们。

entries.example: They decided to bury the old dog near the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他们决定把老狗埋在花园附近。

entries.example: We took a bypass to avoid the heavy traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走了一条旁道以避开拥堵的交通。

entries.example: The workers laid a new cable under the busy street.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在繁忙的街道下铺设了一条新电缆。

entries.example: Students usually eat lunch in the school cafeteria at noon.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们中午通常在学校自助食堂吃午饭。

entries.example: Milk and cheese are good sources of calcium for growing children.
entries.exampleZh: 牛奶和奶酪是成长中儿童良好的钙来源。

entries.meaning: 计算，推算；估计，推测；计划，打算
entries.example: We need to calculate the total cost before booking the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在预订大厅之前计算总费用。

entries.example: I marked the exam dates on my new wall calendar.
entries.exampleZh: 我把考试日期标记在了新挂历上。

entries.example: The young calf stayed close to its mother in the field.
entries.exampleZh: 那头小牛犊在田野里紧挨着它的母亲。

entries.example: Engineers calibrate the machine before every important test.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在每次重要测试前都会校准这台机器。

entries.example: The team admired her calibre as a leader and problem solver.
entries.exampleZh: 团队钦佩她作为领导者和问题解决者的才干。

entries.meaning: 镇静的；平静的；平静；镇静
entries.example: Her calm voice helped the frightened child feel safe again.
entries.exampleZh: 她平静的声音让受惊的孩子再次感到安全。

entries.example: This drink has only one calorie per bottle, according to the label.
entries.exampleZh: 根据标签，这瓶饮料每瓶仅含一卡路里。

entries.example: The tired camel carried our bags across the hot desert.
entries.exampleZh: 疲惫的骆驼驮着我们的行李穿过炎热的沙漠。

entries.example: The historian studied cameral records from the royal treasury.
entries.exampleZh: 历史学家研究了来自皇家国库的宫廷档案。

entries.example: The soldiers used branches and leaves as camouflage near the camp.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在营地附近用树枝和树叶作伪装。

entries.example: They plan to campaign for cleaner air in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划为城市更清洁的空气而开展活动。

entries.example: Every camper must clean the shared kitchen before leaving.
entries.exampleZh: 每位露营者离开前必须清理共用厨房。

entries.example: We sang songs around the campfire until the stars appeared.
entries.exampleZh: 我们围着营火唱歌，直到星星出现。

entries.example: Students often meet friends on the main campus after class.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们下课后经常在主校园里见朋友。

entries.meaning: 取消，废除；抵消，对消；删去，划掉
entries.example: Please cancel the meeting if most people cannot attend.
entries.exampleZh: 如果大多数人不能出席，请取消会议。

entries.meaning: 候选人；应试人；候选人，候补者；申请求职者；报考者
entries.example: Each candidate gave a short speech before the final vote.
entries.exampleZh: 每位候选人在最终投票前都做了简短的演讲。

entries.example: The old man leaned on a wooden cane while walking.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人走路时拄着一根木手杖。

entries.example: The museum displays an old cannon near the entrance.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆在入口附近展示了一门旧大炮。

entries.example: They paddled a small canoe across the quiet lake at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明时他们划着一艘小独木舟穿过平静的湖面。

entries.meaning: 食堂；小卖部；餐具箱；水壶；餐厅，食堂
entries.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every weekday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每个工作日都在学校食堂吃午饭。

entries.example: She grew up speaking cantonese with her family at home.
entries.exampleZh: 她在家和家人一起长大，说广东话。

entries.example: The artist stretched a fresh canvas before starting the new painting.
entries.exampleZh: 画家在开始新画作前绷好了一块新画布。

entries.meaning: 〔对物件起保护作用的〕罩，盖，套；限制〔尤指金钱〕
entries.example: Please put the cap back on the bottle after you use it.
entries.exampleZh: 用完之后请把瓶盖放回瓶子上。

entries.example: She is capable of solving even the most difficult problems on her own.
entries.exampleZh: 她有能力独自解决最困难的问题。

entries.meaning: 容量；容积；理解力；地位；资格；容量，容积；能量，能力
entries.example: This hall has a seating capacity of over two thousand people.
entries.exampleZh: 这个大厅的座位容量超过两千人。

entries.example: We walked along the cape and watched the waves hit the rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着海角散步，看着海浪拍打岩石。

entries.meaning: 资本，大写字母；首都；可处死刑的
entries.example: Paris has been the capital of France for many centuries.
entries.exampleZh: 许多世纪以来，巴黎一直是法国的首都。

entries.example: The small boat began to capsize when the huge wave hit it.
entries.exampleZh: 巨浪打来时，小船开始倾覆。

entries.meaning: 荚；装一剂药的小囊；密封舱；胶囊；航天舱，太空舱
entries.example: The astronaut climbed into the capsule and waited for the launch.
entries.exampleZh: 宇航员爬进太空舱，等待发射。

entries.meaning: 报纸文章的标题；照片说明
entries.example: The caption under the photograph explained where it had been taken.
entries.exampleZh: 照片下方的说明文字解释了它是在哪里拍摄的。

entries.meaning: 俘虏，迷恋者；被俘虏的，被拴住的；被抓住的，被捕获的；受控制的；受垄断的；被抓住的人或动物
entries.example: The zookeepers fed the captive animals twice a day.
entries.exampleZh: 动物园管理员每天给圈养的动物喂食两次。

entries.example: The rare bird was born in captivity and cannot survive in the wild.
entries.exampleZh: 这只珍稀鸟类在圈养中出生，无法在野外生存。

entries.meaning: 捕获，俘虏，夺得；战利品；捕获，俘获；夺取或赢得；捕获；战利品
entries.example: The police managed to capture the thief before he left the city.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在他离开这座城市之前成功抓获了那个小偷。

entries.meaning: 主要的，基本的；深红色；基数
entries.example: Honesty is a cardinal rule in every healthy friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 诚实是每一段健康友谊中的基本准则。

entries.example: Regular exercise is good for your heart and the whole cardiovascular system.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对心脏和整个心血管系统都有好处。

entries.example: She began her career as a teacher in a small village school.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一所乡村小学开始了她的教师生涯。

entries.example: We waited by the baggage carousel for almost half an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在行李传送带旁等了将近半小时。

entries.example: The carpenter fixed the broken table in less than an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 木匠用了不到一小时就修好了那张坏桌子。

entries.meaning: 运货人；带菌者；运输军队的交通工具
entries.example: The aircraft carrier sailed slowly out of the harbour at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘航空母舰在黎明时缓缓驶出港口。

entries.example: Rabbits love eating a fresh carrot or two every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 兔子喜欢每天早上吃一两根新鲜的胡萝卜。

entries.meaning: 传送，运送；带有；支持；赞同；运送，搬运；传送，
entries.example: Can you carry these heavy boxes up to the third floor?
entries.exampleZh: 你能把这些重箱子搬到三楼吗？

entries.example: The farmer loaded the vegetables onto a wooden cart.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫把蔬菜装上一辆木车。

entries.example: She placed the empty milk carton beside the recycling bin near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 她把空牛奶纸盒放在门边的回收箱旁边。

entries.example: The children laughed at a funny cartoon before bedtime last night.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们昨晚睡前看了一部有趣的动画片，笑得开心。

entries.example: He learned to carve small wooden animals during art class.
entries.exampleZh: 他在美术课上学会了雕刻小木动物。

entries.example: A small cascade fell into the clear pool below the rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 一道小瀑布落入岩石下方清澈的水池。

entries.meaning: 现金，钱款；兑现，兑付；现金，
entries.example: I paid the driver in cash and thanked him politely.
entries.exampleZh: 我用现金付了司机钱，并礼貌地感谢了他。

entries.example: The cashier counted the bills carefully before giving me my change.
entries.exampleZh: 出纳员仔细数了钞票，然后才把零钱找给我。

entries.meaning: 磁带盒；照相软片盒；盒式录音带
entries.example: My father still keeps an old cassette in the wooden drawer.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲仍把一盒旧磁带放在木抽屉里。

entries.meaning: 投，掷，抛；铸造；扮演角色；投射；把…加于；投，扔；丢弃，剔除；脱落，蜕；浇铸，铸造；演员表，全体演员；石膏绷带；铸模，铸件；外貌，特征
entries.example: They will cast the new play next week at the local theater.
entries.exampleZh: 他们下周将在当地剧院为这部新剧挑选演员。

entries.meaning: 偶然的，碰巧的；随便的；临时的；偶然的，碰巧的，不经意的；临时的，非正式的
entries.example: He wore casual clothes to the informal meeting after work.
entries.exampleZh: 他下班后穿着便装去参加那个非正式会议。

entries.meaning: 伤亡人员；伤亡，伤亡者；损失的东西；伤亡事故
entries.example: The report listed one casualty after the sudden storm hit the coast.
