entries.exampleZh: 报告列出突发风暴袭击海岸后有一人伤亡。

entries.meaning: 目录；编目；目录；系列；编目录；记载
entries.example: She found the desired book in the library catalogue yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨天在图书馆目录中找到了想要的书。

entries.meaning: 催化剂；造成变化的人或事

entries.meaning: 顶点；小说等的高潮；达到高潮

entries.exampleZh: 长途汽车在河边一家小餐馆停下吃午饭。

entries.example: Several small parties formed a coalition to win the local election.
entries.exampleZh: 几个小党派结成联盟，以赢得地方选举。

entries.meaning: 粗(糙)的; 粗俗的；粗的；粗糙的；粗劣的

entries.exampleZh: 粗糙的沙子蹭着我的赤脚，感觉很粗。

entries.example: Police found a small amount of cocaine hidden in his car.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在他车里发现了少量藏匿的可卡因。

entries.meaning: 规则；代号；密码；把译成密码；密码；代码；把…编码

entries.exampleZh: 只有知道密码的员工才能打开这扇门。

entries.example: A friendly coed showed us around the university campus yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天一位友好的男女同校学生带我们参观了大学校园。

entries.example: Many parents here support coeducation because it prepares children for real life.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的许多家长支持男女同校，因为它让孩子为真实生活做好准备。

entries.exampleZh: 他们试图强迫他签署那份不公平的合同。

entries.example: Different species can coexist peacefully in this protected forest area.
entries.exampleZh: 不同物种可以在这片受保护的森林里和平共存。

entries.example: The old king kept his gold coins in a heavy iron coffer.
entries.exampleZh: 老国王把金币放在一个沉重的铁制保险箱里。

entries.example: Sleep affects memory and cognition more than most people realize.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠对记忆和认知的影响比大多数人以为的更大。

entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼可以改善老年人的认知能力。

entries.meaning: 黏着的；连贯的；条理清楚的，连贯的；一致的，协调的

entries.exampleZh: 她的解释从头到尾清楚而连贯。

entries.example: The coach praised the team's cohesion after a difficult season.
entries.exampleZh: 教练在艰难的赛季后称赞了球队的凝聚力。

entries.example: A thick coil of rope lay beside the old wooden door.
entries.exampleZh: 一捆粗绳放在旧木门旁边。

entries.example: He found an old gold coin under the kitchen table.
entries.exampleZh: 他在厨房桌子下面发现了一枚旧金币。

entries.meaning: 恰好相合，时间巧合；意见一致；同时发生；一致

entries.exampleZh: 我们的计划常常一致，因为我们目标相似。

entries.example: It was pure coincidence that we met at the same cafe.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在同一家咖啡馆相遇纯属巧合。

entries.meaning: 协作，合作；合作，协作；勾结，通敌

entries.exampleZh: 该项目通过两所当地学校之间的密切合作取得了成功。

entries.exampleZh: 桥梁的突然坍塌堵塞了主干道。

entries.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前整理这些报告。

entries.exampleZh: 新政策给许多农村家庭带来了附带的好处。

entries.exampleZh: 志愿者为附近村庄的儿童收集旧书。

entries.example: Her collection of foreign stamps impressed every visitor.
entries.exampleZh: 她的外国邮票收藏让每位访客印象深刻。

entries.example: The two cars may collide if drivers ignore the warning.
entries.exampleZh: 如果司机忽视警告，两辆车可能会相撞。

entries.meaning: 碰，幢;冲突；碰撞；冲突，抵触

entries.exampleZh: 一场严重碰撞使高速公路关闭了几个小时。

entries.meaning: 殖民地的，关于殖民的；殖民地居民

entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了殖民时期的家具。

entries.example: A small colony of ants lived under the garden wall.
entries.exampleZh: 一小群蚂蚁住在花园围墙下面。

entries.example: The colossal statue attracted thousands of tourists every summer.
entries.exampleZh: 这座巨大的雕像每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

entries.meaning: 柱; 柱状物；书报上的栏；纵列；柱；柱形物；专栏，栏目

entries.exampleZh: 请在我们去吃晚饭前梳好头发。

entries.exampleZh: 士兵们刻苦训练以对抗日益严重的威胁。

entries.example: A good combination of patience and practice helps most language learners improve.
entries.exampleZh: 耐心与练习的良好结合能帮助大多数语言学习者进步。

entries.exampleZh: 农民在收获季节常把辛勤劳动与周密计划结合起来。

entries.exampleZh: 那座旧仓库把易燃材料存放在加热器附近，这让检查员很担心。

entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究燃烧过程，以设计更安全的发动机并减少有害排放。

entries.example: Please come to my office after lunch so we can discuss the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 请午饭后到我办公室来，这样我们可以讨论这个计划。

entries.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部轻松喜剧，每个滑稽场景都让我们发笑。

entries.example: The comet appeared in the night sky and stayed visible for several weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 那颗彗星出现在夜空中，并持续可见数周。

entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢睡前读一本连环漫画书。

entries.exampleZh: 该镇将举行游行和公众仪式来纪念其建镇。

entries.example: The ceremony will commence at noon, so please arrive a little early.
entries.exampleZh: 仪式将在中午开始，所以请稍微早点到。

entries.exampleZh: 毕业典礼演讲激励许多毕业生勇敢追求梦想。

entries.exampleZh: 老师将表扬这些学生的诚实和认真合作。

entries.exampleZh: 在线商业改变了小商店接触世界各地顾客的方式。

entries.example: My friends came to commiserate with me after I lost the contest.
entries.exampleZh: 我比赛失利后，朋友们来向我表示同情。

entries.exampleZh: 她对每日练习的坚持帮助她通过了那场艰难的考试。

entries.meaning: 日用品，商品；商品，货物；日用品

entries.exampleZh: 这种商品的价格在过去一年里大幅上涨。

entries.exampleZh: 如今这类问题在大城市里很常见。

entries.exampleZh: 该联邦的成立是为了促进成员国之间的贸易。

entries.exampleZh: 窗外一阵响亮的骚动吵醒了房间里的每个人。

entries.exampleZh: 家长和老师之间良好的沟通有助于孩子在学校表现更好。

entries.exampleZh: 我上班的通勤坐公交车大约需要四十分钟。

entries.exampleZh: 漫长的一天过后，站台上的每个通勤者看上去都很疲惫。

entries.exampleZh: 多年来，我的狗一直是我忠实的伙伴，陪我度过许多艰难岁月。

entries.exampleZh: 在安静的夜晚，她喜欢与老朋友们相伴。

entries.exampleZh: 这两家酒店价格相近，但服务不同。

entries.exampleZh: 我们对这两种教学方法做了比较研究。

entries.exampleZh: 这次考试相对容易，所以大多数学生提前做完了。

entries.meaning: 比较，对照；喻为；比较；对比

entries.exampleZh: 请在明天上午开会前把这两份报告比较一下。

entries.exampleZh: 对这两个方案做仔细比较，可以看出几处明显的不同。

entries.exampleZh: 他把行李箱放到了座位上方的行李格里。

entries.meaning: 指南针；圆规；界限；罗盘，罗盘仪；界限，范围；

entries.exampleZh: 没有指南针，很容易迷路。

entries.meaning: 有同情心的，表示怜悯的

entries.exampleZh: 那位护士很有同情心，对每位害怕的病人都轻声细语。

entries.meaning: 可兼容的，可和谐共存的；兼容的；合得来的

entries.exampleZh: 这款软件与大多数现代笔记本电脑和平板电脑兼容。

entries.example: She felt proud when a compatriot won the international science prize.
entries.exampleZh: 当一位同胞赢得国际科学奖时，她感到很自豪。

entries.example: Heavy traffic may compel us to leave much earlier tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 交通拥堵可能会迫使我们明天早点出发。

entries.example: The professor published a useful compendium of ancient stories for students.
entries.exampleZh: 教授为学生出版了一本有用的古代故事简编。

entries.meaning: 赔偿，补偿；补偿，赔偿；弥补

entries.exampleZh: 公司将就长时间的送货延误赔偿顾客。

entries.exampleZh: 事故损坏她的车后，她要求公平的赔偿。

entries.example: Small shops find it hard to compete with huge online stores.
entries.exampleZh: 小商店发现很难与大型网店竞争。

entries.example: Her competence in handling difficult clients impressed the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 她处理难缠客户的能力给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

entries.example: We need a competent guide to lead us along this route.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一位有能力的向导带领我们走这条路线。

entries.example: The cooking competition attracted many talented young chefs this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年的烹饪比赛吸引了许多有才华的年轻厨师。

entries.example: The job market is highly competitive for new university graduates.
entries.exampleZh: 对于刚毕业的大学生来说，就业市场竞争非常激烈。

entries.example: They plan to compile a short guide to local walking paths.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划编写一本当地步行路线的简短指南。

entries.example: Several guests began to complain about the noise from the street.
entries.exampleZh: 几位客人开始抱怨街上的噪音。

entries.example: The manager listened carefully to every complaint from the hotel guests.
entries.exampleZh: 经理认真听取了酒店客人的每一条投诉。

entries.meaning: 补足物，船上的定员；补语；补充，补足

entries.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐为安静的晚餐做了完美的衬托。

entries.example: Their skills are complementary, so they make an effective team.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的技能互补，因此组成了一支高效的团队。

entries.meaning: 彻底的；完成的；绝对的；完成；结束
entries.example: Please complete the form before you meet the doctor.
entries.exampleZh: 请在见医生之前填完这张表格。

entries.meaning: 复杂的；复合体；变态心理；综合体，集合体；建筑群；
entries.example: The new sports complex includes a pool and two gyms.
entries.exampleZh: 新的体育综合体包括一个游泳池和两个健身房。

entries.example: Fresh air and enough sleep improved her complexion within weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜空气和充足睡眠在几周内改善了她的肤色。

entries.meaning: 复杂，复杂性；复杂的事物
entries.example: The complexity of the new rules confused many small business owners.
entries.exampleZh: 新规则的复杂性让许多小企业主感到困惑。

entries.example: Strict compliance with safety rules is required at all times.

entries.meaning: 侦探的，发觉者的；侦探的；侦探
entries.example: A famous detective solved the mysterious case within a week.
entries.exampleZh: 一位著名的侦探在一周内破了这起神秘案件。

entries.meaning: 阻止，使不敢，吓住；威慑，吓住，断念
entries.example: Heavy fines may deter drivers from parking illegally here.
entries.exampleZh: 高额罚款或许能阻止司机在此违章停车。

entries.meaning: 去垢剂，清洁剂；净化的，清洁的；清洁剂
entries.example: She added detergent to the warm water and washed the shirts.
entries.exampleZh: 她往温水里加了清洁剂，然后洗了衬衫。

entries.meaning: 恶化，败坏；变坏，恶化；退化
entries.example: His health began to deteriorate after the long journey abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 长途出国旅行后，他的健康状况开始恶化。

entries.example: The sudden deterioration of the weather forced us to cancel the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 天气突然恶化迫使我们取消了旅行。

entries.example: Her determination to finish the race impressed everyone at the track.
entries.exampleZh: 她跑完比赛的决心让跑道上的每个人都印象深刻。

entries.example: We must determine the cause of the problem before we act.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在采取行动前确定问题的原因。

entries.example: I detest waiting in long lines at the busy station.
entries.exampleZh: 我讨厌在繁忙的车站排长队等候。

entries.example: Road work forced us to take a long detour through the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 道路施工迫使我们绕道穿过山丘。

entries.example: A few small mistakes should not detract from your excellent results.
entries.exampleZh: 几个小错误不应减损你出色的成绩。

entries.example: He worked late every night to the detriment of his health.
entries.exampleZh: 他每晚工作到很晚，损害了自己的健康。

entries.meaning: 有害的，不利的；不利的，有害的
entries.example: Too much screen time can be detrimental to children's eyesight.
entries.exampleZh: 看屏幕时间过长可能对儿童的视力有害。

entries.example: The bank may devalue the currency to boost falling exports.
entries.exampleZh: 银行可能会让货币贬值以提振不断下降的出口。

entries.meaning: 破坏，蹂躏；破坏，毁坏；使震惊，使极为悲痛
entries.example: The storm could devastate coastal towns if it changes direction.
entries.exampleZh: 如果风暴改变方向，它可能摧毁沿海城镇。

entries.meaning: 破坏性的，毁灭性的；毁灭性的；强有力的
entries.example: The flood had a devastating effect on the small village.
entries.exampleZh: 洪水对这个小村庄造成了毁灭性的影响。

entries.example: The company plans to develop a new app for language learners.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划为语言学习者开发一款新应用。

entries.example: The study examines deviance among teenagers in modern city schools.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究考察现代城市学校中青少年的偏常行为。

entries.example: Please do not deviate from the agreed plan without informing the team.
entries.exampleZh: 未经通知团队，请不要偏离商定的计划。

entries.meaning: 装置，设备，仪表；方法；设计；手段，策略
entries.example: This small device can measure the temperature of the water quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小装置能快速测量水温。

entries.example: The engineers will devise a safer method for transporting heavy equipment.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们将设计出一种更安全的重型设备运输方法。

entries.meaning: 把奉献给；将…奉献给；致力
entries.example: She plans to devote her free time to helping local children read.
entries.exampleZh: 她打算把空闲时间用来帮助当地儿童阅读。

entries.meaning: 狼吞虎咽地吃；挥霍，耗尽
entries.example: The hungry travelers devour their sandwiches before the long bus ride.
entries.exampleZh: 饥饿的旅行者在长途汽车出发前狼吞虎咽地吃掉了三明治。

entries.example: Doctors can diagnose the illness early if patients describe their symptoms clearly.
entries.exampleZh: 如果病人清楚描述症状，医生就能及早诊断这种疾病。

entries.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to explain how the machine works.
entries.exampleZh: 老师画了一个简单的图表来解释这台机器如何运作。

entries.meaning: 表面，钟面；拨号盘；打电话
entries.example: Please dial the office number again after five minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 请五分钟后再次拨打办公室电话。

entries.example: The older villagers still speak a local dialect at home.
entries.exampleZh: 年长的村民在家里仍然讲一种当地方言。

entries.example: The pipe has a diameter of about ten centimeters.
entries.exampleZh: 这根管子的直径大约十厘米。

entries.example: The manager will dictate the new rules to his assistant tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 经理明天将向助手口述新规定。

entries.example: Our teacher gives a short dictation at the start of every lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师在每节课开始时进行一次简短听写。

entries.example: The truck runs on diesel and carries fresh vegetables to town.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆卡车用柴油驱动，把新鲜蔬菜运到镇上。

entries.example: A balanced diet includes plenty of vegetables, fruit, and clean water.
entries.exampleZh: 均衡的饮食包括大量蔬菜、水果和干净的水。

entries.example: The doctor asked about my dietary habits and daily exercise routine.
entries.exampleZh: 医生询问了我的饮食习惯和日常锻炼情况。

entries.meaning: 不相同，意见不一致；不同，相异；发生分歧
entries.example: Our opinions differ on how to spend the extra budget.
entries.exampleZh: 我们对于如何花这笔额外预算意见不同。

entries.meaning: 区别，区分；区分，区别；差别对待，区别对待
entries.example: Young children often cannot differentiate between a safe joke and a cruel one.
entries.exampleZh: 年幼的孩子常常无法区分安全的玩笑和残忍的玩笑。

entries.meaning: 散开，扩散；扩散的；冗长的；散布，传播；漫射；扩散，弥漫；扩散的，漫射的；冗长的，难解的
entries.example: The morning light began to diffuse through the thin curtains.
entries.exampleZh: 晨光开始透过薄窗帘漫射开来。

entries.meaning: 消化；领会，融会贯通；文摘，摘要；消化；领会['daɪdʒ3st]；文摘
entries.example: I need time to digest all this new information.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要时间消化所有这些新信息。

entries.example: Too much spicy food can upset your digestive system.
entries.exampleZh: 吃太多辛辣食物会扰乱你的消化系统。

entries.meaning: 数字的，计数的；数码的，数字的
entries.example: She bought a new digital camera before her trip to Japan.
entries.exampleZh: 去日本旅行之前，她买了一台新的数码相机。

entries.example: The old teacher spoke with great dignity about his long career.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老教师满怀尊严地谈起自己漫长的职业生涯。

entries.example: They bought a dilapidated house and repaired it over two years.
entries.exampleZh: 他们买下一栋破旧的房子，花了两年时间修缮。

entries.example: The eye doctor used special drops to dilate her pupils.
entries.exampleZh: 眼科医生用特殊的滴眼液让她的瞳孔放大。

entries.example: She faced a real dilemma when both job offers arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 两份工作邀约同时到来时，她陷入了真正的两难境地。

entries.example: He is a diligent student who reviews his notes every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 他是个勤奋的学生，每天晚上都会复习笔记。

entries.example: Please dilute the juice with water before giving it to the kids.
entries.exampleZh: 给孩子们喝之前，请用水把果汁稀释一下。

entries.meaning: 暗的，看不清楚的，迟钝的；变暗淡
entries.example: The lights in the theater began to dim before the show.
entries.exampleZh: 演出开始前，剧场的灯光渐渐变暗。

entries.meaning: 尺寸，尺度，大小；尺寸，度；方面，特点；维，元；
entries.example: The new budget adds another dimension to our planning.
entries.exampleZh: 新的预算给我们的规划增添了另一个层面。

entries.example: The new software offers a dimensional view of each room.
entries.exampleZh: 这款新软件可以呈现每个房间的立体视图。

entries.meaning: 减少，减小，缩小；减少；降低；贬低，轻视
entries.example: Interest in the old game began to diminish after a few years.
entries.exampleZh: 几年之后，人们对这项古老游戏的兴趣开始减弱。

entries.example: The din from the street kept us awake all night.
entries.exampleZh: 街上嘈杂的喧闹声让我们一整夜都没睡着。

entries.example: We plan to dine at a small restaurant near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打算在河边的一家小餐馆用餐。

entries.example: He rented a dingy room above an old shop.
entries.exampleZh: 他在一家旧商店楼上租了一间又脏又暗的房间。

entries.example: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen into the air.
entries.exampleZh: 树木吸收二氧化碳，并把氧气释放到空气中。

entries.example: She likes to dip her bread in the warm soup.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢把面包蘸进热汤里。

entries.meaning: 毕业证书，文凭；毕业文凭；资格证书
entries.example: He framed his diploma and hung it above the desk.
entries.exampleZh: 他把毕业文凭装进相框，挂在书桌上方。

entries.example: The young diplomat spoke three languages fluently at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的外交官在会上流利地讲了三门语言。

entries.example: The two nations finally found a diplomatic solution to the dispute.
entries.exampleZh: 两国最终为这场争端找到了外交途径的解决办法。

entries.example: She walked in the wrong direction and got lost.
entries.exampleZh: 她走错了方向，结果迷了路。

entries.meaning: 名录；人名地址录；号码簿
entries.example: I found his office number in the local phone directory.
entries.exampleZh: 我在本地电话簿里找到了他办公室的号码。

entries.meaning: 使无能力，使伤残；使丧失能力，使伤残；使不能正常运转，使无效
entries.example: A serious injury can disable a skilled worker for many months.
entries.exampleZh: 严重的伤病可能使一名熟练工人数月无法工作。

entries.example: The main disadvantage of this plan is its high cost.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划的主要缺点是成本太高。

entries.example: I disagree with your view that the test was easy.
entries.exampleZh: 我不同意你认为这次考试很容易的看法。

entries.example: The team's performance was disappointing despite months of hard training.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管训练了数月，球队的表现仍令人失望。

entries.example: My parents strongly disapprove of my plan to travel alone.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母强烈反对我独自旅行的计划。

entries.example: After the party, the kitchen was left in complete disarray.
entries.exampleZh: 聚会结束后，厨房被弄得一片混乱。

entries.example: The flood was a terrible disaster for the small mountain village.
entries.exampleZh: 这场洪水对那个小山村来说是一场可怕的灾难。

entries.meaning: 损失惨重的，灾难性的；极坏的
entries.example: The company made a disastrous decision to ignore expert advice.
entries.exampleZh: 公司无视专家建议，做出了灾难性的决定。

entries.example: The old computer's disc still holds all my important school files.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑的光盘仍然存着我所有重要的学校文件。

entries.example: Please discard any old papers before the new semester begins.
entries.exampleZh: 请在新学期开始前丢弃所有旧文件。

entries.example: It is hard to discern the truth from these confusing reports.
entries.exampleZh: 很难从这些令人困惑的报道中辨出真相。

entries.meaning: 有识别力的，眼光敏锐的
entries.example: A discerning reader will notice the small errors in this report.
entries.exampleZh: 眼光敏锐的读者会注意到这份报告中的小错误。

entries.meaning: 卸货；排出(液体，气体)；释放；解雇；释放；排出，放出；放；完成，履行；排出；获准离开，免职；履行，执行；清偿[dɪs'tʃɑːdʒ]
entries.example: The factory must not discharge waste into the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂不得向河里排放废物。

entries.meaning: 训练，纪律，戒律，惩罚；训练，
entries.example: Learning a language requires discipline and a little daily practice.
entries.exampleZh: 学习一门语言需要自律和每天一点练习。

entries.meaning: 透露，泄露；揭露；透露；公开
entries.example: The lawyer refused to disclose any details about the secret agreement.
entries.exampleZh: 律师拒绝透露关于这份秘密协议的任何细节。

entries.example: The airline will discontinue this route at the end of March.
entries.exampleZh: 该航空公司将在三月底停止这条航线。

entries.example: Their constant arguments created serious discord within the small team.
entries.exampleZh: 他们不断的争吵在小团队内部造成了严重的失和。

entries.meaning: 折扣；不全信，低估，漠视；给…打折；漠视，低估
entries.example: The store offers a ten percent discount to students every weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 这家商店每个周末给学生提供九折优惠。

entries.meaning: 使泄气，使灰心；阻止，劝阻
entries.example: Teachers should never discourage students from asking difficult questions.
entries.exampleZh: 老师绝不应阻止学生提出难题。

entries.example: His discourteous reply surprised everyone at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他在会上无礼的回答让所有人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: Scientists hope to discover a safer treatment for this rare disease.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们希望发现一种治疗这种罕见疾病的更安全方法。

entries.example: The discovery of a new planet excited astronomers around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 一颗新行星的发现令世界各地的天文学家兴奋不已。

entries.meaning: 使怀疑；使丧失信誉，使丢脸
entries.example: False rumours could discredit the witness before the trial begins.
entries.exampleZh: 虚假的传言可能在审判开始前使证人失去信誉。

entries.example: She made a discreet inquiry about the missing documents.
entries.exampleZh: 她对丢失的文件进行了谨慎的询问。

entries.meaning: 不一致，差异，不符；不同；矛盾
entries.example: The accountant noticed a small discrepancy between the two reports.
entries.exampleZh: 会计注意到两份报告之间有一个小差异。

entries.example: The course is divided into five discrete units for easier study.
entries.exampleZh: 这门课程被分成五个独立单元，以便更容易学习。

entries.example: Please use your discretion when sharing these confidential details.
entries.exampleZh: 分享这些机密细节时请自行斟酌。

entries.meaning: 区别，区分；岐视；区别；歧视
entries.example: Young children often discriminate between familiar and unfamiliar faces.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿常常能区分熟悉和不熟悉的面孔。

entries.meaning: 蔑视, 轻视 "；鄙视，蔑视
entries.example: She looked at the cheap gift with obvious disdain.
entries.exampleZh: 她带着明显的蔑视看着那份廉价礼物。

entries.example: Constant criticism can disempower even the most confident team members.
entries.exampleZh: 持续的批评甚至会让最自信的团队成员失去影响力。

entries.example: Public disenchantment with the government grew after the scandal.
entries.exampleZh: 丑闻发生后，公众对政府的失望情绪加剧了。

entries.example: Graffiti can disfigure the walls of historic public buildings.
entries.exampleZh: 涂鸦会损毁历史公共建筑的墙面外观。

entries.example: The thief wore a simple disguise to avoid recognition.
entries.exampleZh: 小偷戴着简单的伪装以避免被认出。

entries.example: His rude behaviour filled the guests with disgust.
entries.exampleZh: 他的粗鲁行为让客人们感到厌恶。

entries.example: Constant arguing created disharmony within the small research team.
entries.exampleZh: 不断的争吵在小研究团队内部造成了不和谐。

entries.example: The failed experiment may disillusion young students about scientific careers.
entries.exampleZh: 这次失败的实验可能使年轻学生对科学事业不再抱幻想。

entries.example: Her disillusionment with politics began after years of broken promises.
entries.exampleZh: 在多年承诺落空之后，她对政治不再抱幻想。

entries.example: The old paper documents will disintegrate if exposed to moisture.
entries.exampleZh: 这些旧纸质文件如果受潮就会碎裂瓦解。

entries.example: Workers will dismantle the temporary stage after the concert.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会结束后，工人们将拆除临时舞台。

entries.example: She felt deep dismay when the final results were announced.
entries.exampleZh: 当最终结果公布时，她感到深深的沮丧。

entries.meaning: 解散；解雇；不考虑；消除；解雇，解散；驳回，不受理
entries.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers after the safety review.
entries.exampleZh: 安全审查后，经理决定解雇两名工人。

entries.example: Teenagers often disobey their parents when they feel misunderstood.
entries.exampleZh: 青少年感到不被理解时常常不服从父母。

entries.meaning: 混乱，骚动，(身心)失调；混乱；失调，紊乱，疾病
entries.example: The sudden power cut left the whole office in disorder.
entries.exampleZh: 突然停电让整个办公室陷入混乱。

entries.meaning: 使失去方向感；使迷茫，使不知所措
entries.example: Bright flashing lights can disorientate drivers on a dark road.
entries.exampleZh: 明亮的闪光灯会让黑暗道路上的司机失去方向感。

entries.example: It is unfair to disparage her work without reading it first.
entries.exampleZh: 没先读她的作品就贬低它是不公平的。

entries.meaning: 派遣，发送，迅速办理，急件
entries.example: The company will dispatch the order early tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将在明天一大早发送订单。

entries.example: A clear explanation helped dispel the rumors about the new policy.
entries.exampleZh: 清楚的解释帮助消除了关于新政策的谣言。

entries.example: The machine can dispense tickets quickly during busy hours.
entries.exampleZh: 这台机器在繁忙时段能快速分发车票。

entries.meaning: 药剂师，配药师；分配者，施予者；自动售货机
entries.example: The soap dispenser in the bathroom is empty again.
entries.exampleZh: 浴室里的皂液器又空了。

entries.example: The rapid dispersal of the crowd surprised the police.
entries.exampleZh: 人群的迅速疏散让警察感到惊讶。

entries.example: The wind will disperse the smoke before noon today.
entries.exampleZh: 风会在今天中午前把烟吹散。

entries.meaning: 令人沮丧的，使人气馁的
entries.example: The long delay was dispiriting for everyone at the station.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的延误让车站里的每个人都感到沮丧。

entries.meaning: 转移，取代；取代；迫使离开家园；撤职，使失业
entries.example: The new system may displace several workers in our department.
entries.exampleZh: 新系统可能会取代我们部门的几名工人。

entries.meaning: 展览，陈列；陈列，展览；显示，表现
entries.example: The museum will display these rare coins next month.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出这些稀有硬币。

entries.example: Please bring disposable cups for the outdoor picnic on Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 周日户外野餐请带一次性杯子。

entries.example: The safe disposal of chemicals requires special care and training.
entries.exampleZh: 化学品的安全处理需要特别小心和培训。

entries.example: We must dispose of old batteries in a proper way.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须以适当方式处理旧电池。

entries.example: Her cheerful disposition makes her popular with the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 她开朗的性格使她在整个团队中很受欢迎。

entries.meaning: 争论，争执，质疑；对…表示异议；争论，争吵；争论，争端，争吵
entries.example: The two sides resolved their dispute without going to court.
entries.exampleZh: 双方没有上法庭就解决了争端。

entries.example: The referee may disqualify any player who breaks the rules.
entries.exampleZh: 裁判可能会取消任何违反规则的球员的资格。

entries.meaning: 不理，漠视；不理会，漠视；忽视，漠视
entries.example: His complete disregard for safety worried the other workers.
entries.exampleZh: 他对安全的完全漠视让其他工人担忧。

entries.example: It was disrespectful to interrupt the teacher during the lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 在课上打断老师是不礼貌的。

entries.meaning: 使分裂，瓦解；使中断；扰乱
entries.example: Heavy rain can disrupt train services across the whole region.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能会扰乱整个地区的列车服务。

entries.example: The strike caused serious disruption to flights at the airport.
entries.exampleZh: 罢工给机场的航班造成了严重扰乱。

entries.meaning: 制造混乱的；分裂性的；破坏性的
entries.example: Several disruptive students were asked to leave the quiet library.

entries.meaning: (博士学位)论文，学术演讲，专题论文；专题论文

entries.example: The morning fog will dissipate once the sun rises higher.

entries.meaning: 分发，分配，散布；分发，分配，分送；散布，分布；分类，分区

entries.exampleZh: 志愿者今晚将向每户家庭分发食物和水。

entries.meaning: 分开，岔开；分歧，相异；偏离，违背

entries.exampleZh: 公司计划明年使其产品多样化。

entries.exampleZh: 公司上个月向股东支付了一小笔股息。

entries.exampleZh: 昨晚湖面上的日落看起来美极了。

entries.exampleZh: 这家公司去年在上海开设了一个新的部门。

entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的眩晕迫使她坐在楼梯上。

entries.exampleZh: 陡峭的楼梯让我感到头晕目眩、气喘吁吁。

entries.exampleZh: 一滴雨水落在我打开的笔记本上。

entries.exampleZh: 长期干旱毁掉了这个地区的大部分庄稼。

entries.example: A fat earthworm crawled across the wet garden path.
entries.exampleZh: 一条肥大的蚯蚓爬过湿漉漉的花园小径。

entries.meaning: 减轻，放松，小心移置；舒适
entries.example: He passed the exam with ease and smiled at his teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 他轻松地通过了考试，并对老师笑了笑。

entries.example: Our family always gathers for a big meal at Easter.
entries.exampleZh: 我们全家总是在复活节聚在一起吃顿大餐。

entries.meaning: 古怪(的)，偏执(的)，不同心(的)；古怪的，反常的；古怪的人
entries.example: Our eccentric neighbour keeps a small garden full of unusual metal sculptures.
entries.exampleZh: 我们那位古怪的邻居有一个小花园，里面摆满了不寻常的金属雕塑。

entries.example: A clear echo returned from the empty hall after my shout.
entries.exampleZh: 我的喊声过后，空荡的大厅里传来了清晰的回声。

entries.example: A lunar eclipse was visible through thin clouds last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚透过薄云可以看到月食。

entries.example: The ecliptic marks the sun's apparent path across our sky.
entries.exampleZh: 黄道标出了太阳在天空中看起来经过的路径。

entries.example: The new dam may cause serious ecological damage to the river.
entries.exampleZh: 新水坝可能会对这条河造成严重的生态破坏。

entries.meaning: 生态学；生态，生态学；生态环境
entries.example: She studies ecology and hopes to protect coastal forests.
entries.exampleZh: 她学习生态学，希望保护沿海森林。

entries.meaning: 经济的；经济学的，便宜的；经济的；经济上的，经济学的
entries.example: The country faces serious economic problems after the sudden oil price rise.
entries.exampleZh: 油价突然上涨后，这个国家面临严重的经济问题。

entries.example: This small car is very economical on fuel for daily city driving.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车在日常城市驾驶中非常省油。

entries.example: He teaches economics at a local college and writes short articles.
entries.exampleZh: 他在当地一所大学教经济学，并写一些短文。

entries.example: The local economy depends heavily on tourism during the summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 当地经济在夏季月份严重依赖旅游业。

entries.example: A healthy ecosystem needs clean water, varied plants and many small insects.
entries.exampleZh: 健康的生态系统需要干净的水、多样的植物和许多小昆虫。

entries.example: A small eddy formed behind the rock in the fast stream.
entries.exampleZh: 急流中，岩石后面形成了一个小漩涡。

entries.meaning: 加；边界；给加上边，徐徐移动
entries.example: She stood at the edge of the cliff and watched the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 她站在悬崖边缘，望着大海。

entries.example: These wild mushrooms are not edible, so please do not eat them.
entries.exampleZh: 这些野生蘑菇不能食用，所以请不要吃它们。

entries.example: The old teacher hoped to edify his students with simple moral stories.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年老的教师希望用简单的道德故事启迪学生。

entries.example: I need to edit this report before the meeting tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 明天上午开会前我需要编辑这份报告。

entries.example: The first edition of this novel sold out within a week.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说的第一版在一周内就卖完了。

entries.example: The newspaper published a strong editorial about the city's housing crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 报纸发表了一篇关于该市住房危机的强硬社论。

entries.meaning: 作用，影响；结果；效果；使产生，招致；实现
entries.example: The new medicine had a quick effect on her constant headache.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新药对她的持续头痛产生了快速效果。

entries.meaning: 有效的，生效的；给人深刻印象的，显著的
entries.example: This simple method is very effective for learning new words quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 这种简单的方法对于快速学习新单词非常有效。

entries.example: The new system improved efficiency in the office by a large amount.
entries.exampleZh: 新系统大大提高了办公室的工作效率。

entries.meaning: 能胜任的，效率高的；有效的，效率高的；有能力的，能胜任的
entries.example: She is an efficient worker who finishes every task before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个效率很高的员工，每项任务都在截止日期前完成。

entries.example: He made a great effort to finish the report on time.
entries.exampleZh: 他付出很大努力按时完成了报告。

entries.meaning: 自我，自己，个人思考和感觉能力
entries.example: His ego was hurt when nobody praised his new plan.
entries.exampleZh: 没人称赞他的新计划，这伤了他的自尊。

entries.meaning: 驱逐，排出；弹出；喷出；驱逐，逐出
entries.example: The referee decided to eject the player after a violent tackle.
entries.exampleZh: 裁判在一次凶狠的抢断之后决定把那名球员罚出场。

entries.example: The pilot's ejection from the burning plane was shown on the news.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员从燃烧的飞机中弹射出来的画面在新闻里播出了。

entries.example: They had to eke out their small savings until the end of the month.
entries.exampleZh: 他们不得不省吃俭用，把微薄的积蓄撑到月底。

entries.meaning: 复杂的；详尽的；做详细说明；详尽的；复杂的；精心制作的[ɪ'læbəreIt]；详述；详细制定
entries.example: Could you elaborate on your plan a little more?
entries.exampleZh: 你能把你的计划再详细说明一下吗？

entries.example: The professor's elaboration on the topic lasted almost an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 教授对这个话题的详细阐述持续了将近一个小时。

entries.example: Several hours will elapse before the test results are ready.
entries.exampleZh: 检查结果出来之前还要过好几个小时。

entries.meaning: 弹性的，有伸缩性的；橡皮圈；有弹性的；
entries.example: This waistband is elastic, so the trousers fit almost everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 这条腰带是有弹性的，所以几乎人人都能穿。

entries.example: She felt elated when she heard that she had won the prize.
entries.exampleZh: 听说自己得了奖，她感到欢欣鼓舞。

entries.meaning: 肘；衣服肘部；用肘推、挤；肘；肘部
entries.example: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball with his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他和朋友打篮球时伤了肘部。

entries.example: An elderly woman asked me for directions to the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 一位老太太向我打听去火车站的路。

entries.meaning: 电的，电气科学的；电的，电学的，有关电的
entries.example: The electrical wiring in this old building needs urgent repair.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋老建筑的电气线路需要紧急维修。

entries.example: We called an electrician to fix the lights in the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 我们叫了一位电工来修厨房的灯。

entries.meaning: 电子的，用电子操纵的；电子的
entries.example: Please turn off all electronic devices before the plane takes off.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机起飞前请关闭所有电子设备。

entries.example: He studied electronics at university and now works for a big company.
entries.exampleZh: 他在大学学的是电子学，现在为一家大公司工作。

entries.example: She wore an elegant black dress to the dinner party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条雅致的黑色连衣裙去参加晚宴。

entries.meaning: 要素；元素；[the -s] 基本原理
entries.example: Trust is the most important element in any close friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 信任是任何亲密友谊中最重要的要素。

entries.example: The teacher explained the elementary rules before the students began the experiment.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在学生开始实验前解释了基本规则。

entries.meaning: 升高，抬起，提高；提升…的职位；举起；使更有修养
entries.example: Regular exercise can elevate your mood and improve your overall health.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能提升你的情绪并改善整体健康。

entries.example: The old elevator stopped working, so we used the stairs instead.
entries.exampleZh: 旧电梯坏了，所以我们改走楼梯。

entries.example: The teacher asked several questions to elicit honest answers from the shy students.
entries.exampleZh: 老师问了几个问题，以引出害羞学生们的诚实回答。

entries.example: The careful elicitation of details helped the police understand the full story.
entries.exampleZh: 对细节的仔细引导帮助警方了解了完整经过。

entries.meaning: 合格的，适宜的；符合条件的；合适的
entries.example: Only students who pass the test are eligible for the scholarship.
entries.exampleZh: 只有通过考试的学生才有资格获得这项奖学金。

entries.meaning: 消灭，消除；消灭，消除；淘汰
entries.example: We must eliminate waste if we want to reduce costs this year.
entries.exampleZh: 如果今年想降低成本，我们必须消除浪费。

entries.meaning: 社会精华(的)，高贵者(的)；卓越的，精锐的；精英，中坚
entries.example: The elite of the city gathered at the charity dinner last night.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的精英昨晚齐聚慈善晚宴。

entries.example: Her eloquent speech moved the audience and earned long applause.
entries.exampleZh: 她雄辩的演讲感动了观众，赢得了长久的掌声。

entries.example: If this shop is closed, we can look elsewhere for the tools.
entries.exampleZh: 如果这家店关门了，我们可以去别处找这些工具。

entries.example: The professor tried to elucidate the difficult theory with simple examples.
entries.exampleZh: 教授试图用简单的例子阐明这个难懂的理论。

entries.meaning: 难懂的，难捉摸的；易忘的
entries.example: The answer to the puzzle remained elusive despite our many careful attempts.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管我们多次仔细尝试，谜题的答案仍然难以捉摸。

entries.example: We walked along the river embankment and watched the boats pass.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着河堤散步，看着船只驶过。

entries.example: The government placed an embargo on imported goods from that country.
entries.exampleZh: 政府对该国进口商品实施了禁运。

entries.meaning: 上船；从事；开始；上船或飞机；从事
entries.example: They will embark on a new project after the holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 假期过后他们将开始一个新项目。

entries.example: Please do not embarrass her by asking about the mistake in public.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要当众问起那个错误，以免让她难堪。

entries.meaning: 大使馆；大使馆；大使馆全体官员
entries.example: She went to the embassy to renew her passport this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上她去大使馆续办护照。

entries.meaning: 把嵌入，使扎根于社会，使深留脑中；把…嵌入，扎牢；使深留脑中
entries.example: The workers will embed the pipes deep inside the concrete wall.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们会把管道深埋在混凝土墙里。

entries.example: The manager was arrested for embezzlement after a careful audit.
entries.exampleZh: 经过仔细审计，这名经理因贪污被捕。

entries.meaning: 体现；使具体化；表达，体现；具体表现，使具体化；包括，包含
entries.example: These old songs embody the spirit of our small mountain town.
entries.exampleZh: 这些老歌体现了我们山间小镇的精神。

entries.example: The artist will emboss her name on the leather cover.
entries.exampleZh: 这位艺术家会在皮革封面上压印她的名字。

entries.meaning: 拥抱；利用；包含；拥抱；包括；欣然接受
entries.example: Many students embrace new technology because it makes learning more enjoyable.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生欣然接受新技术，因为它让学习更有趣。

entries.example: The scientist observed the tiny embryo under a powerful microscope.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家在强大的显微镜下观察这个微小的胚胎。

entries.meaning: 出现，浮现，暴露；出现；显露，暴露
entries.example: New details about the case began to emerge during the trial.
entries.exampleZh: 审判期间，关于此案的新细节开始浮现。

entries.example: Please call this number immediately if a serious emergency occurs.
entries.exampleZh: 如果发生严重紧急情况，请立即拨打这个号码。

entries.meaning: 保留头衔而退休的，荣誉退休的
entries.example: The emeritus professor still visits his old department every week.
entries.exampleZh: 这位荣誉退休教授仍然每周去看望他原来的系。

entries.example: Her grandparents decided to emigrate from Italy in the 1950s.
entries.exampleZh: 她的祖父母在二十世纪五十年代决定从意大利移居国外。

entries.meaning: 著名的，卓越的；杰出的，显赫的
entries.example: The eminent scholar gave a clear lecture on modern poetry.
entries.exampleZh: 这位著名学者做了一场关于现代诗歌的清晰讲座。

entries.example: The factory must reduce its carbon emission to protect the local air.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂必须减少碳排放以保护当地空气。

entries.meaning: 散发；发射；发出，射出，散发，排放
entries.example: These old machines emit a loud noise throughout the whole day.
entries.exampleZh: 这些旧机器整天发出很大的噪音。

entries.meaning: 感情；情绪；激动；感情；情绪
entries.example: She tried to hide her true emotion during the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她在会议期间试图隐藏自己真实的情绪。

entries.meaning: 感情的，情绪的；引起情感的，表示情感的；情绪激动的，易动感情的
entries.example: The film was so emotional that many viewers began to cry.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影如此感人，以至于许多观众开始哭泣。

entries.example: The ancient emperor ordered his workers to build a huge palace.
entries.exampleZh: 这位古代皇帝命令他的工人建造一座巨大的宫殿。

entries.example: Our teacher placed great emphasis on clear pronunciation and daily practice.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师非常强调清晰的发音和日常练习。

entries.meaning: 强调，加强的语气；强调，着重
entries.example: The coach will emphasize teamwork rather than individual success this season.
entries.exampleZh: 本赛季教练将强调团队合作而不是个人成功。

entries.example: The old empire grew strong through trade and careful diplomacy.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老帝国通过贸易和谨慎的外交变得强大。

entries.meaning: 经验主义的；经验主义的，以经验为依据的
entries.example: The report offers empirical evidence instead of simple personal opinion.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告提供经验证据，而不是简单的个人意见。

entries.example: Many small shops employ local students during the busy summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 许多小商店在繁忙的夏季雇用当地学生。

entries.example: Finding stable employment after graduation remains difficult for many young people.
entries.exampleZh: 毕业后找到稳定的工作对许多年轻人来说仍然困难。

entries.example: Young players often emulate the habits of their favorite sports stars.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻球员常常模仿他们最喜欢的体育明星的习惯。

entries.example: These new tools enable students to finish their projects much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新工具使学生能更快完成项目。

entries.example: The city will enact a new law to protect local parks.
entries.exampleZh: 该市将颁布一项新法律来保护当地公园。

entries.meaning: 装入胶囊；压缩；总结，概述
entries.example: Her brief speech could encapsulate the main idea of the report.
entries.exampleZh: 她简短的讲话能概括这份报告的主要观点。

entries.example: Workers will encase the pipes in thick foam for protection.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们将用厚泡沫把这些管道包起来加以保护。

entries.meaning: 把围起来，把封入信封；围住；附上；把…装入信封
entries.example: Please enclose a recent photo with your application form.
entries.exampleZh: 请随申请表附上一张近照。

entries.meaning: 围栏；附件；四周有篱笆的场地，围场；附件
entries.example: The sheep were moved into a safe enclosure near the barn.
entries.exampleZh: 羊群被转移到谷仓附近一个安全的围栏里。

entries.example: We need to encode these files before sending them online.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在把这些文件发到网上之前进行编码。

entries.example: The final exam will encompass all the topics we studied.
entries.exampleZh: 期末考试将涵盖我们学过的所有主题。

entries.meaning: 遭遇，意外地遇到；遭遇，遇到
entries.example: Their first encounter with the new teacher was quite friendly.
entries.exampleZh: 他们与新老师的第一次相遇相当友好。

entries.example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions during class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师应该鼓励学生在课堂上提问。

entries.meaning: 侵入，侵占，侵犯；侵蚀，蚕食
entries.example: New buildings must not encroach on the protected forest area.
entries.exampleZh: 新建筑不得侵占受保护的森林区域。

entries.example: She found the answer in an old encyclopedia at the library.
entries.exampleZh: 她在图书馆一本旧百科全书里找到了答案。

entries.example: The end of the movie made everyone in the room cry.
entries.exampleZh: 电影的结局让房间里的每个人都哭了。

entries.example: Careless campers can endanger wildlife by leaving food near tents.
entries.exampleZh: 粗心的露营者把食物留在帐篷附近会危及野生动物。

entries.example: The team's latest endeavor aims to improve clean water access.
entries.exampleZh: 该团队最近的努力旨在改善清洁水的获取。

entries.example: Despite many difficulties, their endeavour finally produced excellent results.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管有许多困难，他们的努力最终取得了优异成果。

entries.meaning: 背书，签署(姓名)，赞同；支持，赞同
entries.example: Several famous athletes endorse this brand of running shoes.
entries.exampleZh: 几位著名运动员为这个品牌的跑鞋代言。

entries.example: A wealthy family decided to endow the hospital with new equipment.
entries.exampleZh: 一个富裕的家庭决定向医院捐赠新设备。

entries.example: Long distance running requires great endurance and careful training.
entries.exampleZh: 长跑需要极强的耐力和细致的训练。

entries.example: The villagers had to endure a long, cold winter without electricity.
entries.exampleZh: 村民们不得不在没有电的情况下忍受漫长寒冷的冬天。

entries.meaning: 精力充沛的；精力旺盛的；有力的，精力旺盛的；积极的
entries.example: The energetic puppy ran around the garden for an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 那只精力充沛的小狗在花园里跑了一个小时。

entries.meaning: 强迫服从；实施；加强；实施，执行；强制，迫使
entries.example: The school must enforce its rules fairly and consistently.
entries.exampleZh: 学校必须公平且一贯地执行其规定。

entries.example: The new law will enfranchise thousands of young citizens.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律将赋予数千名年轻公民选举权。

entries.meaning: 雇用；从事；订婚；吸引；啮合；吸引；占用；使从事于，使忙于；雇用，聘用；与交战；啮合，衔接
entries.example: The teacher tried to engage every student in the discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 老师努力让每个学生都参与讨论。

entries.example: Their engagement surprised all of their closest friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的订婚让所有最亲近的朋友都感到惊讶。

entries.example: They will engrave her name on the silver cup.
entries.exampleZh: 他们会把她的名字刻在银杯上。

entries.meaning: 占用；吸引；使全神贯注，占去全部注意力和时间
entries.example: The mystery novel managed to engross her for hours.
entries.exampleZh: 那本悬疑小说让她全神贯注了好几个小时。

entries.meaning: 提高(强度、力量、数量等)，增加(进)；提高，增强，增进
entries.example: Regular exercise can enhance both mood and sleep quality.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼可以改善情绪和睡眠质量。

entries.example: This cream acts as a powerful enhancer of skin repair.
entries.exampleZh: 这种面霜是一种强效的皮肤修复增强剂。

entries.example: His sudden silence remained an enigma to everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 他突然沉默不语，对所有人来说仍是个谜。

entries.meaning: 令人愉快的，使人快乐的
entries.example: We had an enjoyable afternoon by the quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在安静的湖边度过了一个愉快的下午。

entries.example: Please enlarge this photo before you print it.
entries.exampleZh: 请你在打印之前把这张照片放大。

entries.meaning: 启发，开导；启发；开导；阐明
entries.example: The guide will enlighten us about the ancient ruins.
entries.exampleZh: 导游将向我们讲解这些古代遗址。

entries.example: He decided to enlist in the army after college.
entries.exampleZh: 他大学毕业后决定参军。

entries.meaning: 巨大的，庞大的；巨大的，庞大的，极大的
entries.example: An enormous crowd gathered outside the concert hall.
entries.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在音乐厅外面。

entries.meaning: 询问，打听；打听，询问；查问，调查
entries.example: I called to enquire about the train times.
entries.exampleZh: 我打电话询问了火车时刻。

entries.meaning: 询问，打听；询问；调查；探索

entries.exampleZh: 办公室收到了一份关于丢失包裹的询问。

entries.meaning: 使丰富，加料于，增进；充实，使丰富；使富裕

entries.exampleZh: 旅行能以意想不到的方式丰富你的人生。

entries.meaning: 招收，入伍，入学；入学；登记；加入；招收

entries.exampleZh: 她打算下个月报名参加一个烹饪班。

entries.meaning: 登记，入学；登记，注册；入学，入伍；登记簿，名册

entries.exampleZh: 大学预计今年秋季的入学人数会更多。

entries.example: The string ensemble will perform three short pieces at the town hall tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 弦乐合奏组今晚将在市政厅演奏三首短曲。

entries.example: Cruel rulers often try to enslave people through fear and empty promises.
entries.exampleZh: 残酷的统治者常常试图通过恐惧和空洞的承诺奴役人民。

entries.meaning: 跟着发生；结果是；继而发生；接着发生

entries.exampleZh: 如果没有人倾听另一方，激烈的争论可能会随之发生。

entries.example: Please check the list twice to ensure every name is spelled correctly.
entries.exampleZh: 请把名单核对两遍，以确保每个名字都拼写正确。

entries.example: This new project will entail long hours and careful planning from everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新项目将需要每个人投入长时间并做周密规划。

entries.example: Loose ropes can entangle swimmers near the rocky edge of the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 松散的绳子会缠住湖边岩石附近的游泳者。

entries.meaning: 艰巨的事业；事业心，企业；企业，公司；事业
entries.example: Her small enterprise now employs twelve people and serves three nearby towns.
entries.exampleZh: 她的小企业现在雇用了十二个人，并为附近三个城镇服务。

entries.example: Good hosts know how to entertain guests without spending too much money.
entries.exampleZh: 好的主人知道如何在不花太多钱的情况下招待客人。

entries.meaning: 娱乐，招待，表演；招待，款待；娱乐；供消遣的事物
entries.example: The festival offers live entertainment for families throughout the whole weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 这个节庆整个周末都为家庭提供现场娱乐表演。

entries.meaning: 娱乐，招待，表演；热情，热心，积极性；热衷的事物
entries.example: Her enthusiasm for science inspired many students to join the weekend club.
entries.exampleZh: 她对科学的热情激励了许多学生加入周末俱乐部。

entries.meaning: 热情的，热心的；热情的；热心的
entries.example: The coach was enthusiastic about our progress during the final practice match.
entries.exampleZh: 教练对我们最后一场练习赛中的进步充满热情。

entries.example: Bright window displays can entice shoppers to step inside the small bookstore.
entries.exampleZh: 明亮的橱窗展示会吸引购物者走进这家小书店。

entries.example: The entire team stayed late to finish the report before Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 整个团队都待到很晚，以便在周五早上之前完成报告。

entries.meaning: 给(书)题名；给予权利；给…权利；给题名；给…以称号
entries.example: This ticket will entitle you to a free drink and a small gift.
entries.exampleZh: 这张票将使你有权获得一杯免费饮料和一份小礼物。

entries.example: Each local branch is a separate legal entity with its own budget.
entries.exampleZh: 每个当地分支都是一个拥有自己预算的独立法律实体。

entries.example: She will entreat the manager for more time to complete the survey.
entries.exampleZh: 她会恳求经理多给她一些时间完成调查。

entries.meaning: [法]企业家, 演出承包人 "；企业家；承包人
entries.example: The young entrepreneur opened a small bakery and hired three local assistants.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的企业家开了一家小面包店，并雇了三名当地助手。

entries.example: Her entrepreneurial spirit helped the team turn a simple idea into a business.
entries.exampleZh: 她的创业精神帮助团队把一个简单的想法变成了生意。

entries.example: You can entrust the keys to your neighbor while you are away.
entries.exampleZh: 你外出时可以把钥匙托付给邻居。

entries.example: The museum charges no entry fee for children under twelve years old.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆对十二岁以下儿童不收入场费。

entries.example: The two vines entwine around the old wooden fence.
entries.exampleZh: 两根藤蔓缠绕在旧木栅栏上。

entries.example: We must protect the environment for our children and grandchildren.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。

entries.meaning: 想象；期望；设想；展望，想象；面对
entries.example: I cannot envisage a future without books and quiet evenings.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法设想一个没有书和安静夜晚的未来。

entries.example: Her calm smile filled me with quiet envy.
entries.exampleZh: 她平静的微笑让我暗暗羡慕。

entries.example: This enzyme helps break down sugar in the human body.
entries.exampleZh: 这种酶有助于分解人体内的糖。

entries.example: The beauty of cherry blossoms is brief and ephemeral.
entries.exampleZh: 樱花之美短暂而转瞬即逝。

entries.meaning: (疾病)流行性的，传染的；流行病，传染病
entries.example: The city closed its schools during the flu epidemic.
entries.exampleZh: 流感流行期间，这座城市关闭了学校。

entries.meaning: 一系列事件中的一个事件
entries.example: That strange episode changed the way we trust strangers.
entries.exampleZh: 那段奇怪的插曲改变了我们信任陌生人的方式。

entries.meaning: 偶然发生的，不定期的；由许多片段组成的，松散的
entries.example: His memory of childhood is episodic rather than continuous.
entries.exampleZh: 他对童年的记忆是零散的，而非连续的。

entries.example: Their rivalry may epitomise the struggle between old and new.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的竞争或许集中体现了新旧之间的斗争。

entries.example: The invention of printing opened a new epoch in history.
entries.exampleZh: 印刷术的发明开启了历史上的一个新纪元。

entries.meaning: 相等的，相等于，相等匹敌；相等的；比得上
entries.example: In a fair race, every runner should have an equal chance.
entries.exampleZh: 在一场公平的比赛中，每位跑者都应有平等的机会。

entries.meaning: 方程式，等式；方程式，等式；平衡；等同，相等
entries.example: The teacher wrote a simple equation on the whiteboard.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在白板上写了一个简单的方程式。

entries.example: The equator divides the earth into northern and southern halves.
entries.exampleZh: 赤道将地球分为北半球和南半球。

entries.example: The dancer kept her balance and maintained perfect equilibrium.
entries.exampleZh: 舞者保持平衡，维持着完美的均衡。

entries.meaning: 装备，配备；使有能力，使有准备
entries.example: We need to equip the new lab with modern tools.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要用现代工具装备新实验室。

entries.example: The workers checked all safety equipment before starting the job.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在开始工作前检查了所有安全设备。

entries.example: We seek an equitable solution that treats both sides fairly.
entries.exampleZh: 我们寻求一个公平对待双方的解决方案。

entries.meaning: 公平；公正；无固定利息的股票；公平，公正
entries.example: The company aims to promote equity in hiring and pay.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司旨在促进招聘和薪酬方面的公平。

entries.meaning: 相等的，相同；相等的，等量的；相等物，等价物
entries.example: One mile is roughly equivalent to one point six kilometres.
entries.exampleZh: 一英里大约相当于一点六公里。

entries.example: The manager gave an equivocal answer that left everyone confused.
entries.exampleZh: 经理给了一个模棱两可的回答，让每个人都感到困惑。

entries.example: The digital era has changed how we work and communicate.
entries.exampleZh: 数字时代改变了我们的工作和交流方式。

entries.example: Scientists hope to eradicate the disease within the next ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家希望在接下来的十年内根除这种疾病。

entries.example: Please erase the wrong answer before you write a new one.
entries.exampleZh: 请在写新答案之前擦掉错误答案。

entries.meaning: 建立，使竖立；直立的，竖直的
entries.example: Workers will erect a new fence around the garden this weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们这个周末会在花园周围竖起一道新栅栏。

entries.example: Heavy rain can erode the soil on steep hillsides.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨会侵蚀陡峭山坡上的土壤。

entries.example: Coastal erosion has destroyed several homes along this shore.
entries.exampleZh: 海岸侵蚀已经摧毁了这片海岸沿线的几处住宅。

entries.example: I need to run an errand before the bank closes.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要在银行关门前去办一件事。

entries.meaning: 古怪的，反复无常的，不稳定的
entries.example: His erratic driving worried everyone in the car.
entries.exampleZh: 他反复无常的驾驶让车里的每个人都很担心。

entries.example: The report contains erroneous data about last year's sales.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告包含了关于去年销售的错误数据。

entries.example: The volcano could erupt again without any clear warning.
entries.exampleZh: 这座火山可能在没有明确预警的情况下再次喷发。

entries.example: The eruption forced thousands of villagers to leave their homes.
entries.exampleZh: 这次喷发迫使数千名村民离开家园。

entries.meaning: 升级，逐渐发展；逐步增长或发展，逐步升级
entries.example: Small arguments can escalate into serious fights if nobody listens.
entries.exampleZh: 如果没有人倾听，小争论可能会升级为严重的打斗。

entries.example: She took the escalator to the second floor of the mall.
entries.exampleZh: 她乘自动扶梯去了商场的二楼。

entries.meaning: 护卫者；护航舰；护送，护卫
entries.example: A police escort led the team safely through the crowded streets.
entries.exampleZh: 一支警察护卫队带领球队安全穿过拥挤的街道。

entries.meaning: 文章，小品文，随笔；短文，文章；评论文
entries.example: She wrote a thoughtful essay about climate change for class.
entries.exampleZh: 她为课堂写了一篇关于气候变化的深思熟虑的文章。

entries.example: The essence of her argument is simple and clear.
entries.exampleZh: 她论点的本质简单明了。

entries.meaning: 本质(的)，必要(的)；本质的，基本的；必要的，必不可少的；极其重要的；要素；实质，本质；要点
entries.example: Clean water is essential for every community and living thing.
entries.exampleZh: 清洁水对每个社区和生物都至关重要。

entries.meaning: 建立，委任；安置；证实；确立；建立；确立；安置，使定居
entries.example: They plan to establish a small library in the village.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在村里建立一个小图书馆。

entries.meaning: 房地产；财产；个人财产，遗产；土地，地产，庄园
entries.example: The old estate now belongs to a local charity.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧庄园现在属于当地一家慈善机构。

entries.example: She is held in high esteem by all her colleagues at work.
entries.exampleZh: 她在工作中受到所有同事的高度尊重。

entries.meaning: n.；估计，估价；评价，估量；估计，估量；估价；评价['estImət]；估计，估量；估价；评价
entries.example: Experts estimate the repair will take about three weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 专家估计这次修理大约需要三周时间。

entries.example: His harsh words could estrange him from his closest friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他刻薄的话语可能会让他与最亲密的朋友疏远。

entries.example: Birds gather near the estuary where the river meets the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 鸟儿聚集在河流与大海交汇的河口附近。

entries.meaning: 永久的，不朽的，不停的；永恒的
entries.example: Their friendship seemed eternal, lasting through every hardship and joy.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的友谊似乎是永恒的，历经每一次艰难与欢乐。

entries.example: The singer's ethereal voice floated softly through the quiet hall.
entries.exampleZh: 歌手空灵的声音轻柔地飘荡在安静的大厅里。

entries.example: Many shoppers now ask whether their clothes were made in ethical ways.
entries.exampleZh: 如今许多购物者会询问他们的衣服是否以合乎道德的方式制作。

entries.example: The city celebrates many ethnic festivals throughout the year.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市全年庆祝许多民族节日。

entries.example: Good etiquette requires guests to thank their host before leaving.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的礼节要求客人在离开前向主人道谢。

entries.meaning: 撤离，疏散，排清；疏散；撤离
entries.example: Fire alarms forced everyone to evacuate the building within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 火警迫使所有人在几分钟内撤离大楼。

entries.example: The driver tried to evade the police by turning sharply.
entries.exampleZh: 司机试图急转弯来躲避警察。

entries.meaning: 估的价，定的值；评价，估价
entries.example: Teachers evaluate student progress at the end of each term.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评估学生的进步。

entries.example: The final evaluation will decide whether the project continues next year.
entries.exampleZh: 最终评估将决定这个项目明年是否继续。

entries.meaning: 使蒸发，使脱水，消失；蒸发；消失；不复存在
entries.example: The puddles evaporate quickly under the hot afternoon sun.
entries.exampleZh: 水坑在午后炎热的阳光下很快蒸发。

entries.meaning: 甚至还；平的，双数的；使平坦
entries.example: She did not even notice the small mistake on the page.
entries.exampleZh: 她甚至没有注意到页面上的那个小错误。

entries.example: The charity event raised enough money to rebuild the school.
entries.exampleZh: 这次慈善活动筹集到了足够的钱来重建学校。

entries.example: After many delays, the train eventually arrived two hours late.
entries.exampleZh: 经过多次延误，火车最终晚点两小时到达。

entries.example: They planted a tree as a sign of everlasting friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 他们种下一棵树，作为永恒友谊的象征。

entries.example: The landlord threatened to evict the family over unpaid rent.
entries.exampleZh: 房东威胁说因拖欠房租要把这家人赶走。

entries.example: Police found no evidence linking the suspect to the crime.
entries.exampleZh: 警方没有找到将该嫌疑人与此案联系起来的证据。

entries.example: The old photograph can evoke memories of my childhood summers.
entries.exampleZh: 这张老照片能唤起我童年夏天的回忆。

entries.meaning: 演变，进展，进化；进展；进化
entries.example: The evolution of language takes place over many centuries.
entries.exampleZh: 语言的演变历经许多个世纪。

entries.example: Small businesses must evolve quickly to survive in this market.
entries.exampleZh: 小企业必须迅速演变才能在这个市场生存下去。

entries.example: Shouting at him will only exacerbate the tension between you two.
entries.exampleZh: 对他大喊只会加剧你们两人之间的紧张关系。

entries.example: Please tell me the exact time of your arrival tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 请告诉我你明天到达的准确时间。

entries.example: Some reporters exaggerate the danger to make their stories more exciting.
entries.exampleZh: 有些记者夸大危险，让他们的报道更刺激。

entries.example: Doctors will examine the patient carefully before making any choice.
entries.exampleZh: 医生会在做出任何选择之前仔细检查这位病人。

entries.example: His constant complaints about the food exasperate everyone at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 他对食物的不断抱怨让晚餐时每个人都很恼火。

entries.example: Workers began to excavate the site last spring.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们去年春天开始挖掘这个遗址。

entries.example: The excavation of the ancient tomb took nearly three years.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古墓的发掘工作花了将近三年时间。

entries.example: The final cost may exceed our original budget by ten percent.
entries.exampleZh: 最终费用可能超出我们原来的预算百分之十。

entries.example: The mountain path was exceedingly steep and slippery after the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后那条山路极其陡峭湿滑。

entries.example: She seems to excel at solving difficult problems under pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 她似乎很擅长在压力下解决难题。

entries.example: Your presentation yesterday was excellent and the audience loved it.
entries.exampleZh: 你昨天的演讲非常精彩，观众都很喜欢。

entries.example: Everyone except Tom agreed to the new plan immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 除了汤姆，每个人都立刻同意了这个新计划。

entries.meaning: 异常的，优越的；例外的；异常的
entries.example: Her performance in the final was exceptional for such a young player.
entries.exampleZh: 对于一个这么年轻的选手来说，她在决赛中的表现非常出色。

entries.example: The teacher read a short excerpt from the novel aloud.
entries.exampleZh: 老师大声朗读了小说中的一小段摘录。

entries.meaning: 超越；超过；暴行；额外的，附加的；过量的，额外的；超越；过量['ekses]
entries.example: Cut away the excess fat before cooking the meat.
entries.exampleZh: 烹饪这块肉之前先把多余的脂肪切掉。

entries.example: The hotel charges excessive prices during the holiday season.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店在假期期间收取过高的价格。

entries.meaning: 交换；兑换；交换，调换；交易；兑换；交流；谈话，争论；交换，调换；交易；兑换；交流
entries.example: We agreed to exchange gifts at the end of the term.
entries.exampleZh: 我们约定在学期末交换礼物。

entries.meaning: 激动；兴奋；令人兴奋的事
entries.example: The children screamed with excitement when the fireworks lit up the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 烟花照亮夜空时，孩子们激动地尖叫起来。

entries.example: I heard him exclaim in surprise when he opened the box.
entries.exampleZh: 我听到他打开盒子时惊讶地叫了一声。

entries.meaning: 把某人排除在外，排除(可能性等)；把…排斥在外；将排除，不包括
entries.example: The rules exclude anyone who arrives after the race has started.
entries.exampleZh: 规则把比赛开始后才到达的人排除在外。

entries.meaning: 孤傲的；不愿吸收新会员的；索价高昂的；奢华的；独有的；
entries.example: The designer's exclusive collection is sold in only three shops.
entries.exampleZh: 这位设计师的独家系列只在三家商店出售。

entries.meaning: 专门地，排除其他地；专有地，专门地
entries.example: The room is used exclusively for meetings and never for storage.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间专门用于开会，从不用于存放东西。

entries.example: Farmers use animal excrement as a natural fertilizer on their fields.
entries.exampleZh: 农民把动物粪便当作天然肥料施在田里。

entries.example: Scientists tested the excreta of the birds for signs of disease.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家检测了这些鸟的排泄物，以寻找疾病的迹象。

entries.meaning: 远足，短途旅行；远足，短途旅游；【物】 偏移，漂移
entries.example: Our class went on a day excursion to the ancient castle.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班去那座古堡做了一日短途旅行。

entries.meaning: 可原谅的；可谅解的；可容许的
entries.example: Forgetting one name at a party is quite excusable.
entries.exampleZh: 在聚会上忘记一个人的名字是相当可以原谅的。

entries.meaning: 实行，贯彻，实施；处死；演奏；将…处死；实施，执行
entries.example: The team must execute the plan exactly as the manager described.
entries.exampleZh: 团队必须完全按照经理描述的方式执行这个计划。

entries.meaning: 演奏技巧；死刑；执行，实施；处决
entries.example: Her execution of the piano piece impressed the whole audience.
entries.exampleZh: 她对那首钢琴曲的演奏让全场观众印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 执行的，行政的；行政部门，行政人员
entries.example: The company executive answered questions from reporters after the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 会议结束后，这位公司高管回答了记者的提问。

entries.meaning: 举例说明，作为的例证；作为…的典型；例证，举例说明
entries.example: These old houses exemplify the style of the early century.
entries.exampleZh: 这些老房子体现了那个世纪初的风格。

entries.example: Students with a medical note are exempt from the final test.

entries.example: You must exert more effort if you want better results.
