entries.exampleZh: 你可以在客人到来前随意摆放椅子。

entries.example: We heard a wolf howl somewhere deep in the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 我们听到森林深处有只狼在嚎叫。

entries.example: The hubbub in the crowded hall made conversation almost impossible.
entries.exampleZh: 拥挤大厅里的喧哗声让交谈几乎不可能。

entries.meaning: 挤作一团，乱堆；一堆，一团；聚集在一起；杂乱的一堆；拥挤
entries.example: The children huddle together under a blanket during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨中孩子们裹着毯子挤在一起。

entries.example: She gave her brother a quick hug at the airport.
entries.exampleZh: 她在机场匆匆拥抱了弟弟一下。

entries.meaning: 嗡嗡叫，嘈杂声；哼曲子；发嗡嗡声；嗡嗡声，嘈杂声
entries.example: The machines hum softly in the background all day.
entries.exampleZh: 机器整天在背景中轻轻发出嗡嗡声。

entries.meaning: 善良的，人道的，仁慈的，慈悲的；促进文明或教化的，人文的
entries.example: The shelter provides humane care for injured animals and birds.
entries.exampleZh: 收容所为受伤的动物和鸟类提供人道的照料。

entries.example: The school offers a humanistic approach to teaching history and art.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校在历史与艺术教学中采用人文主义方法。

entries.meaning: 人类；仁慈，仁爱；人类，人；人性；人道，仁慈；
entries.example: Climate change is a serious threat to all humanity.
entries.exampleZh: 气候变化对全人类构成严重威胁。

entries.meaning: 谦卑的，恭顺的，简陋的；使卑下，贬抑；谦逊的，谦虚的；地位低下的，卑贱的；简陋的，低劣的；使谦恭；使卑下；贬低
entries.example: His humble manner makes him popular among his coworkers.
entries.exampleZh: 他谦逊的态度使他在同事中很受欢迎。

entries.example: Her humdrum daily routine leaves little room for excitement.
entries.exampleZh: 她单调的日常安排几乎没有留下兴奋的空间。

entries.meaning: 湿的，潮湿的，湿润的，多潮气的
entries.example: The air feels hot and humid before a summer storm.
entries.exampleZh: 夏季暴风雨来临前空气又热又潮湿。

entries.meaning: 湿气，空气湿度；湿度；潮湿
entries.example: High humidity makes the heat feel much worse in summer.
entries.exampleZh: 高湿度使夏天的炎热感觉更难受。

entries.example: Please do not humiliate him in front of his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要在他朋友面前羞辱他。

entries.example: Her sharp humour makes even boring meetings feel enjoyable.
entries.exampleZh: 她敏锐的幽默让即使无聊的会议也变得愉快。

entries.example: The biggest hurdle to our plan is finding enough money.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划最大的障碍是筹集足够的资金。

entries.meaning: 猛掷，猛投；猛投，猛摔；大声叫骂
entries.example: Angry fans began to hurl bottles onto the football field.
entries.exampleZh: 愤怒的球迷开始把瓶子扔向足球场。

entries.example: The hurricane destroyed many homes along the eastern coast last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚飓风摧毁了东海岸的许多房屋。

entries.meaning: 杂交产生的；混合的，合成的；杂交生成的生物体，杂交植物；杂种，混血儿；混合物，合成物
entries.example: The farmer created a hybrid plant that grows faster than either parent.
entries.exampleZh: 这位农民培育出一种比任一亲本生长更快的杂交植物。

entries.example: Scientists are testing hydrogen as a clean fuel for future buses.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家正在测试氢气作为未来公交车的清洁燃料。

entries.example: Good hygiene in the kitchen helps prevent food from making people sick.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房里的良好卫生有助于防止食物让人生病。

entries.example: The speaker's slow, hypnotic voice made the whole audience feel sleepy.
entries.exampleZh: 演讲者缓慢而催眠的声音让全场观众感到困倦。

entries.meaning: (逻辑)前提，假说；假设，假定；假说；猜想
entries.example: Our hypothesis explains the strange results better than the old theory.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的假说比旧理论更好地解释了这些奇怪的结果。

entries.meaning: 假设的，假定的；爱猜想的
entries.example: Please consider a hypothetical case where the company loses all its data.
entries.exampleZh: 请设想一个公司丢失所有数据的假设情况。

entries.meaning: 歇斯底里的, 狂热的
entries.example: She became hysterical when she heard the terrible news about her brother.
entries.exampleZh: 听到关于她兄弟的可怕消息时，她变得歇斯底里。

entries.meaning: 理想的事物；理想；完美的，理想的；理想的，完美的；理想主义的；空想的；唯心的；理想；理想的东西
entries.example: This quiet cafe is an ideal place to study for tomorrow's exam.
entries.exampleZh: 这家安静的咖啡馆是准备明天考试的理想场所。

entries.meaning: 同一的，完全相似的；完全相同的，同一的
entries.example: The twins wore identical coats, so I could not tell them apart.
entries.exampleZh: 那对双胞胎穿着完全相同的外套，所以我分不清他们。

entries.meaning: 可辨认的，可识别的；可确定的，可证明是同一的
entries.example: The suspect was clearly identifiable from the security camera footage.
entries.exampleZh: 从监控录像中可以清楚地辨认出那名嫌疑人。

entries.meaning: 认出，识别；身分证明；身份证明；识别，鉴定
entries.example: Please bring a photo identification card to the front desk tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 请明天带一张带照片的身份证明卡到前台。

entries.meaning: 认出，认为与一致；认出，识别；辨别；查明；确定；视…为同一事物
entries.example: Can you identify the man standing near the main entrance?
entries.exampleZh: 你能认出站在正门附近的那个男人吗？

entries.meaning: 身份; 同一; 一致；特性；身份；特性；同一性
entries.example: Her true identity remained a secret for more than ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 她的真实身份十多年来一直是个秘密。

entries.meaning: 思想，思想体系，意识形态
entries.example: The party's ideology shaped many of the country's new education policies.
entries.exampleZh: 该党的意识形态塑造了这个国家许多新的教育政策。

entries.example: Learning a new idiom every day can make your speech sound natural.
entries.exampleZh: 每天学一个新习语能让你的讲话听起来自然。

entries.example: I felt like an idiot when I forgot my own password again.
entries.exampleZh: 当我又忘记自己的密码时，我觉得自己像个白痴。

entries.meaning: 闲着的，空闲的；懒的；无根据的；虚度
entries.example: The machine sat idle for weeks because no one knew how to fix it.
entries.exampleZh: 这台机器闲置了几周，因为没人知道怎么修它。

entries.example: A single spark can ignite the dry grass during a hot summer.
entries.exampleZh: 一颗火星就能在炎热的夏天点燃干草。

entries.meaning: 无知，愚昧；无知，愚昧；不知道
entries.example: His ignorance of basic safety rules caused a serious accident at work.
entries.exampleZh: 他对基本安全规则的无知导致了工作中一起严重事故。

entries.example: It is dangerous to be ignorant of the law when running a business.
entries.exampleZh: 经营企业时对法律无知是危险的。

entries.example: Please ignore the noise and focus on your work.
entries.exampleZh: 请别理会噪音，专心工作。

entries.example: It is illegal to park your car here.
entries.exampleZh: 在这里停车是违法的。

entries.example: The old man was illiterate and could not read signs.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人是文盲，看不懂标牌。

entries.meaning: 照亮；用灯装饰；阐明；照亮；阐明，解释；启发
entries.example: Bright lamps illuminate the entire hall during the concert.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会上明亮的灯照亮了整个大厅。

entries.meaning: 幻象，错觉；幻想中的事物，错误的观念；错觉，幻觉，假象
entries.example: The mirror creates an illusion that the room is larger.
entries.exampleZh: 镜子造成一种房间更大的错觉。

entries.meaning: 举例或以图表说明，配以插图；说明，举例说明，阐明；给…作插图说明
entries.example: The teacher used simple charts to illustrate her main point.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用简单的图表来说明她的主要观点。

entries.example: This book has a useful illustration on every page.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书每一页都有一幅有用的插图。

entries.example: The company wants to improve its public image this year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司今年想改善其公众形象。

entries.example: Children often use their imagination to create secret worlds.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们常用想象力创造秘密世界。

entries.meaning: 想象的，有想象力的；富有想象力的；创新的
entries.example: She wrote an imaginative story about a talking robot.
entries.exampleZh: 她写了一个关于会说话机器人的富有想象力的故事。

entries.example: Can you imagine living without your phone for a week?
entries.exampleZh: 你能想象一周不用手机的生活吗？

entries.meaning: 模仿，模拟，看似；模仿，模拟；仿效
entries.example: Young children often imitate the words their parents say.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿常模仿父母说的话。

entries.meaning: 模仿，仿造，仿制品，人造；模仿；仿造；仿制品，假货，赝品
entries.example: The bag is a cheap imitation of a famous brand.
entries.exampleZh: 这个包是一个著名品牌的廉价仿制品。

entries.meaning: 立即，马上；紧接地；直接地
entries.example: Please call me immediately if you receive any bad news.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你收到任何坏消息，请立即打电话给我。

entries.meaning: 广大的，巨大的；巨大的，广大的
entries.example: The project required an immense amount of time and money.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目需要大量的时间和金钱。

entries.example: The teacher asked us to immerse ourselves in the story.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们沉浸在故事中。

entries.example: The young immigrant found a job in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻移民在城里找到了一份工作。

entries.example: The government is reviewing its immigration rules this year.
entries.exampleZh: 政府今年正在审查其移民规定。

entries.example: Dark clouds suggest that a storm is imminent tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云表明今晚一场暴风雨即将来临。

entries.meaning: 免除的；安全的，不受影响的；免疫的，有免疫力的；有抵抗力的；不受影响的；免除的，免除惩罚的，豁免的
entries.example: Regular exercise can help you stay immune to stress.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能帮助你保持不受压力影响。

entries.meaning: 碰撞，撞击，撞击力；影响，作用；冲击
entries.example: The new policy had a strong impact on small businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策对小企业产生了很大的影响。

entries.example: Loud music can impair your hearing over time.
entries.exampleZh: 嘈杂的音乐久而久之会损害你的听力。

entries.meaning: 告知，透露，给予；给予，赋予；传授；告知，透露
entries.example: Teachers impart knowledge and skills to their students.
entries.exampleZh: 教师向学生传授知识与技能。

entries.example: Heavy snow may impede traffic on the mountain roads.
entries.exampleZh: 大雪可能会阻碍山路上的交通。

entries.meaning: 紧急的，必要的，强制的，祈使语气
entries.example: It is imperative that we finish the report by Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在周五之前完成这份报告。

entries.example: The museum displays treasures from the imperial court of China.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出中国宫廷的珍宝。

entries.example: Careless logging can imperil the survival of rare animals.
entries.exampleZh: 滥伐可能危及珍稀动物的生存。

entries.meaning: 动力，原动力，推动，激励；推动，促进，刺激；推动力
entries.example: The award gave her fresh impetus to continue her research.
entries.exampleZh: 这个奖项给了她继续研究的新动力。

entries.meaning: 工具，器具；贯彻，履行；使生效，实施；贯彻，执行['ImplImənt]；工具
entries.example: We plan to implement the new rules next month.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划下个月实施这些新规定。

entries.meaning: 含意；暗示，暗指；卷入，牵连
entries.example: The implication of his remark was clear to everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 他这番话的含义每个人都清楚。

entries.meaning: 含蓄的，暗示的，无保留的
entries.example: Her silence gave implicit approval to the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她的沉默表示默许了这个计划。

entries.meaning: 把…强加于；征(税)，利用；把…强加于；征；处以
entries.example: The government may impose new taxes on imported cars.
entries.exampleZh: 政府可能会对进口汽车征收新税。

entries.example: The cathedral is an imposing building with tall towers.
entries.exampleZh: 这座大教堂是一座有高塔的雄伟建筑。

entries.example: It is impossible to finish this work in one day.
entries.exampleZh: 一天之内完成这项工作是不可能的。

entries.example: Heavy debts can impoverish even a wealthy family.
entries.exampleZh: 沉重的债务甚至能让富裕的家庭变得贫困。

entries.meaning: 穷困的，赤贫的；贫乏的，贫瘠的；枯竭的
entries.example: The charity helps impoverished children in rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构帮助农村地区的贫困儿童。

entries.example: His answer was imprecise and left us confused.
entries.exampleZh: 他的回答不精确，让我们很困惑。

entries.meaning: 给…留下深刻印象，使铭记；印，压印；印记
entries.example: The young pianist managed to impress every judge.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻钢琴家设法给每位评委留下了深刻印象。

entries.example: My first impression of the city was very positive.
entries.exampleZh: 我对这座城市的第一印象非常好。

entries.meaning: 给人深刻印象的，惊人的；给人深刻印象的，令人敬佩的
entries.example: The team gave an impressive performance in the final match.
entries.exampleZh: 这支队伍在决赛中表现得令人赞叹。

entries.example: Her impromptu speech at the ceremony charmed every guest.
entries.exampleZh: 她在典礼上的即兴演讲让每位宾客都很喜欢。

entries.example: Regular practice can improve your speaking skills over several months.
entries.exampleZh: 经常练习可以在几个月内提高你的口语能力。

entries.meaning: 改进，进步；改进措施；改进处
entries.example: The new training plan led to a clear improvement in team morale.
entries.exampleZh: 新的培训计划使团队士气有了明显改善。

entries.example: When the script was lost, the actors had to improvise.
entries.exampleZh: 剧本丢失后，演员们不得不即兴表演。

entries.meaning: 推动，冲力，冲动；冲动，突如其来的念头；刺激，驱使；脉冲
entries.example: He bought the expensive watch on impulse and regretted it later.
entries.exampleZh: 他一时冲动买了那块昂贵的手表，后来后悔了。

entries.example: She paid the fee in cash at the local store.
entries.exampleZh: 她在当地商店用现金支付了费用。

entries.example: The old account remained inactive for nearly two years.
entries.exampleZh: 那个旧账户近两年一直处于不活跃状态。

entries.example: The lighting was inadequate for reading the small print.
entries.exampleZh: 灯光不足以看清小字。

entries.meaning: 不可剥夺的，不可分割的
entries.example: Freedom of speech is an inalienable right in many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 言论自由在许多国家是一项不可剥夺的权利。

entries.example: His inapt remark made the whole meeting rather awkward.
entries.exampleZh: 他那句不恰当的话让整个会议相当尴尬。

entries.meaning: 为举行就职典礼，为展览会揭幕，开创；开始，开创；为…举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕式；为…举行落成仪式
entries.example: The mayor will inaugurate the new library next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 市长将于下周一上午为新图书馆举行落成典礼。

entries.example: She has an inborn talent for music and art.
entries.exampleZh: 她在音乐和艺术方面有天赋。

entries.meaning: 使无能力；使伤残；使不适合；使无资格
entries.example: The sudden injury could incapacitate him for several weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 这次突然受伤可能使他数周无法行动。

entries.meaning: 放火的，能引起燃烧的；煽动性的
entries.example: The police found an incendiary device near the empty warehouse.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在空仓库附近发现了一个燃烧装置。

entries.meaning: 鼓励，激励，动机；刺激；激励
entries.example: The bonus gave workers a strong incentive to finish early.
entries.exampleZh: 奖金给了工人们尽早完成的强烈动力。

entries.example: The incidence of flu rises during the cold winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 流感的发生率在寒冷的冬季会上升。

entries.example: The police are investigating a strange incident at the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 警方正在调查火车站发生的一起奇怪事件。

entries.example: Incidentally, I saw your brother at the market yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 顺便说一下，我昨天在市场看见你哥哥了。

entries.example: The factory must incinerate all hazardous waste safely and quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂必须安全迅速地焚化所有危险废物。

entries.example: Doctors can often treat an incipient disease before symptoms appear.
entries.exampleZh: 医生通常能在症状出现前治疗早期疾病。

entries.example: Angry speeches can incite people to break the law.
entries.exampleZh: 愤怒的演讲可能煽动人们违法。

entries.meaning: 倾向，意愿；爱好；趋势；倾斜
entries.example: She has little inclination to attend the meeting tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 她今晚不太愿意参加会议。

entries.meaning: 低头，屈身，倾斜，倾向于；斜坡，斜面
entries.example: The path begins to incline sharply after the bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 过了桥后，小路开始陡然倾斜。

entries.example: Our price will include breakfast and free airport transport.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的价格将包括早餐和免费机场接送。

entries.meaning: 包括的，包含的；包括一切费用在内的；所有数目包括在内的；包容广阔的
entries.example: The tour price is inclusive of meals and local transport.
entries.exampleZh: 旅游价格包含餐食和当地交通。

entries.example: The incoming flight was delayed by heavy snow.
entries.exampleZh: 进港航班因大雪而延误。

entries.meaning: 不兼容的，不能和谐共存的，不协调的，合不来的
entries.example: These two software versions are incompatible with each other.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个软件版本彼此不兼容。

entries.meaning: 不和谐，不相称；不协调或不一致的事物
entries.example: The incongruity between his words and actions surprised everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 他言行之间的不一致让所有人都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 不适宜的；不协调的，不一致的；不适宜的
entries.example: His loud laughter seemed incongruous in the quiet library.
entries.exampleZh: 他响亮的笑声在安静的图书馆里显得很不协调。

entries.meaning: 结合，合并，组成公司；把…合并，纳入；包含，吸收
entries.example: We will incorporate your suggestions into the final plan.
entries.exampleZh: 我们会把你的建议纳入最终计划。

entries.meaning: 难以置信的，惊人的；不可信的；难以置信的
entries.example: The view from the mountain top was simply incredible.
entries.exampleZh: 山顶的景色简直令人难以置信。

entries.example: Each yearly increment in salary was small but welcome.
entries.exampleZh: 每年的工资增幅虽小，却令人高兴。

entries.example: Parents should inculcate good habits in their children early.
entries.exampleZh: 父母应尽早向孩子反复灌输良好习惯。

entries.meaning: 招致; 遭受；招致，遭受
entries.example: You may incur extra fees if you cancel late.
entries.exampleZh: 如果取消得晚，你可能会被收取额外费用。

entries.meaning: 模糊的，不明确的，无定限的
entries.example: The project has been postponed for an indefinite period.
entries.exampleZh: 该项目已被无限期推迟。

entries.example: The accident left an indelible mark on her memory.
entries.exampleZh: 那场事故在她记忆中留下了不可磨灭的印记。

entries.example: The insurance policy offers indemnity against fire damage.
entries.exampleZh: 这份保险单提供火灾损失赔偿。

entries.example: The country celebrated its independence with a huge parade.
entries.exampleZh: 该国以盛大游行庆祝独立。

entries.meaning: 独立的，自主的，不受约束的；中立派，无党派议员
entries.example: She works as an independent consultant for several companies.
entries.exampleZh: 她为几家公司担任独立顾问。

entries.meaning: 标示，表示，表明；象征；暗示，示意
entries.example: The signs indicate that the road is closed ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 标志表明前方道路封闭。

entries.example: The dark clouds were a clear indication that a storm was coming.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云是暴风雨即将来临的明显迹象。

entries.example: Rising prices are often indicative of a growing demand for housing.
entries.exampleZh: 物价上涨往往表明住房需求正在增长。

entries.example: The unemployment rate is a useful indicator of the economy's health.
entries.exampleZh: 失业率是衡量经济健康状况的一个有用指标。

entries.meaning: 不感兴趣的，不关心的，质量不高的；冷漠的，不关心的
entries.example: She seemed indifferent to the criticism and continued with her work.
entries.exampleZh: 她似乎对批评漠不关心，继续做自己的工作。

entries.meaning: 土生土长的，本土的；土产的，本地的，本土的
entries.example: These plants are indigenous to the mountains of southern China.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物原产于中国南方的山区。

entries.example: He was indignant when they accused him of cheating on the test.
entries.exampleZh: 当他们指责他考试作弊时，他感到愤慨。

entries.example: Clean water is indispensable for good health and daily life.
entries.exampleZh: 清洁的水对健康和日常生活必不可少。

entries.meaning: 个人的，个别的；个体的；个人，个体；个别的，单独的；独特的
entries.example: Each individual student receives personal feedback from the teacher every week.
entries.exampleZh: 每位学生每周都会收到老师的个人反馈。

entries.meaning: 懒惰的，倦怠的；不活跃的，无行动的
entries.example: The indolent cat slept in the sun all afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 那只懒散的猫整个下午都在阳光下睡觉。

entries.meaning: 导致；引起；引诱，劝使；引起，导致；感应
entries.example: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 什么也不能促使他改变关于这次旅行的想法。

entries.example: Her induction into the hall of fame took place last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她入选名人堂的仪式于昨晚举行。

entries.example: The scientist used inductive reasoning to form a general theory.
entries.exampleZh: 这位科学家运用归纳推理形成了一个普遍理论。

entries.meaning: 放纵，沉迷于；沉溺于，纵情于；满足；放纵，听任
entries.example: On weekends, she likes to indulge in a long, relaxing bath.
entries.exampleZh: 周末她喜欢尽情享受一次长时间的放松沐浴。

entries.example: The government plans to industrialise the rural region over the next decade.
entries.exampleZh: 政府计划在未来十年内使这个农村地区工业化。

entries.example: The industrious farmer worked from dawn until dusk every day.
entries.exampleZh: 那位勤劳的农民每天从黎明一直工作到黄昏。

entries.example: His inept handling of the situation made the problem much worse.
entries.exampleZh: 他对这一情况的笨拙处理使问题变得更糟。

entries.example: The inert gas filled the glass tube and prevented any reaction.
entries.exampleZh: 这种惰性气体充满了玻璃管，阻止了任何反应。

entries.example: The train slowed down slowly because of its great inertia.
entries.exampleZh: 由于巨大的惯性，火车缓慢地减速了。

entries.example: It was an inescapable fact that the old bridge needed repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧桥需要维修是一个无法逃避的事实。

entries.meaning: 不可避免的，照例必有的；不可避免的，必然的
entries.example: After months of heavy rain, flooding in the valley seemed inevitable.
entries.exampleZh: 在大雨持续数月之后，山谷里的洪水似乎不可避免。

entries.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms during the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 长途旅行中，婴儿安静地睡在母亲怀里。

entries.example: A single cough can infect several people in a crowded room.
entries.exampleZh: 一声咳嗽就可能在一个拥挤的房间里传染给好几个人。

entries.meaning: 传染，感染，侵染，传播；传染病
entries.example: The doctor said the infection should clear up after a week.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说感染应该会在一周后消退。

entries.example: The school closed early because several children had an infectious disease.
entries.exampleZh: 因为好几个孩子得了传染病，学校提前停课了。

entries.example: We can infer from his silence that he did not agree.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以从他的沉默推断出他并不同意。

entries.meaning: 推论, 推断 "；推论；推断
entries.example: Her conclusion was based on a careful inference from the available facts.
entries.exampleZh: 她的结论是基于对现有事实的仔细推断。

entries.example: The study uses inferential statistics to test the main hypothesis.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究使用推断统计来检验主要假设。

entries.meaning: 地位(能力)低的人；劣质的,差的,下等的"；较差的，次的，低劣的；级别低的，较低的；下级；下属，晚辈
entries.example: He felt inferior to his older brother in almost every subject.
entries.exampleZh: 几乎在每个科目上，他都觉得自己不如哥哥。

entries.meaning: 大批出动，成群出现(鼠类及害虫)
entries.example: Rats began to infest the old warehouse near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 老鼠开始大批出没于河边那座旧仓库。

entries.meaning: 悄悄进入，潜入；渗入，渗透
entries.example: The spies tried to infiltrate the enemy camp before dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 间谍们试图在黎明前潜入敌营。

entries.example: The universe may be infinite, but our knowledge of it is limited.
entries.exampleZh: 宇宙也许是无限的，但我们对它的了解是有限的。

entries.example: The injured player was carried to the school infirmary immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 受伤的球员立刻被抬到了学校医务室。

entries.example: Despite his age and infirmity, he still walks to the market daily.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管年事已高且身体虚弱，他仍然每天步行去市场。

entries.example: Workers stored the inflammable liquid in a cool, dry place.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们把这种易燃液体存放在阴凉干燥的地方。

entries.meaning: 使充气，使膨胀；使得意，使骄傲；抬高，使膨胀
entries.example: He used a small pump to inflate the tires before the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 出发前，他用一个小打气筒给轮胎充了气。

entries.example: Rising inflation has made everyday food much more expensive for families.
entries.exampleZh: 不断上升的通货膨胀使日常食品对家庭来说贵了很多。

entries.meaning: 使遭受，强加；把…强加给，使遭受，使承受
entries.example: The storm may inflict serious damage on the coastal villages tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚这场风暴可能会给沿海村庄造成严重破坏。

entries.meaning: 影响(力)，感化(力)，有影响的人或事；影响(力)，作用；影响，对…起作用
entries.example: Her teacher had a strong influence on her decision to study medicine.
entries.exampleZh: 她的老师对她决定学医有很大影响。

entries.example: She became an influential writer after publishing her first novel.
entries.exampleZh: 出版第一部小说后，她成了一位有影响力的作家。

entries.example: The patient stayed home for a week because of influenza.
entries.exampleZh: 那位病人因为流行性感冒在家待了一周。

entries.example: The small town struggled to handle the sudden influx of summer tourists.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小镇难以应对夏季游客的突然涌入。

entries.example: Please inform the manager about the change in tomorrow's schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 请通知经理明天日程的变动。

entries.meaning: 提供消息或情报的人，线人；提供资料的人
entries.example: The journalist protected her informant for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 那名记者多年来一直保护她的线人。

entries.example: The city spent millions improving its aging infrastructure last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年这座城市花费数百万改善老化的基础设施。

entries.meaning: 触犯；违反，侵害；侵犯，侵害；违背，触犯；干涉，干扰
entries.example: The new rules may infringe on students' freedom of speech.
entries.exampleZh: 新规定可能会侵犯学生的言论自由。

entries.meaning: 机灵的；制作精巧的，灵巧的
entries.example: She found an ingenious way to fix the broken machine.
entries.exampleZh: 她找到了一个巧妙的方法来修好这台坏掉的机器。

entries.meaning: (混合物的)组成部分，配料；组成部分，成分；原料；要素，因素
entries.example: Fresh basil is the key ingredient in this simple pasta dish.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜罗勒是这道简单意面菜肴的关键配料。

entries.example: Rare birds inhabit the forests along this quiet northern coast.
entries.exampleZh: 珍稀鸟类栖息在这条安静的北部海岸沿线的森林里。

entries.meaning: 居民；居民，住户，居住者；栖息的动物
entries.example: Every inhabitant of the island knows the old lighthouse keeper.
entries.exampleZh: 岛上的每一位居民都认识那位老灯塔看守人。

entries.example: Do not inhale the fumes from that cleaning liquid.
entries.exampleZh: 不要吸入那种清洁液散发的气体。

entries.meaning: 固有的；内在的；生来就有的
entries.example: There is an inherent risk in climbing mountains without a guide.
entries.exampleZh: 没有向导就爬山存在固有的风险。

entries.meaning: 继承，经遗传而得(特性等)
entries.example: She will inherit her grandmother's small house next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 明年春天她将继承她祖母的小房子。

entries.meaning: 遗传；继承，继承物；遗产，遗赠
entries.example: He used his inheritance to start a small coffee business.
entries.exampleZh: 他用他的遗产开了一家小咖啡店。

entries.meaning: 禁止，抑制；阻止；抑制，约束；起抑制作用
entries.example: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these tropical plants.
entries.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会抑制这些热带植物的生长。

entries.meaning: 不近人情的，残忍的，不人道的
entries.example: Keeping animals in such tiny cages is clearly inhumane.
entries.exampleZh: 把动物关在如此狭小的笼子里显然是不人道的。

entries.meaning: 最初的；人名的首字母；签名首字母于；最初的，开始的；词首的；词首大写字母
entries.example: Her initial reaction to the news was complete surprise.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这条消息的最初反应是完全惊讶。

entries.meaning: 创始，着手，介绍某人为(会员等)；开始，创造，发起；接纳，让…加入；加入组织者
entries.example: The company plans to initiate a new training program in June.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划在六月启动一项新的培训项目。

entries.meaning: 发端，创始，主动性；倡议，新方案；主动性，积极性；主动权
entries.example: She took the initiative and organized a cleanup of the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 她主动带头组织了一次海滩清理活动。

entries.meaning: 注射；注入，灌入；注射；注入，灌输
entries.example: The nurse will inject the vaccine into your left arm.
entries.exampleZh: 护士会把疫苗注射到你的左臂。

entries.meaning: 内地的，内陆的；在内地，向内地；向内地；内陆的[ˌIn'lænd]
entries.example: They drove inland to escape the storm along the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 他们开车向内陆行驶以躲避沿海的风暴。

entries.example: The small boat waited near the narrow inlet at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 黎明时分，小船在狭窄的水湾附近等候。

entries.meaning: 无罪的，无害的，天真的；天真无邪的人；清白的；无害的；天真的
entries.example: The court finally declared the young man innocent of all charges.
entries.exampleZh: 法庭最终宣布这名年轻男子所有指控均不成立。

entries.example: Her latest innovation won praise from engineers across the country.
entries.exampleZh: 她最新的创新赢得了全国工程师的赞扬。

entries.meaning: 革新的，创新的，新颖的；富有革新精神的
entries.example: The company introduced an innovative system to reduce daily water use.
entries.exampleZh: 公司推出了一套创新系统来减少日常用水。

entries.example: The night sky showed innumerable stars above the quiet desert.
entries.exampleZh: 夜空在寂静的沙漠上方展现出无数星星。

entries.meaning: 投入，输入；输入的数据；把…输入计算机
entries.example: Please provide your input before the final plan is approved.
entries.exampleZh: 请在最终方案获批前提供你的意见。

entries.example: I called the hotel to inquire about available rooms next week.
entries.exampleZh: 我打电话给酒店询问下周是否有空房。

entries.meaning: 愚蠢的; 疯狂的；蠢极的，荒唐的；精神病的，精神失常的，疯狂的
entries.example: It seems insane to drive through the storm without any lights.
entries.exampleZh: 在暴风雨中不开任何灯开车似乎很疯狂。

entries.example: They will inscribe the winner's name on the silver cup.
entries.exampleZh: 他们将在银杯上刻下获胜者的名字。

entries.example: The ladder felt insecure against the rough stone wall.
entries.exampleZh: 梯子靠在粗糙的石墙上感觉不牢靠。

entries.meaning: 插入；插入物，插页；插入，嵌入
entries.example: Please insert the card into the machine before entering your code.
entries.exampleZh: 请在输入密码前将卡插入机器。

entries.example: The disease is insidious because early signs are easy to ignore.
entries.exampleZh: 这种疾病很隐匿，因为早期症状容易被忽视。

entries.meaning: 洞察，洞悉，见识；洞察力，深刻的了解；顿悟
entries.example: Her book offers useful insight into modern family life.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书对现代家庭生活提供了有用的见解。

entries.example: The extra cost seemed insignificant compared with the overall budget.
entries.exampleZh: 与总预算相比，这笔额外费用似乎微不足道。

entries.meaning: 无味的，枯燥乏味的；单调的
entries.example: The soup tasted insipid because the cook forgot the salt.
entries.exampleZh: 这汤味道寡淡，因为厨师忘了放盐。

entries.example: She will insist on paying for dinner despite our loud protests.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管我们大声反对，她仍坚持为晚餐付钱。

entries.example: His insolent reply shocked everyone at the quiet family dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 他无礼的回答让安静的家庭晚餐上所有人都震惊了。

entries.example: The company became insolvent after months of falling sales.
entries.exampleZh: 公司在销售额连续数月下降后破产了。

entries.example: Engineers will inspect the bridge carefully before it reopens to traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师将在桥梁重新通车前仔细检查。

entries.example: A surprise inspection found several problems in the factory kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 一次突击检查发现工厂厨房存在几个问题。

entries.meaning: 灵感，鼓舞人心的人或事，好主意；启示，灵感；鼓舞人心的人，激励
entries.example: Her speech gave me the inspiration to try again.
entries.exampleZh: 她的演讲给了我再次尝试的灵感。

entries.meaning: 激励，鼓励，灌注以创造力；鼓舞，激起；给…以灵感
entries.example: Good teachers inspire students to ask better questions.
entries.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生提出更好的问题。

entries.meaning: 令人振奋的；鼓舞人心的；启发灵感的
entries.example: The coach gave an inspiring talk before the final match.
entries.exampleZh: 教练在决赛前做了一场鼓舞人心的讲话。

entries.meaning: 任命；安装，安置；安顿，安置；安装，设置；正式任命，使正式就职
entries.example: We plan to install a new heater before winter.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打算在冬天前安装一个新暖气。

entries.example: She paid for the laptop in one final installment.
entries.exampleZh: 她用最后一期分期付款买下了这台笔记本电脑。

entries.meaning: 分期连载，分期支付的款子
entries.example: The magazine will print the next instalment in June.
entries.exampleZh: 这本杂志将在六月刊登下一期连载。

entries.example: The reaction to the loud noise was almost instantaneous.
entries.exampleZh: 对巨大声响的反应几乎是瞬间发生的。

entries.meaning: 滴注；逐渐灌输；逐步培养
entries.example: Parents should instil good habits in their children early.
entries.exampleZh: 父母应该尽早向孩子灌输好习惯。

entries.example: My first instinct was to call for help.
entries.exampleZh: 我的第一直觉是呼救。

entries.example: Her instinctual reaction was to protect the child.
entries.exampleZh: 她本能的反应是保护那个孩子。

entries.example: The research institute published its findings last week.
entries.exampleZh: 这家研究所上周公布了它的研究结果。

entries.meaning: 协会；机构；制度；习俗；团体；设立，制定
entries.example: The university is a respected institution in our country.
entries.exampleZh: 这所大学是我国一所受人尊敬的机构。

entries.example: The teacher will instruct the class to work in pairs.
entries.exampleZh: 老师将指示全班两人一组进行练习。

entries.meaning: 仪器；器具；乐器；仪器；手段；工具；乐器
entries.example: The violin is a beautiful instrument when played well.
entries.exampleZh: 小提琴演奏得好时是一种美妙的乐器。

entries.meaning: 起作用的，有助于，乐器的；有帮助的，起作用的；用乐器演奏的
entries.example: Her advice was instrumental in helping me choose a career.
entries.exampleZh: 她的建议对我选择职业起了重要作用。

entries.example: The evidence was insufficient to prove his claim.
entries.exampleZh: 证据不足以证明他的说法。

entries.meaning: 岛国；与外界隔绝的生活状况；褊狭
entries.example: Their insularity made it hard for outsiders to join.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的封闭心态使外人很难融入。

entries.meaning: 使绝缘，使绝热，隔离；使绝缘，使隔热，使隔音；隔离；使隔绝
entries.example: We need to insulate the roof before the cold winter.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在寒冬到来前给屋顶做隔热。

entries.meaning: 隔绝，隔绝状态；绝缘，隔热，隔音
entries.example: Good insulation keeps the house warm during the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的隔热层能让房子在冬季保持温暖。

entries.meaning: 侮辱，凌辱；侮辱的言词或行为
entries.example: He did not mean to insult anyone at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 他并不是有意在聚会上侮辱任何人。

entries.meaning: 保险；保险；保险费；保险业
entries.example: The insurance on our apartment costs more than we expected this year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们公寓的保险费今年比我们预想的要高。

entries.example: We decided to insure our house against flooding after the terrible storm.
entries.exampleZh: 那场可怕的暴风雨过后，我们决定给房子投保洪水险。

entries.meaning: 未受损的，完整的；完整无缺的；完好无损的
entries.example: Despite the heavy storm, the old church remained completely intact.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管遭遇了猛烈的暴风雨，那座古老的教堂依然完好无损。

entries.example: Doctors recommend reducing your daily intake of sugar and processed food.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议减少你每天糖和加工食品的摄入量。

entries.meaning: 构成整体所必需的，完整的；不可或缺的，构成整体所必需的；完整的，完备的
entries.example: Regular practice is an integral part of learning to play the piano.
entries.exampleZh: 经常练习是学习弹钢琴不可或缺的一部分。

entries.meaning: 使一体化，取消种族隔离；合并，成为一体
entries.example: The school helps new students integrate quickly into the local community.
entries.exampleZh: 学校帮助新生迅速融入当地社区。

entries.example: She refused the bribe, and everyone praised her honesty and integrity.
entries.exampleZh: 她拒绝了贿赂，大家都称赞她的诚实与正直。

entries.example: His sharp intellect made him a respected scientist in the field.
entries.exampleZh: 他敏锐的才智使他成为该领域一位受人尊敬的科学家。

entries.meaning: 知识分子；智力的，理智的，有理解力的；智力的；理智的
entries.example: The professor enjoys lively intellectual discussions with his graduate students.
entries.exampleZh: 这位教授喜欢和他的研究生进行活跃的智力讨论。

entries.example: Recent intelligence suggests that the situation is more serious than we thought.
entries.exampleZh: 最近的情报表明，情况比我们想象的要严重。

entries.example: She is an intelligent student who asks excellent questions in class.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的学生，在课堂上会提出很好的问题。

entries.meaning: 违犯；伤害的感情；提供；提议
entries.example: They decided to offer her the job after the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 面试之后，他们决定把这份工作提供给她。

entries.meaning: 抵销；补偿；抵消，补偿，弥补
entries.example: Planting trees can offset some of the carbon emissions.
entries.exampleZh: 植树可以抵消一部分碳排放。

entries.example: The company built an offshore wind farm near the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司在海岸附近建了一座海上风电场。

entries.meaning: 子孙后代；动物的幼仔；子女，后代；产物
entries.example: The birds feed their offspring with insects and small worms.
entries.exampleZh: 这些鸟用昆虫和小虫子喂养它们的幼鸟。

entries.example: The sudden storm was a bad omen for the sailors.
entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的暴风雨对水手们来说是个不祥的预兆。

entries.example: Dark clouds and a cold wind seemed ominous to the villagers.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云和冷风在村民看来似乎是不祥的征兆。

entries.example: Please do not omit any details from your final report.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要从最终报告中遗漏任何细节。

entries.example: The cat sat on the warm roof during the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 猫在早晨坐在温暖的屋顶上。

entries.example: We will leave for the park once the rain stops.
entries.exampleZh: 雨停后我们就出发去公园。

entries.example: The driver swerved to avoid the oncoming truck.
entries.exampleZh: 司机猛转方向以避开迎面而来的卡车。

entries.example: Each student must choose one book from the reading list.
entries.exampleZh: 每个学生必须从阅读书单中选择一本书。

entries.meaning: 继续的；进行中的；前进，发展
entries.example: The ongoing project requires more time and careful planning.
entries.exampleZh: 这项正在进行的项目需要更多时间和周密规划。

entries.example: A curious onlooker watched the street performers from the corner.
entries.exampleZh: 一位好奇的旁观者从街角观看街头艺人表演。

entries.example: Doctors treated the patient quickly after the onset of symptoms.
entries.exampleZh: 症状发作后，医生迅速治疗了这名病人。

entries.example: The soldiers struggled to survive the sudden onslaught of enemy fire.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们艰难地在敌人火力的突然猛攻中求生。

entries.example: From noon onwards, the team continued their journey through the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 从中午开始，队伍继续穿越山谷的旅程。

entries.meaning: 不透光的，不透明的；不透明的；晦涩的，难懂的
entries.example: The bathroom window is opaque, so nobody can see inside.
entries.exampleZh: 浴室的窗户是不透明的，所以没人能看见里面。

entries.meaning: 口，孔；开始；张开；职位空缺
entries.example: She found a small opening in the fence and slipped through.
entries.exampleZh: 她在栅栏上发现一个小缺口，然后钻了过去。

entries.meaning: 运转；动手术；起作用；操作；经营
entries.example: Only trained staff may operate this heavy machine safely.
entries.exampleZh: 只有受过培训的员工才能安全操作这台重型机器。

entries.meaning: 运转的；操作的；运营的，业务的
entries.example: The new airport will become operational next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 新机场将于明年春天投入使用。

entries.example: In my opinion, the plan needs more careful review.
entries.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个计划需要更仔细的审查。

entries.meaning: 对手，敌手，反对者；对立的，对抗的；敌手，对手；反对者
entries.example: She defeated her opponent in the final round of the tournament.
entries.exampleZh: 她在锦标赛的最后一轮击败了对手。

entries.example: This job offers a great opportunity to learn new skills.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作提供了一个学习新技能的好机会。

entries.example: Many local residents oppose the construction of a new factory.
entries.exampleZh: 许多当地居民反对建造新工厂。

entries.meaning: 对面的；相反的，对立的；在对面；对立面，对立物
entries.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
entries.exampleZh: 银行在街道的对面。

entries.example: The new laws may oppress minority groups in the country.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律可能会压迫该国的少数群体。

entries.example: Many students opt for a light breakfast before the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生在考试前选择吃清淡的早餐。

entries.meaning: 眼的，视觉的；光学的；光学仪器
entries.example: The optic nerve sends signals from the eye to the brain.
entries.exampleZh: 视神经把信号从眼睛传到大脑。

entries.meaning: 视觉的，眼睛的，光学的；视力的；光学的
entries.example: The microscope uses optical lenses to magnify tiny objects.
entries.exampleZh: 显微镜使用光学镜片来放大微小物体。

entries.example: Her optimism helped the team recover after a difficult loss.
entries.exampleZh: 她的乐观帮助团队在一场艰难的失利后恢复过来。

entries.example: We remain optimistic about the project despite the recent delays.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管最近有延误，我们对这个项目仍持乐观态度。

entries.meaning: 最适宜的；最好的；最有利的
entries.example: The doctor suggested the optimum time for the patient's daily walk.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议了病人每天散步的最适宜时间。

entries.meaning: 选择，可选择的事物；选择；选择的物；选课
entries.example: Leaving early is not a good option for the group.
entries.exampleZh: 提前离开对这个小组来说不是一个好选择。

entries.meaning: 非强制的，自愿的，自发的；可选择的，非强制的，随意的
entries.example: Attendance at the evening lecture is optional for all new students.
entries.exampleZh: 所有新生均可自愿参加晚间讲座。

entries.example: The optometrist checked my eyes and gave me a new prescription.
entries.exampleZh: 验光师检查了我的眼睛，并给了我一张新处方。

entries.example: The palace was famous for its opulence and grand gardens.
entries.exampleZh: 这座宫殿以其富丽堂皇和宏大的花园而闻名。

entries.meaning: 豪华的，华丽的，富裕的；丰富的，丰饶的
entries.example: They rented an opulent hall for the wedding reception.
entries.exampleZh: 他们租了一个豪华的大厅举办婚宴。

entries.meaning: 天体轨道；势力范围；沿轨道运行；沿轨道运行；围绕…运动；轨道；影响范围，势力范围
entries.example: The satellite will orbit the earth twice every day.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗卫星每天将绕地球运行两圈。

entries.example: We picked fresh apples in the orchard behind the farm.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在农场后面的果园里摘了新鲜苹果。

entries.example: The orchestra played a beautiful piece at the city concert.
entries.exampleZh: 管弦乐队在城市音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。

entries.meaning: (对品格或忍耐力的)严格考验
entries.example: The long journey through the storm was a terrible ordeal.
entries.exampleZh: 在暴风雨中长途旅行是一场可怕的磨难。

entries.meaning: 整齐的；有秩序的；有条不紊的
entries.example: The nurse kept the busy ward clean and orderly all day.
entries.exampleZh: 护士让繁忙的病房整天保持清洁有序。

entries.example: The miners found rich ore deep inside the mountain.
entries.exampleZh: 矿工们在山体深处发现了丰富的矿石。

entries.meaning: 器官；报刊；风琴；器官；机构
entries.example: The heart is a vital organ that keeps blood moving through the body.
entries.exampleZh: 心脏是一个重要的器官，它使血液在全身流动。

entries.meaning: 器官的；有机的；有机体的；组织的
entries.example: This farm grows organic vegetables without using any harmful chemicals.
entries.exampleZh: 这个农场种植有机蔬菜，不使用任何有害化学物质。

entries.meaning: 生物；有机体；有机的组织；生物；有机体
entries.example: A tiny organism can survive in extremely cold and hostile places.
entries.exampleZh: 一种微小生物能在极寒冷且恶劣的地方存活。

entries.example: We need to organize the files before the meeting starts today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在今天会议开始前整理这些文件。

entries.example: The museum displays oriental art from several Asian countries.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出几个亚洲国家的东方艺术品。

entries.meaning: 定位；给定位；使适应，使熟悉情况；给…定位，给…定向；使朝向；转至特定方向；适应
entries.example: New students learn to orientate themselves around the campus during welcome week.
entries.exampleZh: 新生在迎新周学习熟悉校园环境。

entries.meaning: 定位；方向，方位；情况介绍；培训，训练
entries.example: The orientation for new employees lasts two full days.
entries.exampleZh: 新员工的入职培训持续整整两天。

entries.example: Scientists still debate the origin of this ancient language.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们仍在争论这种古老语言的起源。

entries.meaning: 起源；原件，原稿；最初的；有独创性的；最初的，原始的；新颖的，有独创性的；原物，原作
entries.example: The original painting hangs in a small room upstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅原画挂在楼上一个小房间里。

entries.meaning: 发生，发起；发明；起源，发生；首创，创造
entries.example: Many popular dishes originate from small family kitchens in rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 许多受欢迎的菜肴起源于农村的小家庭厨房。

entries.example: She placed a glass ornament carefully on the top shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 她小心地把一个玻璃装饰品放在最上层架子上。

entries.example: The garden includes several ornamental trees that produce no fruit.
entries.exampleZh: 这个花园里有几棵不结果的观赏树。

entries.meaning: 正(传)统的；正统的，传统的
entries.example: His orthodox views often surprise younger members of the group.
entries.exampleZh: 他正统的观点常让团队中较年轻的成员感到惊讶。

entries.example: The fan blades oscillate slowly and send cool air across the room.
entries.exampleZh: 风扇叶片缓慢摆动，把凉风送到房间各处。

entries.example: Her ostensible reason for leaving early sounded rather weak.
entries.exampleZh: 她早退的表面理由听起来相当牵强。

entries.example: He dislikes ostentation and prefers simple clothes and quiet meals.
entries.exampleZh: 他不喜欢炫耀，更偏爱简单的衣服和安静的饭菜。

entries.meaning: 用其他方法；不同地；否则，不然；另样，用别的方法；在其他方面；要不然，否则
entries.example: Please write it down; otherwise, you may forget the address.
entries.exampleZh: 请把它写下来，否则你可能会忘记地址。

entries.example: Add one ounce of butter to the warm pan now.
entries.exampleZh: 现在往温热的平底锅里加一盎司黄油。

entries.example: The board voted to oust the manager after the scandal.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会投票决定在丑闻之后罢免经理。

entries.example: The children ran out when the bell rang loudly.
entries.exampleZh: 铃声响亮地响起时，孩子们跑了出去。

entries.example: A sudden outbreak of flu closed the school for a week.
entries.exampleZh: 一场突然的流感爆发使学校停课一周。

entries.meaning: 被遗弃的；被遗弃者，被逐出者
entries.example: The young outcast found kindness in a small village.
entries.exampleZh: 那个年轻的被逐出者在一个小村庄里感受到了善意。

entries.meaning: 结果，后果；结果，成果；后果；结局；出口，输出量
entries.example: Nobody could predict the outcome of the long negotiation.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人能预测这场漫长谈判的结果。

entries.example: The new law caused a public outcry across the country.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律在全国引起了公众的强烈反对。

entries.example: His outdated views often upset the younger members of the team.
entries.exampleZh: 他过时的观点常常让团队里较年轻的成员感到不快。

entries.example: She always tries to outdo her brother in every race.
entries.exampleZh: 她总是想在每次赛跑中胜过她的哥哥。

entries.example: He packed a complete outfit for the camping trip.
entries.exampleZh: 他为这次露营旅行打包了一整套装备。

entries.meaning: 被剥夺公民权者；禁止；亡命之徒，逃犯，被剥夺法律权益者；宣布…为非法，使…成为非法
entries.example: The sheriff finally caught the outlaw near the border.
entries.exampleZh: 警长最终在边境附近抓住了那个亡命之徒。

entries.meaning: 河流等出口，出路；发泄(感情等)的方法
entries.example: Music gives him a healthy outlet for his stress.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐为他提供了一个健康的压力宣泄途径。

entries.meaning: 外形，轮廓；大纲，纲要；提纲；梗概；轮廓；草图；概述；列提纲
entries.example: Please write a clear outline before you start your essay.
entries.exampleZh: 请你在开始写文章之前先写一个清晰的提纲。

entries.example: Her positive outlook helped the team through difficult times.
entries.exampleZh: 她积极的态度帮助团队度过了困难时期。

entries.example: Few buses reach the outlying villages after dark.
entries.exampleZh: 天黑以后很少有公交车到达偏僻的村庄。

entries.example: Soldiers guarded the remote outpost throughout the cold winter.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在整个寒冷的冬天守卫着这个偏远的前哨。

entries.meaning: 产量；产出；产量；输出量；输出功率；输出
entries.example: The factory increased its output without hiring more workers.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂在没有雇用更多工人的情况下提高了产量。

entries.example: His outrageous behaviour shocked everyone at the formal dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 他在正式晚宴上的蛮横行径让所有人都震惊了。

entries.example: Everyone knew his excuse was an outright lie.
entries.exampleZh: 所有人都知道他的借口是一个彻头彻尾的谎言。

entries.example: Their new phone will probably outsell every rival model this year.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新手机今年很可能会卖得比所有竞争对手的型号都多。

entries.example: She warned us about the risks at the outset.
entries.exampleZh: 她一开始就警告过我们这些风险。

entries.example: They bought a quiet house on the outskirts of town.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在城外郊区买了一栋安静的房子。

entries.example: She is an outspoken critic of the city's housing policy.
entries.exampleZh: 她是该市住房政策直言不讳的批评者。

entries.example: Demand for the new service may outstrip supply this summer.
entries.exampleZh: 今年夏天，这项新服务的需求可能会超过供应。

entries.example: Her outward calm hid the anxiety she felt before the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 她外表的平静掩盖了考试前的焦虑。

entries.meaning: 比更重，比更重要；比…重；比…更重要；胜过，强于
entries.example: The benefits of regular exercise outweigh the risks for most healthy adults.
entries.exampleZh: 对大多数健康成年人来说，规律锻炼的好处超过风险。

entries.example: She drew a perfect oval around the date on the calendar.
entries.exampleZh: 她在日历上的日期周围画了一个完美的椭圆。

entries.example: The singer received a standing ovation after her final song.
entries.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后得到了全场起立欢呼。

entries.meaning: 包括一切的，全部的；罩衫，工装裤；全面的；全部的
entries.example: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用低于我们的预期。

entries.meaning: 克服；压倒；战胜，克服；压倒
entries.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.
entries.exampleZh: 她努力克服了当众演讲的恐惧。

entries.example: The bank charged him a fee for using an overdraft.
entries.exampleZh: 银行因他使用透支而收取了费用。

entries.meaning: 过期未付的；过期未付的；逾期的；过度的，过火的；迟到的，延误的
entries.example: The library sent a reminder about the overdue books.
entries.exampleZh: 图书馆发来了关于逾期图书的提醒。

entries.meaning: 对…估计过高[ˌəuvər'estImət]；过高的估计
entries.example: People often overestimate how much time they need to finish.
entries.exampleZh: 人们常常高估完成所需的时间。

entries.example: Some companies overexploit natural resources without considering future generations.
entries.exampleZh: 一些公司不为后代考虑而过度开发自然资源。

entries.example: Do not overfill the suitcase or it may burst open.
entries.exampleZh: 不要把行李箱装得太满，否则它可能会撑开。

entries.example: Heavy rain caused the river to overflow its banks.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨导致河水溢出河岸。

entries.example: Farmers who overgraze their land soon face poor soil.
entries.exampleZh: 过度放牧土地的农民很快就会面临土壤贫瘠。

entries.example: The mechanics will overhaul the old engine next week.
entries.exampleZh: 机械师下周将彻底检修这台旧发动机。

entries.meaning: 在空中，在头顶上，在高处；在头顶上的；高架的；天花板；企业管理费用
entries.example: A small plane circled overhead for several minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 一架小飞机在头顶盘旋了几分钟。

entries.example: I happened to overhear their conversation in the hallway.
entries.exampleZh: 我碰巧在走廊里无意中听到了他们的谈话。

entries.meaning: 与…互搭，与重叠，与部分相同；部分重叠，交叠
entries.example: The two schedules overlap on Tuesday so we must choose.
entries.exampleZh: 两个日程在周二有重叠，所以我们必须做出选择。

entries.example: The report describes two overlapping periods of rapid growth.
entries.exampleZh: 报告描述了两个重叠的快速增长时期。

entries.example: Thick layers of rock overlie the ancient fossils.
entries.exampleZh: 厚厚的岩层覆盖着这些古老化石。

entries.example: We should not overlook the small details in this plan.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不应忽视这个计划中的小细节。

entries.example: Many critics overrate this film simply because of its famous director.
entries.exampleZh: 许多影评人仅仅因为导演有名就对这部电影评价过高。

entries.meaning: 不理(某人的愿望要求)，不顾
entries.example: She chose to override her parents' wishes and move abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 她选择不顾父母的意愿，搬到国外去。

entries.example: If we don't leave now, the meeting will overrun again.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我们现在不走，会议又要超时了。

entries.meaning: 向国外；在海外，在外国；来自海外的，外国来的
entries.example: My brother works overseas and only comes home once a year.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥在海外工作，一年只回家一次。

entries.meaning: 监督，监管；监督，监视；俯瞰，眺望
entries.example: A senior engineer will oversee the whole project from start to finish.
entries.exampleZh: 一位资深工程师将从头到尾监督整个项目。

entries.meaning: 给…蒙上阴影；使扫兴；使黯然失色
entries.example: Dark clouds threaten to overshadow the outdoor ceremony this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云可能会给今天下午的户外仪式蒙上阴影。

entries.example: There was no overt criticism, but everyone clearly disagreed.
entries.exampleZh: 没有公开的批评，但每个人显然都不同意。

entries.example: It is dangerous to overtake other cars on this narrow road.
entries.exampleZh: 在这条窄路上超车很危险。

entries.example: The people rose up to overthrow the corrupt government last year.
entries.exampleZh: 人民去年起义推翻了那个腐败的政府。

entries.example: The company made a friendly overture to its rivals last week.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司上周向竞争对手做出了友好的提议。

entries.example: The first chapter gives a brief overview of the whole subject.
entries.exampleZh: 第一章对整个主题做了简要的概述。

entries.meaning: 超重的，过重的；超重，过重；使负担过重
entries.example: His doctor warned him that he was dangerously overweight for his age.
entries.exampleZh: 医生警告他，以他的年龄来说，他的体重已经严重超标。

entries.example: The small team was afraid the huge task would overwhelm them.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小团队担心这项巨大的任务会压垮他们。

entries.meaning: 使劳累过分；对…使用过度；滥用；过重的工作；工作过度
entries.example: Long hours of overwork finally destroyed his health and his marriage.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间的过度工作最终毁掉了他的健康和婚姻。

entries.meaning: 过分劳累的，过度兴奋的
entries.example: She was too overwrought to speak clearly about the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 她过度激动，无法清楚地讲述那场事故。

entries.meaning: 欠债；感激；由于；欠；把…归功于
entries.example: I still owe my sister fifty pounds from last month.
entries.exampleZh: 我上个月还欠我姐姐五十英镑。

entries.example: A large owl sat silently on the branch above our tent.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大猫头鹰静静地停在我们帐篷上方的树枝上。

entries.example: She took great pains to hide the broken vase from her mother.
entries.exampleZh: 她费尽苦心不让母亲发现打碎的花瓶。

entries.meaning: 极小心的；勤恳的；需细心的，辛苦的，煞费苦心的；勤勉的；刻苦的；辛苦；勤勉；刻苦

entries.exampleZh: 她的朋友们决定用蛋糕和热茶来娇惯她。

entries.exampleZh: 志愿者递给我一本关于家庭节水的小册子。

entries.meaning: 镶板，控制板；座谈小组；镶饰

entries.exampleZh: 从山上我们欣赏到绿色田野与河流的广阔全景。

entries.exampleZh: 长跑结束后，他在终点线附近开始气喘吁吁。

entries.exampleZh: 他穿着深色裤子和一件干净的衬衫去面试。

entries.example: The pilot opened his parachute and floated safely down to the field.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员打开降落伞，安全地飘落到田野上。

entries.meaning: 阅兵整队；列队行进，游行；夸耀；炫示

entries.exampleZh: 对任何热爱大自然的人来说，这座安静的小岛就像天堂一样。

entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的恐惧似乎让他僵住了几秒钟。

entries.meaning: 麻痹，瘫痪；完全无力；瘫痪，麻痹，中风

entries.exampleZh: 中风之后，她右脸出现了瘫痪。

entries.meaning: 最高的；首要的；最重要的，决定性的；最高统治者

entries.exampleZh: 操作重型机械时，安全是最重要的。

entries.example: His constant paranoia made it hard for colleagues to trust him.
entries.exampleZh: 他持续不断的猜疑让同事们很难信任他。

entries.example: She packed all her camping paraphernalia into the back of the car.
entries.exampleZh: 她把她所有的露营装备都塞进了汽车后备箱。

entries.example: Please paraphrase the opening paragraph in your own words.
entries.exampleZh: 请用你自己的话把开头那段改述一下。

entries.meaning: 寄生虫，寄生植物；靠他人为生的人

entries.exampleZh: 这种微小的寄生虫生活在某些鱼类的胃里。

entries.example: A small parcel arrived at our door this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上一个小编包送到了我们家门口。

entries.meaning: 请重复一遍，请再说一遍〔没听清对方的话希望重复一遍时的用语〕；赦免；赦免令，赦免状

entries.exampleZh: 十年之后，州长给予他完全赦免。

entries.example: Parental support plays a big role in a child's success at school.
entries.exampleZh: 父母的支持对孩子的学业成功起着很大作用。

entries.example: The new law was finally approved by parliament last week.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律上周终于获得议会批准。

entries.example: The film is a clever parody of popular detective shows.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影是对热门侦探剧的一次巧妙滑稽模仿。

entries.example: She spent most of her life in a remote part of Scotland.
entries.exampleZh: 她一生大部分时间都在苏格兰一个偏远的地区度过。

entries.meaning: 不完全的；偏袒的；部分的，不完全的；偏爱的，癖好的；偏向一方的，偏心的

entries.exampleZh: 这项研究中的每位参与者都收到了一笔小额报酬。

entries.example: Students are encouraged to participate actively in class discussions.
entries.exampleZh: 鼓励学生积极参与课堂讨论。

entries.example: Her active participation in the discussion impressed all the teachers.
entries.exampleZh: 她在讨论中的积极参与给所有老师留下了深刻印象。

entries.meaning: 颗粒，微粒，[语]小品词；极少量；微粒

entries.exampleZh: 一小粒灰尘进了我的眼睛。

entries.exampleZh: 她对古代中国诗歌有特别的兴趣。

entries.example: I am particularly fond of fresh fruit in summer.
entries.exampleZh: 我特别喜欢夏天的新鲜水果。

entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂向空气中排放有害的颗粒物。

entries.exampleZh: 那名党派人士在激烈辩论中为其政党的政策辩护。

entries.example: A thin partition separates the kitchen from the dining area.
entries.exampleZh: 一道薄隔断把厨房和用餐区分开。

entries.exampleZh: 请把盐递给我，就在桌上。

entries.example: Her passion for music began when she was very young.
entries.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热爱始于很小的时候。

entries.exampleZh: 他发表了一场关于保护环境的激情演讲。

entries.example: She remained passive during the meeting and said nothing.
entries.exampleZh: 她在会上一直很被动，什么也没说。

entries.exampleZh: 旅行前我需要更新护照。

entries.exampleZh: 阅读是我在雨天下午最喜欢的消遣。

entries.meaning: 牧场；放牧；牧场，草原；放牧

entries.exampleZh: 奶牛慢慢地走过绿色的牧场。

entries.exampleZh: 他在旧夹克上缝了一小块补丁。

entries.exampleZh: 那只流浪狗在大雨中看起来可怜极了。

entries.exampleZh: 她学习病理学以了解疾病如何影响身体。

entries.exampleZh: 这部小说的最后一幕充满了一种安静的悲悯。

entries.exampleZh: 教育为年轻人提供了一条通往更好工作的清晰路径。

entries.example: We had breakfast on the patio while the birds sang.
entries.exampleZh: 鸟儿歌唱时，我们在天井里吃了早餐。

entries.meaning: 爱国的，有爱国心的；显示出爱国精神的

entries.exampleZh: 国庆假期期间，人群唱起了爱国歌曲。

entries.exampleZh: 她每一次演讲都流露出深厚的爱国情怀。

entries.exampleZh: 保安每晚闭馆后都会在博物馆园区巡逻。

entries.example: There was a peculiar smell coming from the old fridge.

entries.exampleZh: 他用力踩下踏板，自行车加速了。

entries.exampleZh: 一位行人停下来帮司机换轮胎。

entries.exampleZh: 这只小狗的血统显示其家族中有几只获奖犬。

entries.exampleZh: 她很少跟任何同龄人谈自己的私人问题。

entries.exampleZh: 那座旧钟的钟摆缓慢地左右摆动。

entries.example: The bright sunlight can penetrate the thin curtains in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 早晨明亮的阳光能穿透薄窗帘。

entries.exampleZh: 医生在缝合伤口前检查了穿透的深度。

entries.example: He receives a modest pension after forty years of service.
entries.exampleZh: 他服务四十年后领取一份微薄的养老金。

entries.example: Please add a little black pepper to the soup before serving.
entries.exampleZh: 上桌前请在汤里加一点黑胡椒。

entries.exampleZh: 我察觉到你今天的语气有轻微变化。

entries.exampleZh: 很大比例的学生通过了这场艰难的考试。

entries.example: There was a barely perceptible change in her expression.
entries.exampleZh: 她的表情有几乎察觉不到的变化。

entries.exampleZh: 公众对新法律的看法随时间改变了。

entries.example: The percussion of the hammer echoed through the empty hall.
entries.exampleZh: 锤子的撞击声在空荡的大厅里回响。

entries.meaning: 终年的,四季不断的,持久的；多年生植物"

entries.exampleZh: 这些色彩鲜艳的花是多年生植物，每年春天都会重新长出。

entries.exampleZh: 她将在学校音乐会上演唱她的新歌。

entries.exampleZh: 他在决赛中的表现让每位教练都印象深刻。

entries.exampleZh: 她打开瓶子后，一股甜美的香味充满了房间。

entries.exampleZh: 水手们知道在暴风雨中航行的危险。

entries.meaning: 周边，周长，周界；周长；周边

entries.exampleZh: 一道高栅栏围着学校的周边。

entries.exampleZh: 她每月读一本科普期刊来了解新研究。

entries.exampleZh: 工作人员全年定期检查火灾报警器。

entries.meaning: 外围的；次要的，附带的；外围设备

entries.exampleZh: 打印机和其他外围设备以无线方式连接到电脑。

entries.meaning: (圆体的)外面；周围；不重要的部分；外围

entries.exampleZh: 几家小店铺坐落在老城区的边缘。

entries.exampleZh: 潜艇艇长升起潜望镜观察地平线。

entries.exampleZh: 如果森林家园消失，许多稀有植物将会灭绝。

entries.meaning: (尤指食物)易坏的,易腐烂的;易坏之物"

entries.exampleZh: 鲜牛奶极易变质，必须冷藏保存。

entries.meaning: 永久性的，持久的；永久的，持久的

entries.exampleZh: 经过几个月的寻找，她终于找到了一份固定的工作。

entries.meaning: 弥漫，透过；扩散，弥漫；渗透，渗入

entries.exampleZh: 节日期间，笑声和音乐弥漫整座房子。

entries.exampleZh: 在这栋楼内吸烟是不允许的。

entries.exampleZh: 在这个博物馆拍照之前，你需要获得书面许可。

entries.exampleZh: 工人需要许可证才能进入建筑工地。

entries.exampleZh: 尽管风很大，这座塔仍然垂直于地面矗立。

entries.exampleZh: 那些罪犯每年对老年人实施诈骗。

entries.exampleZh: 她始终挂在脸上的微笑让办公室里的每个人都感到亲切。

entries.exampleZh: 她完全困惑地盯着那台奇怪的机器。

entries.example: A company car is a perquisite of the senior manager's job.
entries.exampleZh: 公司配车是高级经理职位的一项特权。

entries.example: The regime continued to persecute writers who criticized its policies.
entries.exampleZh: 该政权继续迫害批评其政策的作家。

entries.example: If you persevere with your daily practice, your English will improve.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你坚持每天练习，你的英语会有所提高。

entries.meaning: 坚持；持续；坚持；维持，保持，持续
entries.example: The pain may persist for several days after the injury.
entries.exampleZh: 受伤后疼痛可能会持续几天。

entries.meaning: 个人的；身体的；个人的，私人的；亲自的，本人的；身体的，人身的
entries.example: She keeps her personal diary in a locked drawer at home.
entries.exampleZh: 她把私人日记锁在家里的抽屉里。

entries.meaning: 个性；(有名的)人物；人格；个性；名人，人物
entries.example: His lively personality makes him popular with everyone in the office.
entries.exampleZh: 他活泼的个性使他在办公室里很受大家欢迎。

entries.meaning: 使成为私人的；在上标出主人姓名；个人化
entries.example: You can personalize the case with your own name and a small picture.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以用自己的名字和一张小照片来定制这个手机壳。

entries.meaning: 职员，人员，人事；全体人员，员工
entries.example: The company hired extra personnel for the busy holiday season.
entries.exampleZh: 公司为繁忙的假期旺季雇用了额外的人员。

entries.meaning: 透视；透视画法；视角，观点；角度，方法；透视法
entries.example: Travelling abroad gave her a fresh perspective on her own culture.
entries.exampleZh: 出国旅行让她对本国文化有了全新的视角。

entries.example: During the long run, he began to perspire heavily under the hot sun.
entries.exampleZh: 长跑途中，他在烈日下开始大量出汗。

entries.example: I tried to persuade my brother to join the school choir.
entries.exampleZh: 我试着说服弟弟参加学校合唱团。

entries.example: These new rules pertain only to students living in the dormitory.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新规定只涉及住在宿舍的学生。

entries.example: Her comments were highly pertinent to the question we were discussing.
entries.exampleZh: 她的评论与我们正在讨论的问题密切相关。

entries.example: The sudden noise did not perturb the sleeping baby at all.
entries.exampleZh: 突然的响声一点也没有惊扰到睡着的婴儿。

entries.example: A calm and gentle mood seemed to pervade the whole room.
entries.exampleZh: 一种平静温和的气氛似乎弥漫了整个房间。

entries.example: The smell of fresh bread was pervasive throughout the small bakery.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在这家小面包店里。

entries.meaning: 刚愎的；坚持错误的，行为反常的
entries.example: He took a perverse pleasure in proving his teacher wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 他从证明老师错了当中得到一种反常的乐趣。

entries.meaning: 误用，使人堕落；堕落者，反常者
entries.example: Do not pervert the true meaning of his kind words.
entries.exampleZh: 不要曲解他那番善意话语的真正含义。

entries.example: Her constant pessimism about the future worried her closest friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她对未来一贯的悲观让最亲近的朋友们担忧。

entries.example: A tiny green pest was eating the leaves of my tomato plant.
entries.exampleZh: 一只绿色的小害虫正在吃我番茄植株的叶子。

entries.example: Please stop trying to pester me while I am working.
entries.exampleZh: 我在工作的时候请别再缠着我。

entries.example: Farmers here use less pesticide than they did ten years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的农民使用的农药比十年前少了。

entries.example: A single pink petal fell slowly onto the surface of the pond.
entries.exampleZh: 一片粉色的花瓣缓缓落在池塘的水面上。

entries.example: Over a thousand residents signed the petition against the new road.
entries.exampleZh: 一千多名居民签署了反对修建新路的请愿书。

entries.example: The car ran out of petrol halfway to the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 汽车在去海边的半路上没油了。

entries.example: Engineers studied how petroleum forms deep beneath the ocean floor.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们研究了石油如何在海底深处形成。

entries.example: They argued over petty details instead of solving the main problem.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为琐碎细节争吵，而没有解决主要问题。

entries.example: The pharmaceutical company announced a new treatment for rare blood diseases.
entries.exampleZh: 这家制药公司宣布了一种治疗罕见血液病的新疗法。

entries.example: I stopped at the pharmacy to collect my mother's medicine.
entries.exampleZh: 我在药店停下来取我母亲的药。

entries.meaning: 阶段；月的盈亏；方面;相位vt按计划进行
entries.example: The project entered a difficult phase after the budget was cut.
entries.exampleZh: 预算被削减后，这个项目进入了一个艰难阶段。

entries.example: Her performance in the final race was truly phenomenal.
entries.exampleZh: 她在决赛中的表现确实非凡。

entries.meaning: 现象；非凡的人；奇迹(pl-na)；现象，迹象；非凡的人
entries.example: Scientists still cannot fully explain this strange natural phenomenon.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们仍然无法完全解释这一奇怪的自然现象。

entries.example: His philosophy of life is simple: work hard and stay kind.
entries.exampleZh: 他的人生哲学很简单：努力工作，保持善良。

entries.example: She developed a phobia of crowded places after the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 那次事故后，她对拥挤的地方产生了恐惧症。

entries.example: The teacher explained the phonetic rules behind those tricky spellings.
entries.exampleZh: 老师解释了那些难拼写单词背后的语音规则。

entries.meaning: 影印，复印；影印本，复印件
entries.example: Please bring a photocopy of your passport to the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 请带一份护照复印件去面试。

entries.example: She studied photography in Paris before starting her own studio.
entries.exampleZh: 她在巴黎学习摄影，之后开了自己的工作室。

entries.meaning: 身体的，肉体的；物理的，物理学的；物质的，有形的；体检
entries.example: Regular physical activity can improve both mood and sleep quality.
entries.exampleZh: 规律的身体活动可以改善情绪和睡眠质量。

entries.example: The physician advised him to rest and drink plenty of water.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议他休息并多喝水。

entries.example: Stress can cause real physiological changes in the human body.
entries.exampleZh: 压力会在人体内引起真实的生理变化。

entries.example: His strong physique helped him win the swimming competition.
entries.exampleZh: 他强壮的体格帮助他赢得了游泳比赛。

entries.example: You can pick any book you like from this shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以从这个书架上挑选任何你喜欢的书。

entries.example: We packed sandwiches and fruit for a picnic beside the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打包了三明治和水果，去湖边野餐。

entries.meaning: 似画的，生动的；美丽如画的；生动的
entries.example: The village looked picturesque with its old bridge and quiet river.
entries.exampleZh: 那座村庄有古老的桥和安静的河，看起来风景如画。

entries.example: They rebuilt the old school in a piecemeal way over three years.
entries.exampleZh: 他们用三年多时间零碎地重建了那所旧学校。

entries.example: We walked to the end of the wooden pier and watched the boats.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走到木码头的尽头看船。

entries.meaning: 刺穿，戳人；（喻）寒冷刺骨；感动
entries.example: A sharp needle can pierce the thick cloth with little effort.
entries.exampleZh: 一根尖针能毫不费力地刺穿厚布。

entries.example: Her quiet piety impressed everyone who visited the small village church.
entries.exampleZh: 她安静的虔诚给每个参观小村教堂的人留下深刻印象。

entries.example: The artist mixed a red pigment with oil before painting the canvas.
entries.exampleZh: 画家在画布上作画前把红色颜料与油调在一起。

entries.example: Every pilgrim walked slowly toward the ancient temple on the hill.
entries.exampleZh: 每位朝圣者都缓慢地走向山上的古庙。

entries.example: A stone pillar supported the heavy roof of the old hall.
entries.exampleZh: 一根石柱支撑着旧大厅沉重的屋顶。

entries.example: She put a soft pillow behind her back and began to read.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一个柔软的枕头放在背后，开始阅读。

entries.meaning: 试验；飞行员；飞行员，引航员；驾驶，为…引航
entries.example: The experienced pilot landed the plane safely despite the strong wind.
entries.exampleZh: 经验丰富的飞行员尽管风很大仍安全降落了飞机。

entries.example: A small pimple appeared on his forehead the night before the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 考试前一晚，他的额头上出现了一个小脓疱。

entries.meaning: 大头针；用别针别住；钉住，使不能行动
entries.example: Use one pin to hold the note on the board.
entries.exampleZh: 用一枚大头针把便条固定在板子上。

entries.meaning: 捏，拧，掐，夹痛，紧压；压力，重压
entries.example: Add a pinch of salt to the soup before serving it.
entries.exampleZh: 上汤前加一小撮盐。

entries.example: A tall pine stood beside the lake, casting a long shadow.
entries.exampleZh: 一棵高大的松树站在湖边，投下长长的影子。

entries.example: Winning the national prize was the pinnacle of her teaching career.
entries.exampleZh: 赢得全国奖项是她教学生涯的顶峰。

entries.example: Experts could not pinpoint the exact cause of the sudden failure.
entries.exampleZh: 专家们无法精确找出突然故障的确切原因。

entries.example: Online piracy costs the film industry millions of dollars every year.
entries.exampleZh: 网络盗版每年使电影业损失数百万美元。

entries.meaning: 侵犯版权者；海盗；盗用，盗版
entries.example: The old story tells of a pirate who hid treasure on the island.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事讲述一名海盗把宝藏藏在岛上。

entries.example: The mechanic replaced the damaged piston inside the small engine.
entries.exampleZh: 技工更换了小发动机里损坏的活塞。

entries.example: The workers dug a deep pit beside the road for drainage.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在路边挖了一个深坑用于排水。

entries.meaning: 球场；声音的高低度；沥青；程度v投掷；投掷；颠簸；为…定音高；沥青；场地；程度；最高点；音高
entries.example: The players ran onto the wet pitch after the heavy rain stopped.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨停后，球员们跑上了湿漉漉的球场。

entries.example: The debate's pivot was a question nobody had expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这场辩论的核心是一个谁也没料到的问题。

entries.example: Protesters carried a large placard demanding cleaner air in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 抗议者们举着一块大标语牌，要求城市拥有更清洁的空气。

entries.example: Her placid smile made everyone in the room feel instantly calmer.
entries.exampleZh: 她平静的微笑让房间里的每个人都立刻放松下来。

entries.example: Students who plagiarise risk losing their degrees and their reputation.
entries.exampleZh: 抄袭的学生有可能失去学位和名誉。

entries.example: The professor accused him of plagiarism after reading the final essay.
entries.exampleZh: 读完期末论文后，教授指控他剽窃。

entries.meaning: 剽窃，抄袭（别人学说、著作）
entries.example: Never plagiarize another writer's work, even in a short report.
entries.exampleZh: 即使在一份短报告里，也绝不要抄袭其他作者的作品。

entries.example: The plague spread quickly through the crowded medieval city.
entries.exampleZh: 那场瘟疫在拥挤的中世纪城市里迅速蔓延。

entries.example: A plaintive cry came from the child waiting by the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 门口等待的孩子发出了一声哀伤的哭喊。

entries.example: We spent Saturday afternoon at the planetarium watching stars appear.
entries.exampleZh: 周六下午我们在天文馆里看星星出现。

entries.example: He nailed one loose plank back onto the wooden floor.
entries.exampleZh: 他把一块松动的厚板重新钉回木地板上。

entries.example: Tiny plankton near the surface feed many of the ocean's fish.
entries.exampleZh: 靠近海面的微小浮游生物喂养着海洋中的许多鱼类。

entries.example: Her grandfather worked on a tea plantation in the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 她的祖父曾在山间的一片茶园里劳作。

entries.meaning: 膏药；(涂)灰泥；灰泥，石膏；膏药
entries.example: Workers spread wet plaster smoothly across the damaged kitchen wall.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们把湿灰泥均匀地涂抹在受损的厨房墙壁上。

entries.example: Please bring a plastic bottle and a towel to the gym.
entries.exampleZh: 请带一个塑料瓶和一条毛巾去健身房。

entries.example: The herd moved slowly across the dry, windy plateau.
entries.exampleZh: 兽群缓慢地穿过干燥多风的高原。

entries.meaning: 月台，站台；讲台；(政党的)政纲，党纲；平台，站台；纲领
entries.example: We waited on the platform until the last train left.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在站台上一直等到最后一班火车开走。

entries.example: He answered my serious question with a meaningless platitude.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一句毫无意义的陈词滥调回答了我严肃的问题。

entries.meaning: 似乎有道理的；似有道理的，貌似真实的；嘴巧的
entries.example: Her excuse sounded plausible, but nobody in the office believed it.
entries.exampleZh: 她的借口听起来似乎有道理，但办公室里没人相信。

entries.meaning: (法律)抗辩；请求，恳求，托词，口实
entries.example: The family made a public plea for information about the missing boy.
entries.exampleZh: 这家人公开请求提供有关失踪男孩的信息。

entries.example: She will plead her case before the judge next Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 下周一她将在法官面前为自己的案子辩护。

entries.meaning: 抵押品，典当物；象征；正式承诺；发誓，保证；抵押，典当；誓约，保证；抵押
entries.example: The company made a pledge to reduce waste by next year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司承诺明年之前减少浪费。

entries.meaning: 易弯的，柔韧的；易受影响的；容易受影响的；顺从的；易弯的，柔韧的
entries.example: This leather is soft and pliable, making it easy to shape.
entries.exampleZh: 这种皮革柔软又柔韧，很容易塑形。

entries.example: The refugees described their plight to the reporters at the camp.
entries.exampleZh: 难民们向营地的记者描述了他们的困境。

entries.meaning: 小块土地；阴谋，情节；绘制，标绘；情节；阴谋；小块土地
entries.example: The novel has a simple plot that young readers can follow.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说情节简单，年轻读者能跟上。

entries.meaning: 犁，犁形器具；犁地；犁；犁（地），耕（地）
entries.example: Farmers plough the fields before they plant the spring crops.
entries.exampleZh: 农民在播种春季作物之前犁地。

entries.example: He pulled the plug from the wall and left the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他把插头从墙上拔下来，然后离开了房间。

entries.example: The team will plumb the lake to map its deepest areas.
entries.exampleZh: 这个团队将探测这个湖，以绘制其最深区域的地图。

entries.example: Prices can plummet quickly when demand falls across the whole market.
entries.exampleZh: 当整个市场需求下降时，价格可能会迅速暴跌。

entries.example: Soldiers would plunder the village and leave the families with nothing.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵会掠夺村庄，让那些家庭一无所有。

entries.example: She decided to plunge into the cold lake before breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 她决定在早餐前跳进冰冷的湖里。

entries.meaning: 加，加号；正的；比所示数量多的；加上；和，以及；加号；正号
entries.example: The rent is eight hundred dollars plus electricity and water each month.
entries.exampleZh: 房租是每月八百美元，外加水电费。

entries.example: They stayed in a plush hotel near the beach for three nights.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在海滩附近一家豪华酒店住了三晚。

entries.meaning: 指，指向；表明；瞄准；尖，尖端；点，小数点；条款，细目；分数，得分；要点，论点，观点
entries.example: The main point of the meeting was to agree on next steps.
entries.exampleZh: 会议的重点是就下一步措施达成一致。

entries.example: She made a pointed comment about the poor results of the team.
entries.exampleZh: 她对团队糟糕的成绩发表了尖锐的评论。

entries.example: It seems pointless to argue about a game that is already over.
entries.exampleZh: 为一场已经结束的比赛争论似乎毫无意义。

entries.meaning: 平衡，保持平衡；泰然自若，自信
entries.example: She answered every difficult question with calm poise and a smile.
entries.exampleZh: 她以平静的自信和微笑回答了每一个难题。

entries.example: The label warns that the bottle contains a dangerous poison.
entries.exampleZh: 标签警告说，这个瓶子里装有危险的毒药。

entries.meaning: 有毒的，有害的；恶毒的，邪恶的
entries.example: Some mushrooms in this forest are poisonous and should never be eaten.
entries.exampleZh: 这片森林里的一些蘑菇有毒，绝不能食用。

entries.example: Do not poke the animal through the bars of its cage.
entries.exampleZh: 不要隔着笼子的栏杆戳那只动物。

entries.example: The polar bear swam between two large pieces of floating ice.
entries.exampleZh: 那只北极熊在两块大浮冰之间游动。

entries.example: The north pole is much colder than most people imagine.
entries.exampleZh: 北极比大多数人想象的要冷得多。

entries.example: The new policy will help small businesses save money.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策将帮助小企业节省开支。

entries.meaning: 磨光，擦光；润饰，使优美；擦光剂；磨光，擦亮；使优美，
entries.example: Please polish the silver vase before our guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 请在客人到来前把银花瓶擦亮。

entries.example: It was politic to stay silent during that heated argument.
entries.exampleZh: 在那场激烈的争论中保持沉默是明智的。

entries.meaning: 对…进行民意测验；获得…选票；民意测验；政治选举，大选
entries.example: The latest poll shows the mayor leading by a small margin.
entries.exampleZh: 最新民调显示市长以微弱优势领先。

entries.meaning: 授以花粉；【植】 给…授粉
entries.example: Bees pollinate many crops that farmers depend on.
entries.exampleZh: 蜜蜂为许多农民依赖的农作物授粉。

entries.example: This factory releases a harmful pollutant into the river every night.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂每晚向河里排放一种有害污染物。

entries.example: Air pollution in the city has become a serious problem.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的空气污染已经成为一个严重问题。

entries.example: His pompous speech bored everyone at the dinner table.
entries.exampleZh: 他那自负的讲话让餐桌上的每个人都感到无聊。

entries.example: She sat by the window to ponder her next move.
entries.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边思考下一步行动。

entries.meaning: 沉重的，笨重的；(文章)冗长的
entries.example: The ponderous old furniture made the room feel dark and crowded.
entries.exampleZh: 笨重的旧家具让房间显得昏暗又拥挤。

entries.meaning: 人口，全体居民；平民，大众
entries.example: The local populace gathered in the square to hear the news.
entries.exampleZh: 当地民众聚集在广场上听消息。

entries.example: The singer's popularity grew quickly after her first album.
entries.exampleZh: 那位歌手的人气在第一张专辑后迅速增长。

entries.meaning: 宣扬，宣传，推广；使普及，使通俗化

entries.exampleZh: 博物馆希望向幼儿普及科学知识。

entries.example: Wild goats populate the rocky hills above the village.
entries.exampleZh: 野山羊居住在这个村庄上方的岩石山丘上。

entries.example: The city's population has doubled in the past twenty years.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的人口在过去二十年里翻了一番。

entries.example: She keeps her fine porcelain in a glass cabinet.
entries.exampleZh: 她把精美的瓷器放在玻璃柜里。

entries.example: We drank tea on the porch while watching the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上喝茶，看着日落。

entries.example: A tiny pore on my nose became red and sore.
entries.exampleZh: 我鼻子上的一个小毛孔变得又红又疼。

entries.example: This porous rock absorbs water quickly after heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 这种多孔的岩石在大雨后很快吸水。

entries.meaning: 港口，舱门，舱口；(船、飞机)左舷

entries.exampleZh: 那艘船在日出前抵达了繁忙的港口。

entries.meaning: 手提式的，便携式的；便于携带的；手提式的

entries.exampleZh: 这个便携式音箱很容易放进我的小背包里。

entries.meaning: 公事包；文件夹；大臣及部长职位

entries.exampleZh: 她把设计样本放在一个黑色皮文件夹里。

entries.meaning: 一部分，一份，一客；部分；一份；划分，分配

entries.exampleZh: 请给每位客人分一份大小合适的蛋糕。

entries.example: The novel tries to portray life in a small fishing village.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说试图描绘一个小渔村的生活。

entries.example: The model held a graceful pose for the photographer.
entries.exampleZh: 模特为摄影师摆出一个优雅的姿势。

entries.meaning: 位置，方位；职位，职务；姿势，姿态；见解，立场；安放，安置
entries.example: Please place the chair in its original position by the window.
entries.exampleZh: 请把椅子放回窗边原来的位置。

entries.meaning: 确定的；确信的，实际的；正的；阳性的；明确的；肯定的；积极的

entries.exampleZh: 她积极的态度帮助整个团队完成了项目。

entries.exampleZh: 很少有人拥有这种细致工作所需的耐心。

entries.meaning: 所有，拥有；财产；持有，拥有；所有权；所有物，财产，财富；领土
entries.example: The old painting is now in the possession of a private collector.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅旧画现在归一位私人收藏家所有。

entries.example: The postage for this heavy parcel costs more than I expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这个重包裹的邮费比我预想的要高。

entries.example: Please write your full address and postcode on the form.
entries.exampleZh: 请在表格上写下你的完整地址和邮政编码。

entries.example: A colorful poster for the concert hangs beside the door.
entries.exampleZh: 门旁挂着一张色彩鲜艳的音乐会海报。

entries.example: These ancient stories were carefully recorded for posterity.
entries.exampleZh: 这些古老的故事被仔细记录下来，传给后代。

entries.meaning: 大学毕业后的，研究院的；研究生

entries.exampleZh: 她正在写关于中国现代文学的研究生论文。

entries.meaning: 遗腹的；父亡后出生的；死后的；身后的

entries.exampleZh: 这名士兵因英勇行为被追授了一项奖励。

entries.meaning: ，验尸，尸体解剖；事后的，死后的

entries.exampleZh: 医生进行了尸检以查明确切的死因。

entries.example: We decided to postpone the meeting until next Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们决定把会议推迟到下周五上午。

entries.example: She added a short postscript at the end of her letter.
entries.exampleZh: 她在信的末尾加了一段简短的附言。

entries.meaning: 姿势，姿态；态度；姿势；心情；态度
entries.example: Sitting with good posture can help reduce back pain.
entries.exampleZh: 保持良好的坐姿有助于减轻背部疼痛。

entries.example: The medicine proved potent enough to ease her severe headache within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 这药效力足够强，几分钟内就缓解了她严重的头痛。

entries.meaning: 潜在的;；可能的；潜能；潜力；潜在的；可能的；潜力，潜能
entries.example: The young athlete has great potential to become a national champion one day.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员有很大潜力，有朝一日会成为全国冠军。

entries.example: The old woman mixed a strange potion to cure the farmer's cough.
entries.exampleZh: 老妇人调了一种奇怪的药水来治农夫的咳嗽。

entries.example: She sells handmade pottery at the local market every Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她每周六上午在当地市场卖手工陶器。

entries.example: The farm raises poultry and grows vegetables for the nearby town.
entries.exampleZh: 这个农场饲养家禽并为附近城镇种植蔬菜。

entries.meaning: 突然袭击；抓住；突袭，猛扑
entries.example: The cat waited quietly before it tried to pounce on the small bird.
entries.exampleZh: 猫静静地等着，然后试图猛扑那只小鸟。

entries.meaning: (液体)倒,注,灌；流入，流出"；灌，倒；倾泻，涌流；喷发；不断涌现
entries.example: Please pour the hot water slowly into the glass cup.
entries.exampleZh: 请把热水慢慢倒进玻璃杯里。

entries.example: Many families in that region still live in serious poverty today.
entries.exampleZh: 那个地区的许多家庭如今仍生活在严重贫困之中。

entries.meaning: 可实行的；能用的，可行的
entries.example: The committee agreed the new plan was practicable and worth trying soon.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会认为这项新计划可行，值得尽快尝试。

entries.meaning: 实行的；注重实际的，实用的；实际的，实用的；实践的，应用的
entries.example: We need a practical solution that fits our limited time and budget.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一个符合我们有限时间和预算的实用解决方案。

entries.meaning: 实践地；几乎；几乎，简直；实际上
entries.example: The shop is practically empty because the owner closed it early.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店几乎空了，因为店主提前关门了。

entries.meaning: 实践者，从事者；(医生或律师等)开业者
entries.example: The experienced practitioner explained the treatment clearly to the nervous patient.
entries.exampleZh: 这位经验丰富的从业者向紧张的病人清楚地解释了治疗方案。

entries.meaning: 重实效的，实际的；务实的；实事求是的；实用主义观点的
entries.example: Our manager takes a pragmatic approach when solving difficult problems at work.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的经理在处理工作中的难题时采取务实的方法。

entries.example: The priest will preach about kindness during the Sunday morning service.
entries.exampleZh: 牧师将在周日早晨的礼拜中宣讲仁慈。

entries.meaning: 不稳定的，不安全的；不安全的，充满危险的；不牢靠的，不稳固的
entries.example: His job felt precarious after the company announced major budget cuts.
entries.exampleZh: 公司宣布大幅削减预算后，他的工作显得很不稳定。

entries.example: Take the necessary precaution before you enter the old factory building.
entries.exampleZh: 进入那座旧工厂建筑前，请采取必要的预防措施。

entries.example: A short speech will precede the main event on Saturday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 周六晚上，主活动之前会有一个简短的讲话。

entries.example: Safety should take precedence over speed when workers operate heavy machines.
entries.exampleZh: 工人操作重型机器时，安全应优先于速度。

entries.meaning: 先例，前例；先例，范例；惯例
entries.example: The court's decision set a clear precedent for similar cases later.
entries.exampleZh: 法院的裁决为后来的类似案件树立了明确的先例。

entries.example: Read the preceding chapter carefully before you start the new assignment.
entries.exampleZh: 开始新作业前，请仔细阅读前面那一章。

entries.example: Her grandmother gave her a precious ring before the family moved abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 祖母在全家移居国外前给了她一枚珍贵的戒指。

entries.example: The narrow path ran along a steep precipice above the rushing river.
entries.exampleZh: 那条狭窄的小路沿着湍急河流上方的陡峭悬崖延伸。

entries.meaning: 猛然抛下；突然发生；加速；沉淀物
entries.example: The sudden news could precipitate a serious crisis within the company.
entries.exampleZh: 这个突然的消息可能在公司内部引发一场严重危机。

entries.meaning: 降雨，降水；仓促，急躁；【化】 沉淀作用
entries.example: Heavy precipitation forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor concert.
entries.exampleZh: 强降水迫使组织者取消了户外音乐会。

entries.meaning: 精确的；精确的，准确的；严谨的

entries.exampleZh: 工程师准确描述了这台新机器的工作原理。

entries.example: The surgeon handled the tiny tools with remarkable precision during the operation.
entries.exampleZh: 手术过程中，外科医生以惊人的精确度操作那些微小的工具。

entries.meaning: 捕食性动物；食肉动物；奴役他人者；剥削者，掠夺者
entries.example: The eagle is a powerful predator that hunts small animals in the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 鹰是一种强大的捕食者，在山谷中捕猎小动物。

entries.example: The company used predatory pricing to drive smaller competitors out of business.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司采用掠夺性定价把较小的竞争者挤出市场。

entries.example: My predecessor left detailed notes about every client in the department.
entries.exampleZh: 我的前任留下了关于部门每位客户的详细笔记。

entries.example: Scientists cannot always predict how quickly the virus will spread among people.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家并不总能预测病毒在人群中传播的速度。

entries.meaning: 可预言的；可预言的，可预报的；按老一套办事的，墨守成规的
entries.example: The story was so predictable that I guessed the ending after ten minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 这个故事太可预测了，我十分钟后就猜到了结局。

entries.example: Her prediction about the election result turned out to be completely wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 她对选举结果的预测最终完全错了。

entries.meaning: 事先影响某人；偏爱；易受感染
entries.example: Early childhood experiences may predispose some people to anxiety later in life.
entries.exampleZh: 童年早期的经历可能使一些人在日后容易焦虑。

entries.example: He has a natural predisposition to help others whenever they need support.
entries.exampleZh: 他有一种天生的倾向，只要别人需要支持就会伸出援手。

entries.meaning: 主要的，占优势的；卓越的，突出的；支配的，主要的；盛行的
entries.example: Blue is the predominant color in the paintings of that famous artist.
entries.exampleZh: 蓝色是那位著名艺术家画作中的主要颜色。

entries.example: Tall dark trees predominate in this quiet forest near the northern border.
entries.exampleZh: 在这片靠近北部边境的安静森林里，高大深色的树木占多数。

entries.example: Workers prefabricate the walls in a factory before transporting them to the site.
entries.exampleZh: 工人在工厂里预制墙体，然后把它们运到工地。

entries.example: The author wrote a short preface explaining why the book was revised.
entries.exampleZh: 作者写了一篇简短的序言，解释这本书为何修订。

entries.meaning: 更可取的，更好的，更合意的

entries.exampleZh: 在繁忙的假期期间，乘火车比开车更可取。

entries.example: She expressed a clear preference for quiet restaurants with simple local food.
entries.exampleZh: 她明确表示更喜欢提供简单本地食物的安静餐厅。

entries.example: Her first pregnancy went smoothly and she felt healthy throughout.
entries.exampleZh: 她的第一次怀孕很顺利，她全程都感觉健康。

entries.meaning: 怀孕的；意义深远的；怀孕的，妊娠的；充满的
entries.example: She is pregnant with twins and expects to give birth in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 她怀了双胞胎，预产期在春天。

entries.meaning: 偏见，成见；(法律)损害，伤害
entries.example: Education can help reduce prejudice against people from different backgrounds.
entries.exampleZh: 教育有助于减少对不同背景的人的偏见。

entries.meaning: 初步的，开端的；开端的，预备的，初步的

entries.exampleZh: 初步结果表明新方法效果良好。

entries.example: The peaceful morning was a prelude to a very busy day.
entries.exampleZh: 宁静的早晨是忙碌一天的序幕。

entries.meaning: 首要的，第一位的；最著名的；总理；首相
entries.example: The premier of the province announced a new health policy yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 该省省长昨天宣布了一项新的卫生政策。

entries.example: The argument rests on the false premise that money brings happiness.
entries.exampleZh: 这个论点建立在金钱带来幸福这一错误前提上。

entries.meaning: 保险费；额外费用；高级的，优质的；
entries.example: Customers are willing to pay a premium for organic food.
entries.exampleZh: 顾客愿意为有机食品支付额外费用。

entries.example: Good preparation is essential for a successful job interview.
entries.exampleZh: 充分的准备对成功的求职面试至关重要。

entries.example: We need to prepare dinner before the guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 我们得在客人到达前准备好晚餐。

entries.example: Basic math is a prerequisite for this advanced physics course.
entries.exampleZh: 基础数学是这门高级物理课的先决条件。

entries.example: It is the manager's prerogative to set the team schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 设定团队日程是经理的特权。

entries.meaning: 吩咐使用；开处方，开药；规定，指示

entries.exampleZh: 医生常为感染开抗生素，但并非总是明智。

entries.meaning: 规定，指定；药方，处方；处方，药方；开处方，开药方

entries.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张止痛处方。

entries.meaning: 出席，到场；风采，风度；出席；存在；仪态

entries.exampleZh: 你出席会议会带来真正的改变。

entries.meaning: 赠送；提出；显示；描述；赠送；赠品，礼物；授予，提供；显示；引荐，介绍；报告；表演，上演
entries.example: She delivered a clear presentation about the new marketing plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她做了一个关于新营销计划的清晰报告。

entries.meaning: 保护；保存；保护；维持；保存，保藏；腌渍

entries.example: The president will speak to the nation tonight at eight.
entries.exampleZh: 总统今晚八点将向全国发表讲话。

entries.meaning: 压力，压强；强制，压迫；对…施加压力；迫使，说服
entries.example: She felt a lot of pressure before the final exam.
entries.exampleZh: 期末考试前她感到压力很大。

entries.meaning: 威信，声望；(由于成功等而产生)显赫

entries.exampleZh: 这所大学通过其研究获得了国际声望。

entries.example: She teaches at a prestigious university in the north of England.
entries.exampleZh: 她在英格兰北部一所享有声望的大学任教。

entries.meaning: 假定地；也许；推测起来，大概

entries.exampleZh: 火车晚点了，所以大概我们会错过换乘。

entries.exampleZh: 他假定所有人都同意他，结果证明这是错的。

entries.meaning: 预先假定…属实；认为，假设；以…为先决条件，以…为前提

entries.exampleZh: 这个计划似乎预先假定全年价格都会保持低廉。

entries.example: Do not pretend to be busy when I need your help.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要你帮忙的时候，别假装很忙。

entries.meaning: 声称，自命；自负，自命不凡
entries.example: Her pretension to great knowledge impressed nobody at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她自命学识渊博，但在会上没有打动任何人。

entries.meaning: 自负的，自命不凡的；自命不凡的，自负的；炫耀的；做作的
entries.example: The restaurant looks pretentious, but the food is quite ordinary.
entries.exampleZh: 这家餐厅看起来很有派头，但食物相当普通。

entries.example: He left the party early on the pretext of feeling tired.
entries.exampleZh: 他以感到疲倦为借口提前离开了聚会。

entries.meaning: 流行，盛行；流行，盛行；占优势，战胜
