entries.exampleZh: 无论需要多久，正义最终会占上风。

entries.example: The prevalence of cheap phones has changed how people communicate.
entries.exampleZh: 廉价手机的普及改变了人们交流的方式。

entries.example: Such attitudes were prevalent among young workers a century ago.
entries.exampleZh: 一个世纪前，这种态度在年轻工人中很普遍。

entries.example: Regular exercise is a good preventative measure against heart disease.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼是预防心脏病的好措施。

entries.meaning: 先前的；以前的；在…之前的；早先的，稍前的

entries.exampleZh: 她以前没有教孩子识字阅读的经验。

entries.meaning: 捕食；被捕食的动物；捕食；折磨，使烦恼；掠夺；猎物，捕获物；牺牲品，战利品

entries.exampleZh: 猫头鹰在黑暗的森林里悄无声息地捕食猎物。

entries.meaning: 最初的；首要的；最初的，初级的；首要的，基本的
entries.example: Our primary aim is to keep every student safe on the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的首要目标是让每个学生在旅途中保持安全。

entries.meaning: 主要的；最好的；首要的；最好的
entries.example: This old house is in a prime location near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这所老房子位于河边一个极好的地段。

entries.meaning: 原始的，简单的；原始的，上古的；简单的，粗糙的；原始人；原始事物
entries.example: The tribe still uses primitive tools made of stone and wood.
entries.exampleZh: 这个部落仍然使用石制和木制的原始工具。

entries.meaning: 主要的；校长；校长；资本；主角
entries.example: The principal reason for our delay was the heavy snow.
entries.exampleZh: 我们延误的主要原因是那场大雪。

entries.meaning: 原则，原理；规范，准则；基本信念，信条
entries.example: Fairness is the guiding principle of everything we do here.
entries.exampleZh: 公平是我们这里一切事情的根本原则。

entries.meaning: 较早的；更重要的；在前的，优先的
entries.example: No prior experience is needed for this beginner course.
entries.exampleZh: 这门初级课程不需要任何先前经验。

entries.meaning: 优先权；优先，重点；优先考虑的事
entries.example: Safety must remain our top priority during the whole project.
entries.exampleZh: 在整个项目期间，安全必须始终是我们的首要任务。

entries.meaning: 隐退；秘密；隐私，私事；隐私权
entries.example: Many young people worry about their privacy on social media.
entries.exampleZh: 许多年轻人担心自己在社交媒体上的隐私。

entries.example: She keeps her private life completely separate from her office work.
entries.exampleZh: 她把私生活与办公室工作完全分开。

entries.meaning: 特权；优惠；特权，优惠，特许；给予特权，特别优待
entries.example: It was a great privilege to work with such talented musicians.
entries.exampleZh: 能与如此有才华的音乐家合作是莫大的荣幸。

entries.example: There is a high probability of rain later this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午晚些时候下雨的可能性很大。

entries.example: The most probable outcome is a small increase in prices.
entries.exampleZh: 最可能的结果是价格小幅上涨。

entries.meaning: 试用，试读；见习，试用；缓刑；缓刑；试用；试用期
entries.example: The new employees must complete a three-month probation period.
entries.exampleZh: 新员工必须完成三个月的试用期。

entries.meaning: 医学探针；新闻调查；探测；探索，查究；探查，探测；探针；探测器，探测飞船；探索，调查
entries.example: Detectives decided to probe the mysterious disappearance of the funds.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探们决定深入调查那笔资金的神秘失踪。

entries.meaning: 过程，步骤；程序，手续；过程
entries.example: Please follow the correct procedure when you submit your report.
entries.exampleZh: 提交报告时请遵循正确的程序。

entries.meaning: 有关的，切题的，中肯的；有关的，相应的；适当的，中肯的；有重大意义的

entries.exampleZh: 请在给经理的最终报告中只包含相关的细节。

entries.example: We need a reliable source before we publish this sensitive story online.
entries.exampleZh: 在网上发表这篇敏感报道之前，我们需要一个可靠的消息来源。

entries.example: His reliance on public transport grew after he sold his old car.
entries.exampleZh: 他卖掉旧车后，对公共交通的依赖增加了。

entries.meaning: 减轻；救济；减轻，解除；援救，救济；安慰；缓合剂
entries.example: The news brought great relief to everyone waiting outside the hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 这个消息给在医院外等候的每个人带来了极大的安慰。

entries.example: These simple exercises can relieve the pain in your lower back.
entries.exampleZh: 这些简单的锻炼可以缓解你下背部的疼痛。

entries.example: She studies religion because she wants to understand different cultures and beliefs.
entries.exampleZh: 她研究宗教，因为她想了解不同的文化和信仰。

entries.example: The manager refused to relinguish control of the project despite strong criticism.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管受到强烈批评，经理仍拒绝放弃对该项目的控制。

entries.example: The company plans to relocate its main office to a smaller city.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划将其总部迁到一个较小的城市。

entries.meaning: 不愿意的，勉强的；不情愿的，勉强的；难得到的，难处理的
entries.example: She was reluctant to sign the contract without reading every page carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 她不愿意在未仔细阅读每一页的情况下签署合同。

entries.example: You can rely on me to finish the work before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以依靠我在周五之前完成这项工作。

entries.example: Only a few seats remain available for tonight's concert in the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 大厅里今晚的音乐会只剩几个座位了。

entries.example: The judge will remark on the evidence before making a final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 法官将在作出最终裁决前对证据发表评论。

entries.meaning: 不平常的；出色的；引人注目的，显著的，值得注意的；异常的，非凡的
entries.example: Her remarkable progress in English impressed every teacher at the school.
entries.exampleZh: 她在英语方面的显著进步给学校的每位老师留下了深刻印象。

entries.meaning: 治疗，补救；纠正；药品；治疗法；补救；治疗；补救
entries.example: A warm drink with honey is a simple remedy for a sore throat.
entries.exampleZh: 加蜂蜜的热饮是缓解喉咙痛的简单方法。

entries.meaning: 提醒；提醒，使想起；使发生联想
entries.example: Please remind me to call my sister after the meeting ends.
entries.exampleZh: 请在会议结束后提醒我给我姐姐打电话。

entries.example: The family depends on the monthly remittance from their son abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 这家人依靠儿子从国外每月寄来的汇款生活。

entries.example: Only a small remnant of the original forest still survives today.
entries.exampleZh: 原始森林如今只剩下一小片残存。

entries.example: She felt deep remorse for the harsh words she had said.
entries.exampleZh: 她对自己说过的刻薄话深感懊悔。

entries.meaning: 远的，长久的；遥远的，偏僻的；远程的；关系疏远的，脱离的；绝少的，微乎其微的；孤高的，冷淡的
entries.example: He works in a remote mountain village with no internet access.
entries.exampleZh: 他在一个没有网络信号的偏远山村工作。

entries.example: The removal of the old tree took the workers three days.
entries.exampleZh: 移除那棵老树花了工人们三天时间。

entries.meaning: 排除，消除；搬迁，移动；开除，解除；距离，间距
entries.example: Please remove your shoes before you step onto the new carpet.
entries.exampleZh: 踏上新地毯前请先脱鞋。

entries.example: The workers demanded fair remuneration for their long hours.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们要求为他们长时间的工作支付公平的报酬。

entries.meaning: 文艺复兴；复兴，勃发；[the R-] 文艺复兴，文艺复兴时期；复兴，新生
entries.example: The city enjoyed a cultural renaissance after the new museum opened.
entries.exampleZh: 新博物馆开馆后，这座城市经历了一场文化复兴。

entries.meaning: 提供，报答；表演，演奏；翻译；使得，致使；给予，以…回报；提供；呈报，递交；表达；表演；翻译
entries.example: The sudden storm could render the mountain road unsafe.
entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的暴风雨可能使这条山路变得不安全。

entries.example: They arranged a secret rendezvous at the old train station.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在老火车站安排了一次秘密约会。

entries.meaning: 表演，扮演，演唱；翻译；视觉再现
entries.example: Her rendition of the famous song moved the whole audience.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这首名曲的演唱感动了全场观众。

entries.meaning: 重新开始；恢复；更换，更新；续借
entries.example: I need to renew my passport before the summer holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要在暑假前续办护照。

entries.meaning: 可更新的，可再生的，可恢复的；可延长有效期的，可续期的
entries.example: Solar power is a renewable source of energy for homes.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳能是家庭使用的一种可再生能源。

entries.meaning: 更新，恢复；重新开始；重建；复兴；续期；重申
entries.example: The renewal of their contract will be discussed next week.
entries.exampleZh: 他们合同的续签将在下周讨论。

entries.example: The old library is closed for a major renovation this year.
entries.exampleZh: 老图书馆今年因大修而关闭。

entries.example: She is a renowned chef with restaurants in three countries.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位在三个国家都有餐厅的著名厨师。

entries.example: We pay the rent on the first day of each month.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在每个月的第一天付租金。

entries.meaning: 租用的；出租的；租金额；出租，租赁
entries.example: The rental price includes insurance and free parking.
entries.exampleZh: 租金包含保险和免费停车。

entries.meaning: 重新定方位；重新定位；使适应
entries.example: The company must reorient its strategy to attract younger customers.
entries.exampleZh: 公司必须重新调整战略以吸引更年轻的顾客。

entries.meaning: 重新包装；重新填塞；再装配；拆修
entries.example: Please repack the boxes carefully before the truck arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 卡车到达前请仔细重新装箱。

entries.example: We plan to repaint the kitchen walls a lighter color.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打算把厨房的墙重新刷成更浅的颜色。

entries.meaning: 遣返；返回；把遣返回国；归国
entries.example: The government agreed to repatriate the workers after the crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 政府同意在危机后遣返这些工人。

entries.example: I promise to repay the money you lent me next month.
entries.exampleZh: 我保证下个月把你借给我的钱还给你。

entries.meaning: 击退；使厌恶；击退，驱逐；抵制，拒绝；使反感，使厌恶
entries.example: This spray can repel mosquitoes for several hours after you apply it.
entries.exampleZh: 这种喷雾在你涂抹之后能驱蚊好几个小时。

entries.example: She began to repent her harsh words soon after the argument ended.
entries.exampleZh: 争吵结束后不久，她就开始后悔自己说了那些刻薄的话。

entries.meaning: 全部剧目，全部节目；常备剧目；全部节目
entries.example: The pianist added three modern pieces to her repertoire this season.
entries.exampleZh: 这位钢琴家本季把三首现代作品加入了她的演奏曲目。

entries.example: Learning a language well demands patience and constant repetition of key patterns.
entries.exampleZh: 学好一门语言需要耐心以及对关键句型的不断重复。

entries.example: We must replace the broken window before the cold weather arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在寒冷天气到来之前换掉那扇破窗户。

entries.example: Please replenish the water bottles in the fridge before the guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 请在客人到来之前把冰箱里的水瓶补满。

entries.meaning: 重复，复现或复制；再制造；再生
entries.example: Scientists tried to replicate the experiment but obtained slightly different results.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们试图复现这个实验，但得到了略有不同的结果。

entries.meaning: 代表；声称；代表；表示；表现
entries.example: These figures represent the total sales of our company last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这些数字代表我们公司去年的总销售额。

entries.meaning: 典型的，有代表性的；代表，代理人
entries.example: She was chosen as the representative of our class at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她被选为我们班在会上发言的代表。

entries.example: He gave his son a gentle reproach for coming home so late.
entries.exampleZh: 他因为儿子回家太晚而温和地责备了他。

entries.meaning: 繁殖，生育；复制，仿造，翻版；再现，使…在脑海中重现
entries.example: These tiny plants reproduce quickly in warm and wet conditions.
entries.exampleZh: 这些微小的植物在温暖潮湿的环境中繁殖很快。

entries.meaning: 爬行动物；爬虫；爬行动物，爬虫类；卑鄙的人
entries.example: The zoo keeps several kinds of reptile in a heated building.
entries.exampleZh: 这家动物园把好几种爬行动物养在一座供暖的建筑里。

entries.meaning: 名声好的，高尚的；受尊敬的；值得信赖的
entries.example: You should only buy medicine from a reputable pharmacy or clinic.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该只从信誉良好的药店或诊所买药。

entries.example: The restaurant has a good reputation for fresh seafood and friendly staff.
entries.exampleZh: 这家餐厅以海鲜新鲜、员工友好而享有好名声。

entries.example: The manager approved my request for two days off next week.
entries.exampleZh: 经理批准了我下周请两天假的请求。

entries.example: All students require a valid card to enter the library after dark.
entries.exampleZh: 所有学生天黑后进入图书馆都需要一张有效卡。

entries.meaning: 需要，需求，要求；需要的东西；必要条件
entries.example: The main requirement for this job is excellent spoken English.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作的主要要求是出色的英语口语。

entries.meaning: 需要的；必要的；必需品；要素
entries.example: She lacked the requisite skills for the position she applied for.
entries.exampleZh: 她缺乏她所申请职位所需的技能。

entries.example: The officer signed a requisition for more medical supplies this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那名军官今天上午签署了一份索取更多医疗物资的正式申请。

entries.example: The fire crew managed a daring rescue of two trapped hikers.
entries.exampleZh: 消防队成功完成了一次大胆的营救，救出两名被困的徒步者。

entries.example: There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters.
entries.exampleZh: 这两姐妹之间有着惊人的相似之处。

entries.example: These two paintings resemble each other in style and colour.
entries.exampleZh: 这两幅画在风格和色彩上彼此相似。

entries.meaning: 怨恨；愤恨；对…表示愤恨，感到气愤
entries.example: I resent the way he speaks to the new staff.
entries.exampleZh: 我对他跟新员工说话的方式感到气愤。

entries.meaning: 保留意见，存疑；预定，预订
entries.example: She made a reservation for four at the new Italian place.
entries.exampleZh: 她在新开的意大利餐厅订了四个人的位子。

entries.meaning: 保存；预定；预订，预约；保留；储备；储备；自然保护区
entries.example: We should reserve a table before the concert starts.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应该在音乐会开始前预订一张桌子。

entries.meaning: 说话不多的，内向的；有所保留的，预订的
entries.example: He is quite reserved and rarely speaks at team meetings.
entries.exampleZh: 他相当内向，在团队会议上很少发言。

entries.example: The city draws most of its water from a nearby reservoir.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的大部分用水来自附近的一座水库。

entries.meaning: 居住；住处；住宅；住宅，住处；居住
entries.example: Their new residence stands at the end of a quiet lane.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新住宅位于一条安静小路的尽头。

entries.meaning: 常驻的，居住的；居民，住户
entries.example: Every resident on our street received a notice about the repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们街上的每位住户都收到了一份关于维修的通知。

entries.example: This quiet residential area has no shops or offices.
entries.exampleZh: 这个安静的住宅区没有商店和办公室。

entries.meaning: 放弃；辞去；辞职；辞去；放弃
entries.example: He plans to resign from his post at the end of May.
entries.exampleZh: 他打算在五月底辞去他的职务。

entries.example: The manager handed in her resignation after a serious disagreement.
entries.exampleZh: 经理在一次严重分歧之后递交了辞呈。

entries.meaning: 回弹，弹性；弹性，弹力；复原力；适应性；乐观的性情
entries.example: Her resilience helped her recover quickly from the setback.
entries.exampleZh: 她的复原力帮助她迅速从挫折中恢复过来。

entries.example: It is hard to resist the smell of fresh bread.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味让人难以抗拒。

entries.meaning: 反抗，抵制；抵抗力，抵抗性；阻力；电阻
entries.example: The new policy met strong resistance from local farmers.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策遭到了当地农民的强烈抵制。

entries.example: This fabric is resistant to water and stays dry in rain.
entries.exampleZh: 这种布料防水，在雨中能保持干燥。

entries.example: He must resit the exam because his score was too low.
entries.exampleZh: 他必须补考这门考试，因为他的分数太低。

entries.meaning: 坚决，坚定；决定，决议；决心，解决
entries.example: She made a firm resolution to exercise every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她下定了每天早晨锻炼的坚定决心。

entries.meaning: 解决；决定；解决，解答；决定，决意；分解，分析；决心，决意
entries.example: They hope to resolve the dispute without going to court.
entries.exampleZh: 他们希望不诉诸法庭就解决这场纠纷。

entries.example: Her voice was so resonant that the whole hall fell silent.
entries.exampleZh: 她的嗓音洪亮而富有共鸣，整个大厅都安静了下来。

entries.meaning: 求助；求助；诉诸；求助；诉诸；胜地
entries.example: The small resort by the lake fills up quickly every summer.
entries.exampleZh: 湖边那个小小的度假胜地每到夏天很快就住满了。

entries.meaning: 资源；机智；资源〔指土地、矿产等〕；向…提供资源
entries.example: Water is our most precious resource in this dry region.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个干旱的地区，水是我们最宝贵的资源。

entries.example: I respect her honesty, even when the truth is painful.
entries.exampleZh: 我尊重她的诚实，即使真相令人痛苦。

entries.meaning: 呼吸作用；一次呼吸；植物光合作用
entries.example: Doctors monitor his respiration closely after the operation.
entries.exampleZh: 手术之后，医生密切监测他的呼吸。

entries.meaning: 回答，答复；响应；作出反应
entries.example: Please respond to my email before Friday afternoon if possible.
entries.exampleZh: 如果可能，请在周五下午之前回复我的邮件。

entries.meaning: 回答者，响应者；调查对象；被告
entries.example: Each respondent received a short questionnaire about daily travel habits.
entries.exampleZh: 每位受访者都收到了一份关于日常出行习惯的简短问卷。

entries.example: Her quick response saved the team from a serious mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 她的迅速回应使团队避免了一个严重错误。

entries.example: Taking care of the garden is my responsibility this month.
entries.exampleZh: 这个月照料花园是我的责任。

entries.example: She is responsible for training all the new staff members.
entries.exampleZh: 她负责培训所有新员工。

entries.example: The new manager is always responsive to suggestions from her staff.
entries.exampleZh: 新经理总是对员工的建议积极回应。

entries.example: The children grew restless during the long wait at the airport.
entries.exampleZh: 在机场漫长的等待中，孩子们变得焦躁不安。

entries.meaning: 恢复；归还；恢复，使复位；修复，整修，重建；归还，交还
entries.example: Workers will restore the old bridge over the river next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们明年春天将修复河上的那座旧桥。

entries.example: He could hardly restrain his anger when they changed the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 当他们改变计划时，他几乎无法抑制自己的愤怒。

entries.example: The city may restrict traffic in the centre on weekends.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市可能在周末限制市中心的交通。

entries.example: A new restriction on plastic bags starts next Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 一项关于塑料袋的新限制下周一开始实施。

entries.meaning: 重新开始；继续；重新占用；重新开始，继续恢复
entries.example: Classes will resume on Monday after the long holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 长假之后，课程将于周一恢复。

entries.meaning: 零售，零卖；零售，以…价格销售；零售
entries.example: She works in retail and enjoys helping customers choose gifts.
entries.exampleZh: 她从事零售工作，喜欢帮顾客挑选礼物。

entries.meaning: 零售商人；复述者，传播者
entries.example: The online retailer offers free delivery on large orders.
entries.exampleZh: 这家网络零售商对大额订单提供免费送货。

entries.example: Online retailing has changed how small shops do business.
entries.exampleZh: 网络零售改变了小商店的经营方式。

entries.meaning: 保持，保有；聘请(律师)；保留；保持
entries.example: She managed to retain her calm during the difficult interview.
entries.exampleZh: 在那次艰难的面试中，她设法保持了镇定。

entries.example: The company chose not to retaliate against the unfair criticism.
entries.exampleZh: 公司选择不对那些不公平的批评进行报复。

entries.meaning: 沉默寡言的；言不如意的
entries.example: He was rather reticent about his plans for the summer.
entries.exampleZh: 他对自己夏天的计划相当沉默寡言。

entries.example: My father plans to retire from teaching next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲打算明年春天从教学生涯中退休。

entries.example: Her quick retort made everyone at the table laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 她机智的反驳让桌旁的人都笑了。

entries.example: The army was forced to retreat after a long battle.
entries.exampleZh: 经过一场漫长的战斗后，军队被迫撤退。

entries.example: The firm announced a serious retrenchment after losing key clients.
entries.exampleZh: 失去重要客户后，这家公司宣布进行大规模的削减开支。

entries.example: He dived into the water to retrieve his lost keys.
entries.exampleZh: 他跳进水里去捞回丢失的钥匙。

entries.example: In retrospect, that decision was clearly a serious mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 回想起来，那个决定显然是个严重的错误。

entries.meaning: 重聚，团聚；聚会，联谊活动
entries.example: Our family reunion last summer was full of laughter and stories.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天的家庭团聚充满了欢笑和故事。

entries.example: The war finally ended and the sisters could reunite.
entries.exampleZh: 战争终于结束，姐妹俩得以重聚。

entries.example: The report will reveal several surprising facts about the local market.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告将揭示有关当地市场的几个令人惊讶的事实。

entries.example: Volunteers worked for years to revegetate the damaged hillside.
entries.exampleZh: 志愿者们花了数年时间在受损的山坡上重新植被。

entries.meaning: 揭示，揭露；被揭示的真相，新发现；揭示，显示；泄露
entries.example: The revelation about the company's hidden debts shocked all the investors.
entries.exampleZh: 关于公司隐藏债务的披露让所有投资者感到震惊。

entries.example: He wanted to revenge himself on the man who had lied.
entries.exampleZh: 他想对那个撒谎的人进行报复。

entries.meaning: (国家的)年收入；税收；收入；税收
entries.example: Tourism brings a large amount of revenue to this small island.
entries.exampleZh: 旅游业给这个小岛带来了大量的收入。

entries.example: The visitors stood in reverent silence before the ancient statue.
entries.exampleZh: 参观者在那座古老的雕像前恭敬地静立。

entries.meaning: 相反(的)；颠倒(的)；相反的；倒转的，颠倒的；颠倒，倒退；相反，颠倒；背面，后面

entries.exampleZh: 这款软件可以模拟逼真的天气条件用于飞行员训练。

entries.example: The flight simulation felt almost real to every new pilot.
entries.exampleZh: 这次飞行模拟对每位新飞行员来说几乎真实。

entries.meaning: 同时发生的；同时的，同时发生的，同时存在的；同步的
entries.example: The two events were simultaneous, so nobody could attend both.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个活动是同时举行的，所以没人能两个都参加。

entries.meaning: 真挚的；诚恳的；真挚的，诚挚的，真诚的，诚恳的
entries.example: Her sincere apology convinced everyone that she truly regretted the mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 她真诚的道歉让每个人都相信她确实后悔了这个错误。

entries.example: The old rope was made from strong animal sinew.
entries.exampleZh: 那根旧绳子是用结实的动物肌腱制成的。

entries.meaning: 单一的；未婚的；单人的；单打，单程票
entries.example: She bought a single ticket for the evening train to Boston.
entries.exampleZh: 她买了一张去波士顿的晚间火车单程票。

entries.example: Her singular talent for music impressed every judge at the competition.
entries.exampleZh: 她在音乐方面的非凡才华让比赛中的每位评委都印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 不吉祥的，凶兆的；险恶的，邪恶的
entries.example: A sinister figure stood quietly at the end of the dark hall.
entries.exampleZh: 一个险恶的身影静静地站在黑暗走廊的尽头。

entries.example: The kitchen sink was full of dirty dishes after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭后厨房的水槽里堆满了脏盘子。

entries.example: She slowly began to sip the hot tea while reading.
entries.exampleZh: 她一边读书一边慢慢开始小口喝热茶。

entries.example: The construction site was closed because of heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 建筑工地因大雨而关闭。

entries.meaning: 坐落在的；处于某种境地的；位于…的；处于…境地的
entries.example: The hotel is situated near the river and the old market.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店坐落在河边和老市场附近。

entries.example: They saved a sizeable amount of money for their summer trip.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为夏季旅行存下了一笔相当多的钱。

entries.meaning: 骨骼；(建筑物、计划的)骨架；纲要
entries.example: The museum displayed a huge dinosaur skeleton in the main hall.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆在主大厅展示了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

entries.meaning: 草图，素描;；短剧；简述；草拟；画素描；概述；素描；速写
entries.example: The artist made a quick sketch of the mountains before sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 艺术家在日落前画了一幅山的速写。

entries.example: Missing data can skew the results of the whole survey.
entries.exampleZh: 缺失的数据可能会使整个调查的结果出现偏差。

entries.meaning: 浏览，略读；掠过，抹去；撇去；掠过，擦过；浏览，略读
entries.example: I only had time to skim the report before the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 开会前我只来得及浏览一下报告。

entries.example: Do not skip breakfast if you want to stay healthy.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你想保持健康，就不要跳过早餐。

entries.example: The doctor examined the patient's skull after the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 事故后医生检查了病人的颅骨。

entries.example: The new skyscraper towers over the old buildings downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新摩天楼高耸于市中心的旧建筑之上。

entries.example: A heavy stone slab covered the entrance to the ancient tomb.
entries.exampleZh: 一块沉重的石板盖住了古墓的入口。

entries.meaning: 懈怠的；萧条的；呆滞的；松驰的；不紧的
entries.example: The rope was too slack to hold the boat safely.
entries.exampleZh: 绳子太松，无法安全地固定住船。

entries.example: Please slacken the rope slowly before you move the boat.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你移动船之前慢慢放松绳子。

entries.example: Workers removed the dark slag from the furnace after the fire.
entries.exampleZh: 大火之后，工人们清除了炉子里黑色的炉渣。

entries.example: I heard the slam of the front door late last night.
entries.exampleZh: 我昨晚很晚听到前门砰的一声关上。

entries.meaning: 诽谤，污蔑；诋毁，中伤，诽谤；诋毁，诽谤
entries.example: The actor sued the magazine for slander after the false story.
entries.exampleZh: 那篇虚假报道之后，这位演员起诉那家杂志诽谤。

entries.example: She threatened to slap the rude man across the face.
entries.exampleZh: 她威胁要扇那个粗鲁男人的耳光。

entries.meaning: 砍；大幅度削减；砍痕，伤痕；斜线号
entries.example: The company will slash its travel budget by half next year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司明年将把差旅预算削减一半。

entries.example: One wooden slat was missing from the old garden bench.
entries.exampleZh: 旧花园长椅上少了一根木条。

entries.example: The roof was covered with gray slate from a local quarry.
entries.exampleZh: 屋顶铺着来自当地采石场的灰色石板。

entries.example: The film shows the cruel slaughter of innocent animals in the wild.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影展示了野外无辜动物遭到残忍屠杀。

entries.example: The children pulled their sledge up the snowy hill together.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们一起把雪橇拉上白雪覆盖的山坡。

entries.meaning: 光滑而有光泽的；时髦的；豪华的；使光滑发亮
entries.example: Her sleek black hair shone under the bright kitchen lights.
entries.exampleZh: 她乌黑顺滑的头发在明亮的厨房灯光下闪闪发亮。

entries.meaning: 细长的，苗条的；纤弱的，微小的，微薄的；修长的，细长的，苗条的；微小的，微薄的
entries.example: A slender young woman walked quietly along the river bank.
entries.exampleZh: 一位身材苗条的年轻女子沿着河岸静静地走着。

entries.meaning: 片，部分；切片；把…切成片，削；薄片，切片；份，部分
entries.example: He cut a thin slice of bread for his breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 他切了一片薄面包当早餐。

entries.meaning: 滑；幻灯片；滑动；滑动，下滑；悄悄地移动；滑动，下滑；滑坡，滑道，滑面；幻灯片；突然崩落
entries.example: The children love to slide down the hill in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天孩子们喜欢从山上滑下来。

entries.meaning: 细长的，轻微的；轻视，怠慢；轻微的，微小的；侮慢；轻视，冷落
entries.example: There is a slight difference between the two blue shirts.
entries.exampleZh: 这两件蓝衬衫之间有一点细微差别。

entries.meaning: 细长的；苗条的；变苗条；苗条的；薄的
entries.example: She looks slim and healthy after months of regular exercise.
entries.exampleZh: 经过几个月的规律锻炼，她看起来苗条又健康。

entries.meaning: 滑，失误；滑倒，失足；减退；摆脱，闪开；塞入；差错，疏漏；滑倒；纸片
entries.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet kitchen floor.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别在湿滑的厨房地板上滑倒。

entries.meaning: 表面光滑的，(人)不老实的，不可靠的；滑的，滑溜的；油滑的，狡猾的；棘手的
entries.example: The icy pavement was so slippery that we walked very slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 结冰的人行道太滑了，我们走得很慢。

entries.meaning: 狭长的切口；裂缝；切开，撕裂
entries.example: He cut a narrow slit in the envelope with a knife.
entries.exampleZh: 他用刀在信封上划开一道窄缝。

entries.example: The company's new slogan appears on every poster in town.
entries.exampleZh: 公司的新标语出现在城里每一张海报上。

entries.meaning: 斜线，斜度；倾斜面，斜坡；倾斜；斜坡；倾斜
entries.example: The children ran down the grassy slope towards the river.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们沿着长满草的斜坡跑向河边。

entries.example: Put the coin into the slot and wait for your ticket.
entries.exampleZh: 把硬币投入投币口，然后等你的票。

entries.example: His slothful habits made him fail most of his exams.
entries.exampleZh: 他懒散的习惯让他大多数考试都不及格。

entries.meaning: 懒散地站；低头垂肩地站
entries.example: Please don't slouch in your chair during the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 开会时请不要在椅子上懒散地瘫着。

entries.example: The old computer feels sluggish after running several heavy programs.
entries.exampleZh: 运行几个大型程序后，这台旧电脑就变得很迟钝。

entries.meaning: 平民窟; 陋巷；贫民窟，贫民区
entries.example: The charity built a small school in the crowded slum.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构在拥挤的贫民窟里建了一所小学校。

entries.example: The baby began to slumber quietly in his mother's arms.
entries.exampleZh: 婴儿开始在母亲怀里安静地入睡。

entries.meaning: 大幅度下降，暴跌；突然倒下，猛然落下；萧条期；低潮状态
entries.example: Sales began to slump sharply after the new tax was announced.
entries.exampleZh: 新税公布后，销售额开始急剧下跌。

entries.example: The workers pumped thick slurry from the flooded tunnel.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们从被淹的隧道里抽出了浓稠的泥浆。

entries.example: Her sluttish room was full of dirty clothes and old papers.
entries.exampleZh: 她那邋遢的房间堆满了脏衣服和旧报纸。

entries.meaning: 漂亮的；聪明的；轻快的；漂亮的，时髦的；高明的
entries.example: She wore a smart black dress to the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条漂亮的黑色连衣裙去面试。

entries.example: The angry boy tried to smash the window with a stone.
entries.exampleZh: 那个生气的男孩想用石头砸碎窗户。

entries.meaning: 胡乱涂抹；弄脏，弄污；诽谤，诋毁；变得模糊不清，
entries.example: Do not smear that wet paint on your new shirt.
entries.exampleZh: 别把那种湿油漆抹到你的新衬衫上。

entries.example: I can smell fresh bread from the bakery next door.
entries.exampleZh: 我能闻到隔壁面包店新鲜面包的香味。

entries.meaning: 光滑的；平稳的；使光滑；使平稳；顺利的；流畅的；协调的
entries.example: She used a warm iron to smooth the wrinkled tablecloth.
entries.exampleZh: 她用温热的熨斗把起皱的桌布熨平。

entries.meaning: 使窒息，使闷死；闷住；抑制；忍住；厚厚地覆盖；窒息；把闷熄
entries.example: Thick smoke began to smother the firefighters inside the burning house.
entries.exampleZh: 浓烟开始让着火的房子里的消防员窒息。

entries.example: They tried to smuggle rare birds across the border last night.
entries.exampleZh: 他们昨晚试图把珍稀鸟类偷运过边境。

entries.meaning: 快餐，小吃；快餐，小吃；点心
entries.example: She packed a healthy snack for the long train journey.
entries.exampleZh: 她为长途火车旅行带了一份健康零食。

entries.meaning: out；of；中迅速恢复过来；改变；咔嚓折断，啪地绷断；打开；咬；厉声说话，怒声责斥；突然的，匆忙的；咔嚓声
entries.example: The branch broke with a loud snap during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨中，树枝咔嚓一声断了。

entries.example: He tried to snatch the bag from her hands.
entries.exampleZh: 他试图从她手中抢走包。

entries.meaning: 势利的，谄上欺下的；自命不凡的
entries.example: Her snobbish remarks made the whole team feel uncomfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 她势利的言论让整个团队感到不舒服。

entries.example: Please soak the dirty clothes in warm water before washing them.
entries.exampleZh: 请把脏衣服在温水里浸泡一下再洗。

entries.meaning: 鸟高飞，翱翔；[喻]高涨，猛增
entries.example: House prices continue to soar in many large coastal cities.
entries.exampleZh: 许多大型沿海城市的房价持续猛涨。

entries.example: He remained sober throughout the serious discussion about the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 在关于事故的严肃讨论中，他一直保持清醒。

entries.meaning: 友好的，喜好交际的；友善的，友好的；好交际的，合群的
entries.example: She is sociable and enjoys meeting new people at parties.
entries.exampleZh: 她很好交际，喜欢在聚会上结识新朋友。

entries.meaning: 来往，交往，交际；使适应社会生活
entries.example: Students often socialise with friends after their morning classes end.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们上午的课结束后常常和朋友交往。

entries.example: She decided to study sociology because of her interest in modern cities.
entries.exampleZh: 由于对现代城市感兴趣，她决定学习社会学。

entries.example: The gardener mixed rich soil with sand before planting the seeds.
entries.exampleZh: 园丁在播种前把肥沃的土壤和沙子混合在一起。

entries.meaning: 太阳的；太阳的；太阳能的
entries.example: They installed solar panels on the roof to save electricity.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在屋顶安装了太阳能电池板以节省电费。

entries.meaning: 脚底；单独的；惟一的；唯一的，独有的；鞋底，袜底；脚底
entries.example: Her sole reason for moving was to find better work.
entries.exampleZh: 她搬家的唯一原因是找到更好的工作。

entries.meaning: 庄严的，严肃的，隆重的；庄严的，隆重的；严肃的，认真的
entries.example: The ceremony was solemn, and everyone spoke in quiet voices.
entries.exampleZh: 仪式庄严肃穆，大家都轻声说话。

entries.meaning: 法务官；初级律师，事务律师
entries.example: She asked her solicitor to review the contract before signing it.
entries.exampleZh: 她请她的初级律师在签字前审阅合同。

entries.example: The workers showed solidarity by supporting each other during the strike.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在罢工期间互相支持，表现出团结一致。

entries.meaning: 巩固，确保；凝固，固化；团结
entries.example: The cold air will solidify the melted wax within a few minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 冷空气会在几分钟内使融化的蜡凝固。

entries.meaning: 独居的，孤独的，惟一的；荒凉的
entries.example: He leads a solitary life in a small house near the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 他在森林附近的一所小房子里过着孤独的生活。

entries.example: Her solo in the school concert received loud applause from parents.
entries.exampleZh: 她在学校音乐会上的独唱赢得了家长们的热烈掌声。

entries.meaning: 可溶解的；可溶的；可解决的
entries.example: Sugar is soluble in warm water, as every cook knows.
entries.exampleZh: 糖能溶于温水，这是每个厨师都知道的。

entries.meaning: 解决困难，解答问题；溶解；溶液；解答，解决办法；溶解，溶液
entries.example: The simplest solution to this problem may surprise everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 这个问题的简单解决办法可能会让房间里的每个人吃惊。

entries.example: Can you solve this puzzle before the timer rings at noon?
entries.exampleZh: 你能在中午计时器响之前解开这个谜题吗？

entries.meaning: 能偿还的；溶剂，偿付能力
entries.example: Water is a common solvent in many school chemistry experiments.
entries.exampleZh: 水是许多学校化学实验中的常见溶剂。

entries.example: She somehow finished the difficult report before the office closed.
entries.exampleZh: 她不知怎么在办公室关门前完成了那份困难的报告。

entries.example: The final exam was somewhat harder than the students had expected.
entries.exampleZh: 期末考试比学生们预想的有点难。

entries.example: As a city sophisticate, he knew the best restaurants and galleries.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一个城市里久经世故的人，他知道最好的餐馆和画廊。

entries.meaning: 老练的，有经验的，世故的；尖端的；老于世故的，老练的；精密的，尖端的，先进的；复杂的；高雅的，有教养的
entries.example: Her sophisticated taste in art impressed the visitors at the small gallery.
entries.exampleZh: 她在艺术方面高雅的品味让小画廊的参观者印象深刻。

entries.meaning: 疼痛的；恼火的；痛的；恼火的；剧烈的；疮
entries.example: My throat felt sore after I sang for the whole evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我唱了一整晚后喉咙感到疼痛。

entries.example: Her face showed deep sorrow when she heard the sad news.
entries.exampleZh: 当她听到那个悲伤的消息时，脸上露出深深的悲哀。

entries.example: What sort of music do you enjoy listening to on weekends?
entries.exampleZh: 你周末喜欢听哪种音乐？

entries.meaning: 健康的，健全的；可靠的，充分的；彻底的
entries.example: The doctor said my heart is sound and my lungs are clear.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说我心脏健康，肺部清晰。

entries.example: The milk tastes sour because it stayed out of the fridge.
entries.exampleZh: 牛奶尝起来发酸，因为它被放在冰箱外面了。

entries.meaning: 来源，出处；源头，发源地；根源，起源
entries.example: The river is an important source of water for nearby farms.
entries.exampleZh: 这条河是附近农场的重要水源。

entries.example: She bought a small souvenir for her sister at the museum shop.
entries.exampleZh: 她在博物馆商店给妹妹买了一个小纪念品。

entries.example: The small nation became sovereign after many years of peaceful struggle.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小型国家经过多年和平斗争后成为主权国家。

entries.example: Farmers sow seeds in spring when the soil becomes warm.
entries.exampleZh: 农民在土壤变暖的春天播种。

entries.example: The spacecraft landed safely on the moon after a long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 宇宙飞船经过漫长旅程后安全降落在月球上。

entries.meaning: 广阔的，宽敞的；宽广的，宽敞的
entries.example: Their new apartment is bright and spacious, with a large kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新公寓明亮宽敞，还有一个大厨房。

entries.example: He used a spade to dig a hole for the young tree.
entries.exampleZh: 他用铁锹为小树挖了一个坑。

entries.meaning: 跨度；跨越；横跨；持续；跨距；一段时间
entries.example: The bridge's span reaches nearly two kilometres across the wide river.
entries.exampleZh: 这座桥的跨度接近两公里，横跨宽阔的河面。

entries.meaning: 空闲的；剩余的；备用件；闲置的；备用的，外加的；空闲的；省出，抽出；饶恕，赦免；免去；不吝惜；备用品；
entries.example: Do you have a spare pen I could borrow for the exam?
entries.exampleZh: 你有备用的笔可以借我考试用吗？

entries.example: A single spark from the wire started the fire in the dry grass.
entries.exampleZh: 电线迸出的一颗火花点燃了干草中的火。

entries.example: Her eyes sparkle whenever she talks about her favourite music.
entries.exampleZh: 每当谈起自己最喜欢的音乐，她的眼睛就闪闪发亮。

entries.example: Vegetation is sparse on the high plateau above the tree line.
entries.exampleZh: 在树线以上的高原地带，植被十分稀疏。

entries.example: A sudden spasm in his back made him drop the heavy box.
entries.exampleZh: 背部突然的一阵抽搐让他失手摔下了沉重的箱子。

entries.example: The machine gave a spasmodic jerk before it finally stopped.
entries.exampleZh: 机器在最终停下之前猛地抽搐了一下。

entries.example: Children develop spatial awareness through play and physical activity.
entries.exampleZh: 儿童通过游戏和身体活动来发展空间意识。

entries.meaning: 专门研究，专攻；专用于，使适应特殊目的
entries.example: She plans to specialise in children's heart surgery after medical school.
entries.exampleZh: 她打算从医学院毕业后专攻儿童心脏外科。

entries.example: The specialist examined my knee and recommended a month of rest.
entries.exampleZh: 那位专家检查了我的膝盖，建议休息一个月。

entries.exampleZh: 这座塔的钢结构上部已于去年春天完工。

entries.meaning: 监督，管理，指导；监督，管理；指导
entries.example: Two teachers will supervise the students during the science exam.
entries.exampleZh: 两位老师将在科学考试期间监督学生。

entries.example: Children should not swim here without adult supervision.
entries.exampleZh: 没有大人监督，孩子们不应在这里游泳。

entries.meaning: 监督人，管理人，指导者；主管
entries.example: My supervisor approved my request for two days off.
entries.exampleZh: 我的主管批准了我请两天假的申请。

entries.meaning: 补充，增补['sʌplɪmənt]；增补，补充；补遗；增刊；附录
entries.example: She takes a vitamin supplement every morning with breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天早晨吃早饭时服用一片维生素补充剂。

entries.meaning: 补充的，附加的；增补的，补充的
entries.example: The teacher handed out supplementary notes before the final lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在最后一节课前发了补充讲义。

entries.meaning: 供给，供应；；供给，供应；满足，弥补
entries.example: The village has a limited supply of clean drinking water.
entries.exampleZh: 这个村庄的清洁饮用水供应有限。

entries.meaning: 支持的，支援的；赞助的；鼓励的；同情的
entries.example: My parents were very supportive when I changed my career.
entries.exampleZh: 我改变职业时，父母非常支持我。

entries.meaning: 假想，假定，猜想，推测；[用于祈使句]假定，让；[常用于被动语态]期望做，认为应该做
entries.example: I suppose we should leave before the traffic gets worse.
entries.exampleZh: 我想我们该在交通变得更堵之前出发。

entries.example: The castle is supposedly haunted by a former king.
entries.exampleZh: 据说这座城堡里有一位前国王的鬼魂出没。

entries.example: Her theory is based on supposition rather than solid evidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她的理论基于猜测而非确凿的证据。

entries.meaning: 镇压；平定；抑制；隐瞒；压制，镇压；禁止发表，查禁；抑制，忍住；阻止…的生长
entries.example: He tried to suppress a smile during the serious meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 在严肃的会议上，他努力忍住不笑。

entries.example: The suppression of the protest angered many local citizens.
entries.exampleZh: 对抗议活动的镇压激怒了许多当地市民。

entries.meaning: 最高的；最大的，最重要的
entries.example: The king held supreme power over the entire region.
entries.exampleZh: 国王掌握着整个地区的最高权力。

entries.example: The hotel added a small surcharge for room service.
entries.exampleZh: 酒店对客房送餐服务收取了一小笔额外费用。

entries.example: We plan to surf near the quiet beach tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划明天早上在安静的海滩附近冲浪。

entries.meaning: 浮出水面；浮现，显露；在…上加表面；表面；外表，外观
entries.example: The submarine rose to the surface after a long dive.
entries.exampleZh: 潜艇在长时间下潜后浮出水面。

entries.meaning: 波动，汹涌，澎湃；蜂拥而出；波动，涌动；洋溢；猛增
entries.example: A sudden surge of wind shook the small tent.
entries.exampleZh: 一阵突如其来的风摇晃着小帐篷。

entries.example: The surgeon washed her hands before the long operation.
entries.exampleZh: 那位外科医生在长时间手术前洗了手。

entries.meaning: 外科，外科手术；外科学；外科手术；手术室，诊疗室
entries.example: He needs surgery on his knee next week.
entries.exampleZh: 他下周需要做膝盖手术。

entries.example: They worked hard to surmount every problem during the project.
entries.exampleZh: 他们努力工作，克服了项目期间的每一个问题。

entries.meaning: 超过，超越，胜过；超过，超越，优于，胜过；超过…的界限，非…所能办到
entries.example: Her latest results surpass all our earlier expectations.
entries.exampleZh: 她最新的成绩超过了我们早先的所有预期。

entries.example: The farm sold its surplus grain at a fair price.
entries.exampleZh: 农场以合理的价格卖掉了剩余的谷物。

entries.example: The soldiers refused to surrender despite the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们尽管下着大雨仍拒绝投降。

entries.example: Tall trees surround the old house on three sides.
entries.exampleZh: 高大的树木从三面环绕着那座老房子。

entries.example: She quickly adapted to her new surroundings at college.
entries.exampleZh: 她很快适应了大学里的新环境。

entries.example: The bank added cameras for better surveillance of the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 银行在大厅里增设了摄像头以便更好地监视。

entries.meaning: 环视，眺望；测量；勘定；检查；概述；调查，勘察；测量，勘测；审视；调查，检视；测量，勘测；俯瞰，眺望
entries.example: We conducted a short survey about lunch options yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们昨天就午餐选择做了一项简短调查。

entries.example: Clean water is essential for survival in the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 在沙漠中，干净的水对生存至关重要。

entries.meaning: 活下来；幸免于；比…活得长，比…长命
entries.example: These plants can survive long periods without any rain.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物能够在没有任何雨水的情况下存活很长时间。

entries.meaning: 敏感的；易受感动的；易受影响的，易受伤害的；易受感染的；敏感的，易动感情的；能经受…的，容许…的
entries.example: Young children are more susceptible to colds in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 年幼的孩子在冬天更容易感冒。

entries.meaning: 疑有,猜想;觉得可疑；嫌疑犯；可疑的"；猜想，怀疑
entries.example: The police suspect the driver was not paying attention.
entries.exampleZh: 警察怀疑司机当时没有注意。

entries.meaning: 吊，悬挂，悬浮；暂停；吊，悬挂；推迟；暂停，中止
entries.example: The school may suspend classes if the storm gets worse.
entries.exampleZh: 如果暴风雨加剧，学校可能会停课。

entries.example: The final result of the competition remained in complete suspense until midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛最终结果直到午夜仍完全悬而未决。

entries.example: The bridge's suspension cables were checked carefully after the strong storm.
entries.exampleZh: 强风暴过后，这座桥的悬索被仔细检查。

entries.example: The guard became suspicious when the stranger avoided every camera.
entries.exampleZh: 当陌生人避开每一台摄像机时，警卫起了疑心。

entries.meaning: 支撑；支持，维持；支撑，撑住，承受住；维持，保持；经受，遭受，忍耐
entries.example: These plants can sustain growth even during a long dry season.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物甚至在漫长旱季也能维持生长。

entries.meaning: 可以忍受的；足以支撑的；养得起的
entries.example: The city hopes to build a sustainable system for managing its waste.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市希望建立一个可持续的废物管理系统。

entries.example: The travelers carried enough sustenance for three days in the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 旅行者带了足够在山中维持三天的食物。

entries.example: Please swallow the pill with a full glass of water.
entries.exampleZh: 请用一整杯水吞下这片药。

entries.example: Heavy rain turned the low field into a muddy swamp overnight.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨一夜之间把低洼田地变成了泥泞的沼泽。

entries.example: Let us swap seats so you can sit near the window.
entries.exampleZh: 我们换一下座位吧，这样你可以坐在窗边。

entries.meaning: (昆虫)等一大群；成群飞舞；蜂拥而入
entries.example: A swarm of bees flew over the garden and frightened the children.
entries.exampleZh: 一群蜜蜂飞过花园，吓到了孩子们。

entries.example: The tall trees sway gently whenever the evening wind blows.
entries.exampleZh: 每当晚风吹起，高大的树木便轻轻摇摆。

entries.meaning: 郑重地说；强调；发誓；宣；诅咒
entries.example: I swear I will return your book before Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我发誓会在周五早上之前把你的书还给你。

entries.example: She packed a warm sweater for the cold nights in the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 她带了一件暖和的毛线衫，以备山中寒冷的夜晚。

entries.meaning: 扫，扫除；连绵区域；扫除；掠过；连绵
entries.example: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 请在今晚客人到来之前扫一下厨房地板。

entries.meaning: 使膨胀；使增强，使壮大，使隆起；膨胀；增长，增强
entries.example: Her ankle began to swell after the long walk yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天长途步行后，她的脚踝开始肿起来。

entries.example: The driver had to swerve sharply to avoid a small dog.
entries.exampleZh: 司机不得不猛打方向以避开一只小狗。

entries.meaning: 快的；迅速的，敏捷的；快的；敏捷的，迅速的
entries.example: The team made a swift recovery after the early defeat.
entries.exampleZh: 球队在早早失利后迅速恢复状态。

entries.meaning: 摆动，摇动；旋转，转向；摇摆；突然转向；摇摆；秋千
entries.example: The little girl likes to swing back and forth on the old tire.
entries.exampleZh: 小女孩喜欢在旧轮胎上荡来荡去。

entries.example: The dry leaves swirl around the yard whenever the wind rises.
entries.exampleZh: 每当风起，干枯的树叶便在院子里打旋。

entries.meaning: 改变，转变；转换；对调；开关；转换
entries.example: You can switch the light off when the room is empty.
entries.exampleZh: 房间没人时你可以把灯关掉。

entries.example: The old office chair began to swivel suddenly under his weight.
entries.exampleZh: 那把旧办公椅在他的重压下突然开始旋转。

entries.example: Our teacher posted the course syllabus online before the first class.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的老师在第一次上课前把课程教学大纲发到了网上。

entries.example: A white dove is often a symbol of peace around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 白鸽在世界各地常常是和平的象征。

entries.meaning: 符号的使用；象征主义，象征手法
entries.example: The novel uses vivid symbolism to explore hope and loss.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说用生动的象征手法探讨希望与失落。

entries.example: In many cultures, candles symbolize hope during dark times.
entries.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，蜡烛在黑暗时期象征着希望。

entries.example: The garden's perfect symmetry pleased everyone who walked through it.
entries.exampleZh: 花园完美的对称让每个走过的人都感到愉悦。

entries.meaning: 同情的，有同情心的；同情的，体谅的；赞同的，支持的；和谐的
entries.example: She gave me a sympathetic smile when I told her the news.
entries.exampleZh: 当我告诉她这个消息时，她给了我一个同情的微笑。

entries.example: I really sympathise with your difficult situation at work.
entries.exampleZh: 我真的很同情你在工作中遇到的困难处境。

entries.example: Her letter expressed deep sympathy for our recent loss.
entries.exampleZh: 她的信对我们最近的丧亲之痛表达了深切的同情。

entries.example: The orchestra performed a beautiful symphony by Mozart last night.
entries.exampleZh: 乐团昨晚演奏了莫扎特的一首优美交响曲。

entries.example: Scholars from several countries attended the symposium on climate change.
entries.exampleZh: 来自几个国家的学者参加了这次关于气候变化的专题讨论会。

entries.meaning: 症状，症候，征兆；症状；征候，征兆
entries.example: A persistent cough can be an early symptom of illness.
entries.exampleZh: 持续咳嗽可能是疾病的早期症状。

entries.example: We need to synchronise our watches before the race starts.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛开始前我们需要把手表校准同步。

entries.meaning: 使同时发生，使同步发生
entries.example: Please synchronize your calendar with the team's shared schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的日历与团队的共享日程同步。

entries.example: The teacher asked us to find a synonym for happy.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们找出一个表示快乐的同义词。

entries.meaning: 合成法；综合，合成物；综合，合成；综合体
entries.example: Her thesis offers a careful synthesis of several competing theories.
entries.exampleZh: 她的论文对几种相互竞争的理论进行了细致的综合。

entries.meaning: 人工合成的；人造的；合成的，综合的；合成物；合成纤维
entries.example: This jacket is made from a cheap synthetic material.
entries.exampleZh: 这件夹克是用一种廉价的人造材料制成的。

entries.meaning: 有系统的，系统的；有计划有步骤的；系统的，体系的
entries.example: The team followed a systematic approach to solve the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 团队采用系统的方法来解决这个问题。

entries.example: Click the blue tab to open your account settings.
entries.exampleZh: 点击蓝色标签打开你的账户设置。

entries.example: The doctor told him to take one tablet after breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 医生告诉他早餐后服用一片药。

entries.meaning: (宗教迷信)禁忌；禁忌的，禁止的
entries.example: In some cultures, it is a taboo to talk about money at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 在一些文化里，吃饭时谈论钱是一种禁忌。

entries.example: They reached a tacit agreement never to mention the accident again.
entries.exampleZh: 他们达成了心照不宣的默契，再也不提那次事故。

entries.meaning: 处理，对付；抓住；对付，处理；向某人提起；抢截，抢球；用具，器具；滑轮，滑车；抢截
entries.example: The team must tackle these problems before the deadline next week.
entries.exampleZh: 团队必须在下周截止日期前处理这些问题。

entries.example: Her favourite tactic was to ask questions until the speaker lost confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她最常用的策略是不断提问，直到发言的人失去信心。

entries.example: The price tag on that jacket seemed far too high for me.
entries.exampleZh: 那件夹克上的价签在我看来实在太高了。

entries.example: The spy had to take the stranger through the crowded railway station.
entries.exampleZh: 那名间谍不得不尾随陌生人穿过拥挤的火车站。

entries.example: She is a talented young musician who performs with great confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位有才华的年轻音乐家，演出时非常自信。

entries.meaning: 驯服了的；(人)顺从的，听话的
entries.example: The children were excited to stroke the tame rabbit at the farm.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们很兴奋能在农场抚摸那只驯服的兔子。

entries.example: Someone had tried to tamper with the lock on the back door.
entries.exampleZh: 有人曾试图乱动后门上的锁。

entries.meaning: 晒成棕褐色，晒黑；硝；棕褐色；晒黑
entries.example: After a week at the beach, she came back with a deep tan.
entries.exampleZh: 在海边待了一周后，她回来时晒得很黑。

entries.meaning: 可触知的；明确的；确实的
entries.example: The new plan brought tangible benefits to families in the area.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新计划给该地区的家庭带来了实实在在的好处。

entries.meaning: 可触摸地；可感知地；有形地
entries.example: The quality of the air improved tangibly after the new rules.
entries.exampleZh: 新规定实施后，空气质量有了可感知的改善。

entries.example: The traffic slowed to a tangle of cars near the bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 桥附近的车辆慢下来，挤成了一团。

entries.example: A huge oil tanker slowly entered the narrow harbour this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，一艘巨大的油轮缓缓驶入狭窄的港口。

entries.meaning: 龙头；轻拍，轻敲；轻拍，轻敲；轻拍；利用，开发
entries.example: The tap in the kitchen has been dripping all night.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房里的水龙头整晚都在滴水。

entries.example: Workers spread hot tar over the damaged road this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，工人们在损坏的路面上铺上了热沥青。

entries.meaning: 靶，标；批评对象；指标；目标；对象，靶子；对准，面向
entries.example: The company missed its sales target for the second year running.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司连续第二年没有完成销售目标。

entries.meaning: (酒店)价目表；关税税率；关税，税率；价目表
entries.example: The government raised the tariff on imported steel last month.
entries.exampleZh: 上个月政府提高了进口钢材的关税。

entries.meaning: (尤指金属表面)失去光泽；玷污
entries.example: A single scandal could tarnish the reputation of the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 一桩丑闻就可能玷污整个团队的声誉。

entries.example: The older boys would taunt him about his shabby shoes.
entries.exampleZh: 那些大一点的男孩会嘲笑他那双破旧的鞋子。

entries.example: The new government promised to reduce taxation for small businesses next year.
entries.exampleZh: 新政府承诺明年减轻小企业的税负。

entries.meaning: 协力合作，团队合作；配合
entries.example: Good teamwork made the difficult project much easier for everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的团队合作让这个困难的项目对每个人来说都轻松多了。

entries.meaning: 眼泪；撕裂，撕碎；破坏安宁
entries.example: A single tear rolled down her cheek during the sad movie.
entries.exampleZh: 看那部悲伤的电影时，一滴眼泪顺着她的脸颊滑落。

entries.meaning: 取笑，嘲笑；戏弄；逗乐，奚落，戏弄；强求；揶揄，戏弄，取笑；逗弄者，取笑者
entries.example: Please do not tease your younger brother about his new haircut.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要拿你弟弟的新发型取笑他。

entries.example: The manual explains the technical details in simple language for new users.
entries.exampleZh: 这本手册用简单的语言向新用户解释技术细节。

entries.example: A skilled technician repaired the broken machine in less than an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 一位熟练的技术人员不到一小时就修好了那台坏机器。

entries.meaning: 技术，技能；行家手法；技巧，技艺；技术，技能
entries.example: Her swimming technique improved after weeks of careful practice with a coach.
entries.exampleZh: 经过数周在教练指导下的认真练习，她的游泳技术提高了。

entries.meaning: 乏味的，沉闷的；冗长乏味的，单调的
entries.example: The lecture was so tedious that several students fell asleep.
entries.exampleZh: 那场讲座非常乏味，以至于好几个学生都睡着了。

entries.meaning: 大量出现，涌现；倾泻；充满，遍布
entries.example: These clear rivers teem with fish during the warm summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 在温暖的夏季月份，这些清澈的河流里鱼群大量出现。

entries.example: The company invests heavily in telecommunication systems across several developing countries.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司在几个发展中国家的电信系统上投入巨资。

entries.meaning: 打电报，发电报；泄露，流露；电报机；电报
entries.example: Messages once traveled by telegraph across long distances in a few minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 过去，信息通过电报在几分钟内传送到很远的地方。

entries.example: We used a small telescope to observe the rings around Saturn.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用一架小型望远镜观察了土星周围的光环。

entries.meaning: 用户电报；直通专用电传
entries.example: The office still sends urgent orders by telex to its overseas partners.
entries.exampleZh: 这个办公室仍然通过电传向海外合作伙伴发送紧急订单。

entries.example: Her silence was a telling sign that she disagreed with the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她的沉默是一个有力的迹象，表明她不同意这个计划。

entries.meaning: 心情；怒气，脾气；使软化，使缓和；情绪；使缓和
entries.example: He lost his temper when the train was delayed again.
entries.exampleZh: 火车再次晚点时他发火了。

entries.example: Her calm temperament makes her a good teacher for young children.
entries.exampleZh: 她沉稳的性情使她成为幼儿的好老师。

entries.meaning: 有节制的，不过分的；(气候)温和的
entries.example: The region has a temperate climate with mild winters and cool summers.
entries.exampleZh: 该地区气候温和，冬季温和，夏季凉爽。

entries.example: The music slowed its tempo near the end of the song.
entries.exampleZh: 这首歌接近结尾时音乐放慢了节奏。

entries.meaning: 暂时的；临时的；临时的，暂时的
entries.example: She found a temporary job while searching for a permanent position.
entries.exampleZh: 她在寻找永久职位期间找到了一份临时工作。

entries.example: The low price might tempt you to buy more than you need.
entries.exampleZh: 低价可能会诱使你买下超过你需要的东西。

entries.example: The smell of fresh bread was a strong temptation for the hungry children.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味对饥饿的孩子们来说是一种强烈的诱惑。

entries.meaning: 可防守的，守得住的；可保持的，可维持的；站得住脚的；可防守的
entries.example: Your argument is not tenable without stronger evidence and clear examples.
entries.exampleZh: 没有更有力的证据和清晰的例子，你的论点站不住脚。

entries.example: The tenacious climber refused to give up despite the freezing wind.
entries.exampleZh: 那位顽强的登山者不顾刺骨的寒风，拒绝放弃。

entries.example: The landlord renewed our tenancy for another year after a friendly meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 房东在一次友好的会面后把我们的租期又延长了一年。

entries.example: The new tenant paid the first month's rent before moving in.
entries.exampleZh: 新租客在搬进来之前付了第一个月的房租。

entries.example: Young children tend to copy the behavior of their parents.
entries.exampleZh: 年幼的孩子往往会模仿父母的行为。

entries.example: There is a growing tendency for people to work from home.
entries.exampleZh: 人们在家工作的趋势正在日益增长。

entries.meaning: 脆弱的，娇嫩的；温柔的；提供，投标；嫩的；脆弱的；温柔的

entries.exampleZh: 她给了受惊的小狗一个温柔的拥抱和轻声细语。

entries.example: His voice sounded tense during the difficult interview with the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 在与经理的那次艰难面试中，他的声音听起来很紧张。

entries.meaning: 拉力的，张力的；可延展的，可伸长的
entries.example: Engineers tested the tensile strength of the new bridge cables.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师测试了新桥缆索的抗拉强度。

entries.meaning: 紧张局势；情绪紧张；不安状态
entries.example: The tension in the room rose when the two rivals met.
entries.exampleZh: 当两个对手见面时，房间里的紧张气氛加剧了。

entries.example: A squid uses each tentacle to catch food and feel its surroundings.
entries.exampleZh: 鱿鱼用每一条触手捕捉食物并感知周围环境。

entries.example: We made a tentative plan to meet again next Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们暂时计划下周五下午再次见面。

entries.example: The contract covers a term of two years and can be renewed.
entries.exampleZh: 这份合同涵盖两年期限，并且可以续签。

entries.meaning: 终点站；航空枢纽；每期的；终点的；末端的；终点，终端；终点站，航站楼
entries.example: We waited at the bus terminal until the last coach arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在汽车终点站一直等到最后一班长途汽车到达。

entries.example: The company may terminate the contract if payments stop completely.
entries.exampleZh: 如果付款完全停止，公司可能会终止合同。

entries.example: Medical terminology can be difficult for ordinary readers to understand at first.
entries.exampleZh: 医学术语起初可能让普通读者难以理解。

entries.meaning: 斜坡地，梯田；看台，大阶级；一层梯田；一排并列的房子；阳台
entries.example: From the terrace we watched the sun set behind the distant hills.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从露台上看着太阳落在远处的山丘后面。

entries.meaning: 地面，地形，地图；地形，地势
entries.example: The rocky terrain made the long hike slow and rather exhausting.
entries.exampleZh: 多岩石的地形使这次长途徒步变得缓慢而相当累人。

entries.meaning: 地球上的，陆地的；陆地的，陆生的，陆栖的；地球的
entries.example: Many terrestrial animals depend on forests for food and safe shelter.
entries.exampleZh: 许多陆生动物依赖森林获取食物和安全的庇护所。

entries.example: A terrific storm destroyed several houses along the coast last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一场可怕的暴风雨摧毁了海岸边几栋房屋。

entries.example: Loud noises at night can terrify small children and their pets.
entries.exampleZh: 夜间的巨响会吓坏小孩子和他们的宠物。

entries.example: The two countries have a long territorial dispute over that island.
entries.exampleZh: 两国就那座岛屿存在长期的领土争端。

entries.meaning: 领土，区域；领土，版图；领域，范围
entries.example: The wolf marks its territory to warn other animals away.
entries.exampleZh: 狼标记自己的领地以警告其他动物离开。

entries.example: The sudden darkness filled the children with terror and confusion.
entries.exampleZh: 突如其来的黑暗使孩子们充满了恐惧和困惑。

entries.example: His terse reply made it clear that he was annoyed.
entries.exampleZh: 他简短生硬的回答清楚表明他生气了。

entries.example: Her testimony in court helped the police catch the thief.
entries.exampleZh: 她在法庭上的证词帮助警方抓住了小偷。

entries.example: The factory produces textile goods for several European countries.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂为几个欧洲国家生产纺织产品。

entries.meaning: (织物)组织，结构；(材料)构造，结构；质地，纹理；口感
entries.example: The soft texture of this cloth feels pleasant against my skin.
entries.exampleZh: 这块布的柔软质地贴在我的皮肤上很舒服。

entries.example: The spring thaw turned the frozen river into dangerous water.
entries.exampleZh: 春季的解冻使冰封的河流变成了危险的水域。

entries.example: The police are investigating the theft of a valuable painting.
entries.exampleZh: 警方正在调查一幅珍贵画作被盗的案件。

entries.example: The main theme of the novel is love and forgiveness.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说的主题是爱与宽恕。

entries.example: The course offers theoretical knowledge but little practical training.
entries.exampleZh: 这门课程提供理论知识，但几乎没有实践训练。

entries.meaning: 理论，原理；学说；意见，看法
entries.example: Darwin's theory of evolution changed how scientists understand life.
entries.exampleZh: 达尔文的进化论改变了科学家对生命的理解。

entries.example: Physical therapy helped her walk again after the serious accident.
entries.exampleZh: 物理治疗帮助她在严重事故后重新行走。

entries.example: He signed the contract, thereby agreeing to all its terms.
entries.exampleZh: 他签署了合同，从而同意了其中的所有条款。

entries.example: The road was flooded; therefore, we took a longer route.
entries.exampleZh: 道路被淹了，因此我们走了一条更长的路线。

entries.meaning: 热的；热量的；热的，热量的；热气流

entries.exampleZh: 这件夹克有特殊的保暖内衬，适合寒冷的冬日。

entries.exampleZh: 护士用数字温度计测量了他的体温。

entries.example: Please turn down the thermostat before the room gets too warm.
entries.exampleZh: 请在房间变得太热之前把恒温器调低。

entries.exampleZh: 我的老师在教室的字典旁放着一本厚厚的同义词词典。

entries.exampleZh: 他整个夏天都在写关于古代贸易路线的论文。

entries.example: The player injured his thigh during the second half of the match.
entries.exampleZh: 那名球员在下半场比赛中伤了大腿。

entries.example: After the long hike, her thirst was impossible to ignore.
entries.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，她的口渴实在难以忽视。

entries.example: The children were thirsty after playing outside all afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在户外玩了一下午，都渴了。

entries.example: A sharp thorn cut through her glove while she picked roses.
entries.exampleZh: 她摘玫瑰时，一根尖刺划破了她的手套。

entries.example: The committee faced a thorny question about funding for the project.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会面临一个关于项目资金的棘手问题。

entries.example: The doctor gave him a thorough check before the operation.
entries.exampleZh: 手术前医生给他做了彻底的检查。

entries.meaning: 深思的，关心的；沉思的；体贴的

entries.exampleZh: 你为她母亲带花来，真是体贴。

entries.exampleZh: 比赛还没开始，乌云就预示着要下雨。

entries.meaning: 门槛；开始；开端，入门；入门，门槛；界限；开端，起点

entries.exampleZh: 她在门槛前停了一下，然后才走进空荡荡的大厅。

entries.example: My grandmother was thrifty and never wasted a single piece of bread.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖母很节俭，从不浪费一片面包。

entries.meaning: 激动；震颤；非常激动；发抖

entries.exampleZh: 坐过山车让孩子们兴奋不已。

entries.example: These plants thrive in warm, wet climates near the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物在沿海温暖潮湿的气候中长得很茂盛。

entries.example: He caught a cold and now his throat feels very sore.
entries.exampleZh: 他感冒了，现在嗓子很疼。

entries.example: After the long run, she felt a throbbing pain in her knee.
entries.exampleZh: 长跑之后，她感到膝盖一阵阵跳痛。

entries.example: A throng of fans waited outside the stadium for hours.
entries.exampleZh: 一大群粉丝在体育场外等了好几个小时。

entries.exampleZh: 这个节日把音乐和舞蹈带到了老城的各个角落。

entries.exampleZh: 火箭的推力使它缓慢地离开了地面。

entries.example: He hurt his thumb while closing the heavy wooden door.
entries.exampleZh: 他关那扇沉重的木门时伤到了大拇指。

entries.meaning: 雷，雷声；轰隆声；打雷；轰隆响；雷；雷声

entries.exampleZh: 乌云聚集，响亮的雷声滚过山谷。

entries.meaning: (钟表)滴答声；一刹那；用勾作为记号

entries.exampleZh: 钟开始在安静的房间里大声滴答作响。

entries.example: Soft feathers can tickle your nose and make you sneeze.
entries.exampleZh: 柔软的羽毛会使你的鼻子发痒，让你打喷嚏。

entries.meaning: 潮汐，(舆论，公众情绪)潮流趋势

entries.exampleZh: 潮水迅速上涨，淹没了小片沙滩。

entries.example: Her tidy desk had every paper in the correct folder.
entries.exampleZh: 她整洁的书桌上每份文件都放在正确的文件夹里。

entries.meaning: (使)变紧，(使)绷紧，扣紧；变紧；使更加严格，加强

entries.exampleZh: 请在你摇晃那个罐子之前把盖子拧紧。

entries.exampleZh: 一块松动的瓦片在暴风雨中从屋顶掉落。

entries.example: The farmers hoped the dry field would soon become tillable.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们希望这块干涸的土地很快变得适宜耕种。

entries.meaning: (使)倾斜；倾斜，斜坡；倾斜，倾侧；倾向于，偏向；倾斜，倾侧
entries.example: The old painting had a slight tilt to the left.
entries.exampleZh: 那幅旧画略微向左倾斜。

entries.meaning: 木材，木料；树木，树林；木材，木料；栋木，大梁

entries.exampleZh: 工人们从森林里砍伐木材来建造新房子。

entries.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩度过了一段美好的时光。

entries.exampleZh: 她及时的警告帮助我们避免了一场严重的道路事故。

entries.example: The timid boy hid behind his mother at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 那个胆小的男孩在聚会上躲在母亲身后。

entries.example: His timidity kept him from speaking in front of the class.
entries.exampleZh: 他的胆怯使他不愿在全班面前发言。

entries.meaning: (较淡)着色于，染色；使带有气息

entries.exampleZh: 日出时淡淡的粉红色光线会使云朵染上一层颜色。

entries.meaning: 生理组织；薄纸；棉纸；织物；一套

entries.exampleZh: 医生在显微镜下检查了一份薄薄的组织样本。

entries.meaning: 标题；题目；称号；法律权利，所有权
entries.example: The title of her new book is simple but striking.
entries.exampleZh: 她那本新书的标题简单却引人注目。

entries.meaning: 烤面包，烤火；为祝酒，敬酒

entries.exampleZh: 她早餐喜欢吃抹了黄油和果酱的烤面包。

entries.example: The little child began to toddle across the living room.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小孩开始摇摇晃晃地走过客厅。

entries.meaning: 辛劳工作，艰难地行动；苦工，难事

entries.exampleZh: 农民们在炎热的夏日阳光下辛勤劳作数小时。

entries.example: This small gift is a token of my thanks for your help.
entries.exampleZh: 这份小礼物是我对你帮助的一点心意。

entries.meaning: 可忍受的，可容许的，尚好的

entries.exampleZh: 到了下午，房间里的热度几乎让人受不了。

entries.exampleZh: 宝宝出生后，她对噪音的容忍度就消失了。

entries.example: I cannot tolerate people who are rude to waiters.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法容忍对服务员无礼的人。

entries.meaning: (道路，桥梁)通行费；损失，代价；税收

entries.exampleZh: 这座新桥的通行费上个月翻了一倍。

entries.example: He carried a heavy old tome to the reading desk.
entries.exampleZh: 他把一本沉甸甸的旧巨著搬到阅读桌上。

entries.example: She answered in a toneless voice that hid her feelings.
entries.exampleZh: 她用毫无起伏的单调声音回答，掩饰了自己的情绪。

entries.example: Hot soup burned his tongue at dinner last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚吃饭时，热汤烫到了他的舌头。

entries.meaning: 滋补品，补药；强身的，健体的
entries.example: Ginseng tea is a popular tonic in many Asian homes.
entries.exampleZh: 人参茶在许多亚洲家庭中是常见的补品。

entries.exampleZh: 夏季暴风雨中，强风能吹倒老树。

entries.example: Farmers added rich topsoil before planting the new seeds.
entries.exampleZh: 农民在播下新种子前加了一层肥沃的表层土。

entries.example: He lit a torch to find the path in darkness.
entries.exampleZh: 他点着火把在黑暗中寻找小路。

entries.meaning: 剧烈痛苦；折磨，烦扰；折磨；纠缠；痛苦，折磨；令人痛苦的东西[tɔː'ment]；折磨，使痛苦，烦扰；纠缠；戏弄，捉弄

entries.exampleZh: 持续的噪音成了一家人的折磨。

entries.exampleZh: 昨晚龙卷风警报让所有人都躲进了地下室。

entries.exampleZh: 一小时的工夫，瓢泼大雨就淹没了街道。

entries.example: The old tortoise moved slowly across the sunny garden path.
entries.exampleZh: 那只老陆龟慢慢地爬过阳光下的花园小径。

entries.meaning: 拷打，折磨，使受剧烈痛苦

entries.exampleZh: 等考试成绩对我来说简直是种折磨。

entries.exampleZh: 我摆桌子的时候，你能把沙拉拌一下吗？

entries.example: He is touchy about jokes regarding his new haircut.
entries.exampleZh: 他对于有关自己新发型的玩笑很敏感。

entries.exampleZh: 旅游业为这个沿海小镇带来了大量收入。

entries.example: Our team won the tennis tournament last weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队上周末赢得了那场网球锦标赛。

entries.example: The truck had to tow our car to the nearest garage.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆卡车不得不把我们的车拖到最近的修车厂。

entries.example: She dried her hands with a clean towel.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一条干净的毛巾擦干了手。

entries.example: The old stone bridge adds charm to the townscape.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的石桥为市镇风光增添了魅力。

entries.meaning: 有毒的，中毒的；有毒的；中毒的

entries.exampleZh: 那家工厂去年把有毒废料排入了河中。

entries.exampleZh: 科学家在贝类中发现了一种危险的毒素。

entries.exampleZh: 那些丢失的钥匙在厚雪中没有留下任何痕迹。

entries.exampleZh: 警察沿着小偷穿过雪地的足迹追踪。

entries.exampleZh: 一大片森林被砍伐开垦成了农田。

entries.exampleZh: 湿滑的路面使轮胎几乎没有抓地力。

entries.exampleZh: 过新年吃饺子是家里的一项传统。

entries.meaning: 传统的，惯例的；口传的，传说的

entries.exampleZh: 我祖母每个星期天仍然做传统菜肴。

entries.exampleZh: 那场大火对整个村庄来说是一场可怕的悲剧。

entries.exampleZh: 这个故事以海上的一场悲惨事故告终。

entries.exampleZh: 耐心是一名好老师的重要品质。

entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥今年晚些时候将进行大修。

entries.meaning: 大学本科生，大学生，大学肄业生
entries.example: As an undergraduate, she studied history and wrote for the paper.
entries.exampleZh: 作为本科生，她学习历史并为校报撰稿。

entries.example: We took the underground to the museum instead of a taxi.
entries.exampleZh: 我们乘地铁去博物馆，没有打车。

entries.meaning: 划线于之下，强调；画线于…之下；强调
entries.example: Please underline the most important sentence in each paragraph.
entries.exampleZh: 请在每个段落中最重要的句子下面画线。

entries.example: The manager rarely listened to advice from his young underling.
entries.exampleZh: 经理很少听取他那位年轻下属的建议。

entries.meaning: 含蓄的，潜在的；在下面的；表面下的，下层的，在下面的；根本的；潜在的，隐含的
entries.example: The doctor could not find the underlying cause of the pain.
entries.exampleZh: 医生找不到这种疼痛的潜在原因。

entries.meaning: (暗中)破坏；(逐渐)削弱；削弱；破坏
entries.example: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence over time.
entries.exampleZh: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱孩子的自信。

entries.meaning: 在下面，在底下；在下面；在…下面；下部
entries.example: The cat hid underneath the old wooden table during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间，猫躲在那张旧木桌下面。

entries.example: Strong evidence should underpin every claim in your research paper.
entries.exampleZh: 有力的证据应当支撑你研究论文中的每一个论断。

entries.meaning: 可以理解的，能懂的；可同情的
entries.example: Her anger was understandable given the unfair treatment she received.
entries.exampleZh: 考虑到她受到的不公平待遇，她的愤怒是可以理解的。

entries.meaning: 体谅的；宽容的；理解；谅解
entries.example: Thank you for your patience and understanding during this difficult time.
entries.exampleZh: 感谢你在这段困难时期给予的耐心与体谅。

entries.meaning: 同意，答应；着手做某事；承担，负起责任；同意或答应做某事
entries.example: The company will undertake a full review of its safety procedures.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将着手对其安全程序进行全面审查。

entries.meaning: 给保险；同意赔款(海上保险)
entries.example: The insurer will underwrite the cargo for the long sea voyage.
entries.exampleZh: 保险公司将为这批货物在漫长的海上航行中承保。

entries.example: The small error remained undetected for several months.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小错误好几个月都没有被发现。

entries.example: She looked at him with undisguised admiration and delight.
entries.exampleZh: 她用毫不掩饰的钦佩和喜悦看着他。

entries.meaning: 解开，拨开；败坏(名声，成果)
entries.example: He tried to undo the knot with his shaking fingers.
entries.exampleZh: 他试着用颤抖的手指解开那个结。

entries.meaning: 无疑地，必是地；毋庸置疑地，确凿地
entries.example: This is undoubtedly the best meal I have had here.
entries.exampleZh: 这无疑是我在这里吃过的最好的一餐。

entries.example: The delay caused undue stress for everyone in the team.
entries.exampleZh: 这次延误给团队中的每个人都造成了过度的压力。

entries.meaning: 不自在的；心神不安的；担心的
entries.example: I felt uneasy about leaving the children home alone.
entries.exampleZh: 我对把孩子们单独留在家里感到不安。

entries.example: The rise in unemployment worried many local families.
entries.exampleZh: 失业率的上升令许多当地家庭感到担忧。

entries.example: The path was uneven and difficult to walk on.
entries.exampleZh: 这条小路高低不平，走起来很困难。

entries.example: An unexpected guest arrived just before dinner started.
entries.exampleZh: 一位不速之客在晚餐开始前刚到。

entries.example: She began to unfold the map on the table.
entries.exampleZh: 她开始在桌子上展开地图。

entries.example: The concert was unfortunately cancelled because of heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会因大雨而不幸被取消了。

entries.example: The young horse looked ungainly as it ran.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹小马跑起来显得很笨拙。

entries.meaning: 不变的，一贯的；制服；相同的，一致的
entries.example: The bricks were laid in a uniform pattern.
entries.exampleZh: 砖块被铺成整齐一致的图案。

entries.meaning: 使联合，统一，使相同，一致
entries.example: The new leader hopes to unify the divided party.
entries.exampleZh: 新领导人希望使分裂的政党团结起来。

entries.example: They made a unilateral decision without asking the other partners.
entries.exampleZh: 他们未征求其他合伙人意见就做出了单方面决定。

entries.meaning: 协会，工会，同盟；联合，合并
entries.example: The local union voted to accept the new contract on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 当地工会周五投票接受了新合同。

entries.meaning: 唯一的，独一无二的；唯一的，独一无二的；极不寻常的，极好的
entries.example: Her unique style of painting attracts visitors from many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 她独特的绘画风格吸引了来自许多国家的游客。

entries.example: Music is often called a universal language that everyone can understand.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐常被称为一种人人都能理解的通用语言。

entries.meaning: 宇宙，天地万物；世界；领域
entries.example: Scientists still do not know how large the universe really is.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们仍然不知道宇宙究竟有多大。

entries.example: It is unlikely that the match will finish before dark.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛不太可能在入夜前结束。

entries.example: Two workers helped us unload the boxes from the truck.
entries.exampleZh: 两名工人帮我们从卡车上卸下了箱子。

entries.meaning: 不显著的，不引人注目的；不张扬的
entries.example: She wore unobtrusive clothes that did not draw any attention.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿着不引人注目的衣服，没有引起任何注意。

entries.example: The view from the mountain top was simply unparalleled in beauty.
entries.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色之美简直无与伦比。

entries.example: A good judge must remain unprejudiced when listening to both sides.
entries.exampleZh: 好的法官在听取双方意见时必须保持无偏见。

entries.example: He finished reading the letter aloud and said unquote before sitting down.
entries.exampleZh: 他大声读完那封信，说了句“引语结束”，然后坐了下来。

entries.example: Detectives worked for months to unravel the mystery of the missing painting.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探们花了几个月时间解开那幅失踪画作之谜。

entries.example: Expecting perfect results from a single lesson is quite unrealistic.
entries.exampleZh: 指望一节课就取得完美结果是很不现实的。

entries.example: The club refuses to accept unregistered guests after ten at night.
entries.exampleZh: 俱乐部拒绝在晚上十点后接待未登记的客人。

entries.example: Growing unrest in the region forced the government to act quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 该地区日益加剧的动荡迫使政府迅速采取行动。

entries.example: The restaurant was closed because its kitchen was dirty and unsanitary.
entries.exampleZh: 那家餐厅因为厨房又脏又不卫生而被关停。

entries.example: The manager called the team's performance unsatisfactory and demanded real improvement.
entries.exampleZh: 经理称团队的表现不能令人满意，并要求切实改进。

entries.example: The storm caused untold damage to farms across the northern valley.
entries.exampleZh: 这场风暴给北部山谷的农场造成了数不清的损失。

entries.meaning: 不值得信任的，靠不住的
entries.example: His untrustworthy behaviour made the whole team doubt his reports.
entries.exampleZh: 他不可信的行为让整个团队都怀疑他的报告。

entries.meaning: 揭去面纱或覆盖物；揭幕；首次公开、揭露或展示
entries.example: The company will unveil its new phone at a special event.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将在一次特别活动上发布新手机。

entries.example: The children couldn't wait to unwrap their presents on Christmas morning.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们迫不及待地想在圣诞节早上拆开礼物。

entries.meaning: 顽强的；坚硬的；不能弯曲的，坚固的
entries.example: Her unyielding determination helped the team finish the project despite many problems.
entries.exampleZh: 她顽强的决心帮助团队克服许多困难完成了项目。

entries.example: His strict upbringing taught him to respect others and work hard.
entries.exampleZh: 他严格的教养教会他尊重他人并努力工作。

entries.example: Please update your address in the system before the end of the week.
entries.exampleZh: 请在本周末之前更新你在系统中的地址。

entries.meaning: 向上的斜坡；增加，改善；使升级，提高，改进；提拔，提升；改善
entries.example: The company decided to upgrade its software to improve daily work.
entries.exampleZh: 公司决定升级其软件以改善日常工作。

entries.example: The old man walked uphill slowly with a heavy bag of fruit.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人提着一袋沉重的水果，缓慢地往上走。

entries.example: The court must uphold the law even when public opinion is strong.
entries.exampleZh: 即使公众舆论强烈，法院也必须维护法律。

entries.example: The upkeep of this old house costs more than we expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的保养费比我们预期的要高。

entries.example: She hurt her upper arm while playing tennis last Saturday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 上周六下午打网球时，她伤到了上臂。

entries.example: The piano stood upright against the wall in the quiet living room.
entries.exampleZh: 钢琴直立着靠在安静客厅的墙边。

entries.example: The violent uprising was quickly ended by the well-trained soldiers.
entries.exampleZh: 那场暴力的叛乱很快被训练有素的士兵平息了。

entries.meaning: 倾覆，打乱；心烦的；不适的；使苦恼；搅乱；推翻，颠倒[ˌʌp's3t]
entries.example: She felt upset after reading the message from her best friend.
entries.exampleZh: 读完最好朋友发来的消息后，她感到很心烦。

entries.example: Many young families move to urban areas for better job chances.
entries.exampleZh: 许多年轻家庭为了更好的工作机会搬到城市地区。

entries.example: Rapid urbanization has changed the quiet village into a busy city.
entries.exampleZh: 快速的城市化把这个安静的村庄变成了繁忙的城市。

entries.meaning: 敦促，力劝；鼓励；竭力主张

entries.exampleZh: 医生敦促人们在炎热的夏日多喝水。

entries.meaning: 紧急的，紧迫的；催促的，急切的

entries.exampleZh: 我们收到一条紧急消息，不得不提早离开聚会。

entries.example: The utilisation of solar power has grown quickly in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来太阳能的利用增长得很快。

entries.example: We should utilise our free time to learn a new language.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应该利用空闲时间学习一门新语言。

entries.meaning: 有用，实用；公用事业(煤气，水电)；功用，效用；

entries.exampleZh: 这个简单工具的实用性让工地上所有工人感到惊讶。

entries.example: She handled the difficult situation with the utmost care and patience.
entries.exampleZh: 她以极度的谨慎和耐心处理了这个棘手的局面。

entries.meaning: 用言语表达，讲话；话语，言语，言论

entries.exampleZh: 他在会上最后说的话让房间里所有人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: She was utterly exhausted after the long journey home.
entries.exampleZh: 长途回家后她完全累坏了。

entries.meaning: 空位，空房间；空缺，空职；无主意，空虚，茫然若失
entries.example: The hotel had one vacancy left for the busy weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店繁忙的周末还剩一个空房。

entries.meaning: 空的；未被占用的；空虚的，无表情的；未占用的，空的
entries.example: The old house has been vacant since last winter.
entries.exampleZh: 这所老房子从去年冬天起就一直空着。

entries.meaning: 假期;休庭期;腾空；假期；休假
entries.example: We spent our summer vacation at a quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在一个安静的湖边度过了暑假。

entries.meaning: 真空；用吸尘器清扫；真空；
entries.example: A vacuum cleaner can remove dust from the carpet.
entries.exampleZh: 吸尘器可以清除地毯上的灰尘。

entries.example: His answer was too vague for us to understand.
entries.exampleZh: 他的回答太模糊了，我们无法理解。

entries.meaning: 徒劳的，无效果的；自负的；不尊敬的

entries.exampleZh: 他徒劳地试图打开那扇沉重的门。

entries.meaning: 有效的，具有法律效力的；正当的；有根据的，有理的

entries.exampleZh: 你的护照在接下来的三个月内仍然有效。

entries.example: The lawyer questioned the validity of the signed contract.
entries.exampleZh: 律师质疑了这份已签署合同的有效性。

entries.example: A small river runs through the green valley below.
entries.exampleZh: 一条小河穿过下面的绿色山谷。

entries.meaning: 贵重的，有价值的；贵重物品，财宝
entries.example: She gave me some valuable advice before the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 面试前她给了我一些宝贵的建议。

entries.example: The company hired an expert to complete the valuation.
entries.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位专家来完成估价。

entries.example: Please turn the valve slowly to stop the water.
entries.exampleZh: 请慢慢转动阀门来停止水流。

entries.example: The delivery van stopped outside our house this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 送货车今天下午停在了我们家外面。

entries.meaning: 消失；突然消失；不复存在，消逝
entries.example: The morning fog will vanish when the sun rises.
entries.exampleZh: 当太阳升起时，晨雾将会消失。

entries.example: Her vanity made her spend hours before the mirror.
entries.exampleZh: 她的虚荣心使她在镜子前花了好几个小时。

entries.example: The young general hoped to vanquish his old enemy.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻将军希望击败他的老敌人。

entries.example: The variability of the weather makes planning difficult here.
entries.exampleZh: 天气的变化无常使这里的计划安排变得困难。

entries.meaning: 可变的，变化的；可变物，变量

entries.meaning: 不同的，变异的；变体，异体；不同的；变量；变体

entries.exampleZh: 这种病毒的变体传播得比之前更快。

entries.exampleZh: 老师注意到两次测试结果有轻微变化。

entries.example: Her varied interests include music, sports, and travel.
entries.exampleZh: 她兴趣多样，包括音乐、体育和旅行。

entries.meaning: 多样化；种；变种；综艺演出；品种，种类；变化，多样化
entries.example: The shop offers a wide variety of fresh fruit.
entries.exampleZh: 这家商店提供种类繁多的新鲜水果。

entries.meaning: 各种各样的；不同的；多方面的
entries.example: We discussed various ways to solve the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们讨论了解决问题的各种方法。

entries.meaning: 变化；改变；多样化；变化；不同
entries.example: Prices for fresh fruit vary widely from store to store.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜水果的价格在不同商店差别很大。

entries.example: The vast desert stretches for miles in every direction.
entries.exampleZh: 广阔的沙漠向四面八方延伸数英里。

entries.example: My sister has been a vegetarian for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹多年来一直是素食者。

entries.example: Thick vegetation covered the hills after the rainy season.
entries.exampleZh: 雨季过后，茂密的植被覆盖了山丘。

entries.meaning: 感情强烈的；热烈的；(人)有强烈感情的
entries.example: She made a vehement protest against the new rules.
entries.exampleZh: 她强烈抗议这些新规定。

entries.meaning: 车辆交通工具；思想媒介
entries.example: The old vehicle broke down on the narrow road.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在狭窄的路上抛锚了。

entries.meaning: 面纱；掩饰物；面纱；遮蔽物；蒙着面纱；掩饰
entries.example: A thin veil of mist covered the quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 一层薄雾笼罩着安静的湖面。

entries.meaning: 静脉，叶脉；(石头)纹理；矿脉
entries.example: The nurse carefully found a vein in his arm.
entries.exampleZh: 护士小心地在他手臂上找到一根静脉。

entries.meaning: 速度，速率；速度，速率；迅速，快速
entries.example: The rocket reached a high velocity before leaving the atmosphere.
entries.exampleZh: 火箭在离开大气层前达到了很高的速度。

entries.example: Many people venerate the old teacher for his wisdom.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人因这位老教师的智慧而敬重他。

entries.example: He sought vengeance after his brother was treated unfairly.
entries.exampleZh: 在他兄弟受到不公平对待后，他寻求报复。

entries.meaning: 有毒的；分泌毒液的；恶意的，狠毒的
entries.example: The venomous snake warned us with a loud hiss.
entries.exampleZh: 那条毒蛇大声嘶嘶作响，警告我们不要靠近。

entries.example: The workers opened a vent to let hot air escape.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们打开一个通风口让热空气排出。

entries.example: We need to ventilate the room before the guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 客人到达前我们需要给房间通风。

entries.meaning: 空气流通；通风设备，通风方法
entries.example: Good ventilation keeps the small kitchen fresh and dry.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的通风使小厨房保持清新干燥。

entries.meaning: 冒险，冒险事业；敢于去；拿…冒险，
entries.example: They decided to venture into the forest without a guide.
entries.exampleZh: 他们决定在没有向导的情况下冒险进入森林。

entries.example: The concert venue was easy to find near the main station.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会场地就在主车站附近，很容易找到。

entries.meaning: 言语的，字句的；口头的；口头的；言辞的，文字的，词语的；动词的
entries.example: Her verbal instructions were clear, so everyone finished the task quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 她的口头指示很清楚，所以大家都很快完成了任务。

entries.meaning: (陪审团)裁决, 定论；意见 "；裁定；定论；判断；意见
entries.example: The jury reached a verdict after two hours of discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 陪审团经过两小时的讨论后作出了裁决。

entries.example: The old bridge stands on the verge of collapse.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧桥处于倒塌的边缘。

entries.example: The bank requires verification of your address before opening the account.
entries.exampleZh: 银行在开户前要求确认你的地址。

entries.example: Please verify the figures before you send the report.
entries.exampleZh: 请在发送报告前核实这些数字。

entries.meaning: 本国语的；本国话；方言；土语；民间风格
entries.example: The local people still use their vernacular in daily conversation.
entries.exampleZh: 当地人仍在日常对话中使用他们的方言。

entries.meaning: 多才多艺的；技术超群的；多才多艺的，多面手的；多用途的，通用的
entries.example: She is a versatile artist who can paint and sculpt.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位多才多艺的艺术家，既能绘画又能雕塑。

entries.meaning: 描述，译文；说法；样式；型号；种类；说法；版本；译本
entries.example: The new version of the software runs faster than the old one.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新版本的软件运行得比旧版快。

entries.meaning: [略作v或vs](诉讼或比赛中)对；与…相对，对抗
